tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 rdzogs pa chen po ngal gso skor gsum

tei:div.tei:p: rnyoḍirdorme3 noske rī dū/ rte thu litshodku rternyo shu sto snye༄/tsa rdzirke —4 7 'iglerngolasdeḍa'i 4 —sha do wa—5ri—sna—jaX shoX— — rgyohoshri
skru lhi// bhe— ༵treṭaṃ trītswangarnye~X/ phozhispre

dkar chas/rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya ba/ (1)rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i bsdus don puṇḍa rī ka'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ (9)rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba/ (12)rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i don khrid snying po bcud bsdus zhes bya ba/ ( 4)rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso zhes bya ba/ (46)rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso'i bsdus don matsā ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ (58)rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta bzang po zhes bya ba/ (62)rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i gnas gsum dag pa gsum gyi don khrid byang chub lam bzang (126)rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso zhes bya ba/ (165)rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta chen po zhes bya ba/ (207)

sa /rjogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya ba ba'ugs/rgya gar skad du/ ma hā sa sgyu na tha shārnya nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma'i rang bzhin mkha' mnyam dag pa'i dgyings/ /chos mchog mi g.yo shin tu spros dang bral/ /'od gsal mas nyid byang chub snying po la/ /gzhi rdzogs 'apo 'gyur thed par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shin tu rmad byung gang / /so so rang rig ye shes rtogs bya'i phyir/ /rgyud luji man ngag snying po'i bcud bkus te/ /ji ltar nyams su blangs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /ri rtse nags khrod mtsho gling la sogs pa/ /dus bzhi yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo zhi ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /'od gsal rjos dang bral ba bsgom par bya/ /gnas dang gang zag nyams su blang bya'i chos/ /rnam gsum rang bzhin dag las 'aspub par 'gyur/ /dang po gnas ni dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /dus bzhi'i rnal 'byor dag darda mthun pa ste/ /dbyar ni gangs dang ri rtse la sogs par/ /sgyug ma 'od ma 'jag khang la sogs par/ /bsil sar bsil khang nang du bsgom par bya/ /ston ni nags khrod ri ngogs brag rjong sogs/ /bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas dang khang bu ru/ /zas gos skyod lam de dang mabun par bya/ /dgun ni nags khrod brag sug sa khang sogs/ /dma' ba'i gnas dang dro ba'i sa phyogs su/ /zas gos mal cha la sogs rjes mazun bya/ /dasnyid ni ri dang nags 'dab mtsho gling dang / /bsil drod snyoms par rjes mabun khang pa ru/ /zas gos spyod lam mthun pa shin tu gces/ /ji nang rten 'brel gcig pas de yi phyir/ /yid 'ong dben la nyams dga'i gnas la brten//ri rtse shes pa dngas la rgya che bas/ /gying ba gseng ba'i gnas te bskyed rim shis/ /gangs khrod ting 'dzin gsal zhing rig pa dngas/ /lhag mthong bsgom pa'i gnas yin bar chad nyung / /nags khrod shes pa gnas shing sems gnas skye/ /zhi gnas bsgom pa'i gnas te bde shas che/ /brag ri'i drung ni mi rtag skyo shas che/ /dngas la gyin che zhi lhag zung 'brel 'grub/ /chu bo'i 'gram ni blo sna thung ba ste/ /nges 'byung 'phral la gsar du skye bar byed/ /dur khrod gyin che dngos grub myur ba ste/ /bskyed rdzogs gang la'ang mchog tu shis par gsungs/ /grong dang tshong dus khang stong shing gcig sogs/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po rgyu ba ni/ /las dang po la g.yeng zhing bar du gcod/ /brtan pa rnams la grogs te mchog tu bsngags/ /lha khang mchod rten rgyal 'gong gnas sa ni/ /sems 'tshubs zhe sdang rtog tshogs skye ba ste/ /sa sug la sogs babeen mo'i gnas rnams su/ /'dod chags skye zhing bying rgod lhag par che/ /shing gcig la sogs ma mo mkha' 'gro dang / brag dang ri sna dmu btsan the'u rang gnas/ /sems 'tshubs rkyen dang bar chad mang par 'dod/ /gdol pa klu gnyan sa bdag gnas sa ni/ /mtsho 'gram rna'u gseng nags khrod la sogs te//yid dga' the tog tsān shing brgyan pa ni/ /dang por dga' yang jis nas bar chad mang / /mdonee na

gnas khang dang po nyams dga' la/ /'dris shing mi dga' dngos grub chung ba'i gnas/ /dang po 'jigs la mi dga' 'dris shing dga'/ /byin che dngos spub che la bar chad med/ /de las gzhan kun bar ma phan gnod med/ /gnas la brten nas nang gi sems 'gyur zhing / /dge ba'i sbyor ba 'phel 'grib gnyis yod pas/ /sa gnas brtag pa shin tu gces par gsungs/ /de yang bsdu na las bzhi'i gnas kyang bzhi/ /zhi gnas yid ni lhan gyis 'dzin pa ste/ /rgyas gnas yid dga' gzi bajid mdangs dang ldan/ /dbang gnas yid 'phrog chags dang ldan pa ste/ /drag gnas sems tsub 'jigs dngangs skye bar byed/ /dbye ba rnam pa grangs mang mtha' las 'das/ /'dir ni ting 'dzin zhi ba'i gnas mchog ste/ /gzhan rnams yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /zhi ba'i gnas der bsam gtan khang bu yang / /dbeen la yid 'dzin bkod par 'tshams pa ste/ /phyogs phyed mthongs gsal che ba rab tu shis/ /mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor mun tsāng 'khor ma ste/ /mtho sar 'khor khang dbus su lte ba'i tshul/ /byang du sngas gtad mya ngan 'das gzims bzhin/ /nyin mo'i gnas ni snang ba'i rnal 'byor ba/ /gangs dang chu 'bab nags dngayul la sogs/ /khyams kyi mthongs gsal che zhing nam mkha' yangs/ /sems gsal dngas la bsil drod snyoms par bya/ /zhi gnas dus su dben khang ra bas bskor/ /ngang gis sems gnas skye ba'i gnas shis la/ /lhag mthong dus su mthongs gsal dngas pa gces/ rgyun du yid dga' dus dang mthun pa gces/ /nags rong la sogs dma' zhing 'thibs pa ni/ /zhi gnas gnas yin gangs sogs mtho sa nyid/ /lhag mthong gnas yin bye brag shes pa gces/ /mdor na sa phyogs dang ni dben khang nyid/ /gang du nges 'byung skyo shas blo sna thung / /ting 'dzin 'phel la dge la sbyor ba'i gnas/ /snying bo byang chub gnas dang mtshungs pas bstan/ /gang du gnas pas dge 'grib nyon mongs 'phel/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi tshe 'di'i dbang gyur na/ /las ngan bdud kyi gnas te mkhas pas spang / /'di dag rang byung padmas gsungs pa'i phyir/ /thar ba 'dod pa dag gis shes par bya/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso las/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i sa phyogs bstan pa ste gnas dang po'o/ /gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i gang zag kyang / /dad brtson nges 'byung skyo shas dang ldan zhing / /'khor bas skyo ngal thar ba don du gnyer/ /tshe 'di blos btang phyi ma'i byang chub 'dod/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi rgyang bsrings nyon mongs chung / /khong yangs spro ring dag snang mos gus che/ /bstan la sri zhur ldan pa de dag gis/ /dam pa'i bla ma rab tu mnyes byas te//thos bsam bsgom pas rang gi sems sbyong zhing / /khyad par snyan rgyud snying po'i man ngag la/ /brtson la yun ring sgrub pas nyin mtshan 'da'/ /tha mal phyogs su skad cig ma yengs par/ /yang zab snying ngo 'i don la nan tan bya/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dang rig pa 'dzin/ /sdom pa gsum po dag dang ma 'acigal bas/ /rang rgyud sdom zhing gzhan phan ci 'grub dang / /ci snang thar pa'i lam du bsgyur bar bya/ /las dang po yis gtso bor rang don sgrub/ /dben par sems bzung rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi btang / /rkyen ngan spang zhing gnyen pos nyon mongs 'dul/ /lta spyod ma 'dzol sgom pa kur blang zhing / /dug lnga rang rgyud gang skyes skatwe cig la/ /dran pas gzung zhing ma yengs gnyen po bsten/ /sgo gsum bag yod shes bzhin ngo tsha shes//

khril yod ldan pas rang rgyud gdul bar bya/ /bstod smad dgag sgrub snyan dang mi snyan la/ /sgyu ma rmi lam bden med mgo snyoms bya/ /brag ca'i sgra ltar rjes mthun bzod pa bsgom/ /nga bdag 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rtsa ba bcad/ /mdor na ci byed chos dang mi 'gal bas/ /rang gi rgyud bldams gzhan la mi gnod cing / /nyon mongs phyogs su skad cig ma song bar/ /nyin mtshan dge bas 'da' ba shin tu gces/ /ding sang dus na skye bo mi bsrun pas/ /dben sar rang don sgrub pa shin tu gces/ /'dab gshog ma rdzogs 'phur bar mi nus ltar/ /mngon shes mi ldan gzhan don mi nus pas/ /rang don lhur blangs yid kyis gzhan don bsam/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bdud kyi bslu brid 'dis/ /rang sems ma bslus sgrub la 'bad pa gces/ /'chi dus 'gyod pas gdung bar ma byed cig /de bas da lta sems la ser btab ste/ /da lta 'chi na khyer so ci 'dug ltos/ /gar 'gro cir 'gyur gtad so ma zin par/ /rnam g.yeng 'khrul pas nyin mtshan 'da' ba 'di/ /dal 'byor don med chud zos byed pas na/ /gcig pur dben par snying po'i don bsgoms shing / /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res legs dgos so/ /phyi nas gar 'gro bdag la cha yod dam/de bas de ring nyid du brtson par bya/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang 'dra/ /'di las thar thabs dgos so sems la zung / /da res 'khrul na gtan tu 'khrul bar 'khyams/ /de bas brtson pa skyed cig snying la zhog /nyon mongs rgya mtsho bdag 'dzin brgal dka'i mtsho/ /dal 'byor spu bos da res brgal bar bya/ /thar lam byang chub brgya lam res 'ga' zhig /bsod nams dbang gis snang ba'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas phan bde bsgrub par bya/ /tshe yang mi rtag skad cig 'gyur ba ste/ /rnam g.yeng bslu mkhas phyi bshol dge la byed/ /'khrul pa rgyun ring goms pa brtan pas na/ /nyon mongs phyogs ni skad cig ngang gis 'dud/ /bsod nams dge la 'bad kyang 'byung dka' bas/ /las kyi gdung shugs bzlog la 'bad pa gces/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba cung zad med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal bsams na bzod glags med/ /'di las thar thabs da res brtsam par bya/ /snying nas snying po'i don la ma 'bad na/ /dal khom res 'ga'i chos kyis phan mi thogs/ /de bas mi rtag skyo shas cher bskyed de/ /skad cig ma yengs sgrub la brtson 'aspus bskyed/ /de ltar dang po nyid du rtogs byas na/ /phyis nas 'phags pa'i go 'phang myur du 'thob/ /rang don 'grub cing gzhan don ngang gis 'byung / /'khor ba'i gnas las thar pa'i lam mchog rnyed/ /de phyir ci byed chos dang bstun pa ni/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso las/ /gang gis bsgoms pa'i gang zag bstan pa ste gnas gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa nyams su blang bya'i chos la gsum/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bstan pa/ /mi rtag skyo shas spyi yi sngon 'gro ste/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa gting nas zlog par byed/ /snying rjes sems bskyed bye brag sngon 'gro ste/ /theg chen lam du chos rnams 'gro bar byed//de phyir thog mar sngon 'gro rnam gnyis sbyong / /de rjes khyad par mchog gi sngon 'gro ni/ /dbang rdzogs thob nas bskyed pa rim gnyis te/ /rang lus lha dang snod bcud lhar gsal bas/ /tha mal 'dzin pa'i zhen pa zlog par byed/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yis/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa shuṭwāṃs

las 'char/ /bar chad kun sel dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /de phyir de rjes sngon 'gro mchog gnyis bsgom/ /de ltar sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bzhi yis/ /ma nor lam du sems nyid tshud pa dang / /thar lam mchog zin gnas lugs myur du skye/ /dngos gzhi 'byongs sla bar chad med pa dang / /dngos grub nye sogs yon tan tshad med ldan/ /de phyir sdon 'gro 'phyongs ba shin tu gces/ /dngos gzhi'i rnam pa'ang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i/ /bsam gtan thabs las gnas lugs ngo sprod de/ /'od gsal spros dang bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa 'char ba yin/ /dang po bde chen thabs la ngo sprod pa/ /de yang sngon 'gro sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i rjes/ /'khor lo bzhi dbus rtsa gsum ka ba'i tshul/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mjing sbubs ma can/ /yar sna tshangs bug mar sna gsang gnas te/ /lte ba'i thad drang dbu ma'i nang a las/ /me 'bar spyi bo'i ha las bdud rtsi bab/ /'khor lo bzhi dang lus nang kun gang ste/ /bde bas khyab dus snying gar bo yig la/ /haṃ gi bdud rtsi rgyun chad med par 'bab/ /bde ba'i nyams ni ma skyes bar du bsgom/ /de nas tpa yang je chung je phra las/ /dmigs bsam spros dang bral ba'i ngang du gzhag /thabs des sems zin bde bas zhi gnas skye/ /de nas gang yang brjod las 'das pa'i sems/ /blo bral nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ngang nyid 'char/ /de ni 'od gsal bde stong rdzogs pa che/ /dngas shing bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid yin/ /de nyid goms las nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /gang snang thams cad bde bar 'char ba dang / /nyin mtshan bde ba'i ngang las 'bral mi phod/ /chags ldang la sogs zug zus rgyud mi 'khrugs/ /chos kyi tshig rdan rtogs pa'i shes rab skye/ /de nas yang bsgoms spyan dang mngon shes sogs/ /yon tan dpag med nyi ma sems la 'char/ /'di ni yang zab gnad kyi gdams pa yin/ /gnyis pa gsal ba'i thabs kyi ngo srud pa/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin rtsa gsum gsal btab pa'i/ /ro rkyang gug pa dbu mar 'jug pa'i tshul/ /mar snar bsgoms la yar snar sna bug gtad/ /rlung ro gsum bus nad gdon sdig sgrib song / /dal bus tshur jubs brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten kun/ /'od zhu sna nas tshur byung ro rkyang nas/ /dbu ma'i nang byung snying dbus tshon gang 'od/ gong bu la thim zub thang bar du gzung /steng 'og kha sbyar gtong dus cung zad gzung / /dal bus 'byusda grubs bya ba shin tu gces/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas la sogs yon tan kun/ /snying gar thim las gzhan du ma yengs bya/ /thabs des sems gsal dngas la gnas pa 'byung / /de rjes snying ga'i 'od las 'od mched de/ /lus nang 'khor lo bzhi nang 'bar ba las/ /phyir mched 'jig rten 'od kyis gang bar bsgom/ /zhag 'gar nyin mtshan de nyid don bsgoms pas/ /rmilam 'gag dang 'od kyi snang ba ni/ /zla ba 'bar ba me khyer skar ma sogs/ /'od lnga'i snang bas phyi nang khyab pa mthong / /gsal ba'i ngang du sems zin zhi gnas skye/ /de nas sgar bsdu snying ga'i 'od de yang/ /je chung je phrar stong nyid ngang la gzhag /gang du'ang mi dmigs stong gsal dngas pa'i sems/ /rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba 'char/ /de ni gsal stong gnyug ma'i ye shes te/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /de nyid goms las nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi//garwa snang 'al 'ol zang thal gsal ba snyam/ /nyin mtshan gsal ba'i ngang la gnas pa dang / /rnam rtog mi

gatsha mas gsal dngas pa dang / /shes rab klong rdol gzung 'dzin bral ba'o/ /de yang goms las mngon shes 'char ba dang / /sgrib pas chod kyang pha rol zang thal sogs/ /mthong ba'i spyan dang rdzu 'phrul 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni yang zab gdams pa'i nying khu yin/ /gsum pa mi rtog thabs kyis ngo sprad nas/ /sngon 'gro jir bzhin dngos gzhi rnam pa gsum/ /'phang ba gzung ba sbyang ba'i rim pa las/ /'phang ba snying gar sems nyid 'od gsal ba/ /ha'am 'od kyi gong bu tshon gang zhig /ha zhes nyer gcig ngar dang bcas brjod pas/ /rgyangs kyis spyi gtsug nas 'thon mkha' la song je mtho je mazor mthar ni bltar med pa'i/ /ngang du lus sems khong glod mnyam par gzhag /skad cig de la rnam rtog rgyun chad de/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i ngang la gnas/ /nyams kyang bltar med bsam yul 'das pa 'byung / /gzung ba nyi ma'i ngos la rgyab gtad de/ /dngas pa'i mkha' la mig gtad lhan der gzhag /rlung rgyu mi chor ci nas dal bar bya/ /mi rtog spros dang bral ba khong nas 'char/ /rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams skye'o/ /sbyang ba mkha' la mig gtad ma yengs par/ /sems gsal spro bsdu med pa'i ngang de nas/ /sa rdo ri brag snod bcud thams cad kyang / /zang thal nam mkha' gcig tu song bar bsgom/ /rang gi lus kyang rags pa'i dngos med de/ /sems dang nam mkha' dbyer med ngang du gzhag /phyi nang bar gsum rnam dbye med pa'i chos/ /nam mkha'i ngang der lus sems khong glod la/ /dran bsam yid la byed pa rang zhi'i ngang / /spro bsdu med pa'i sems nyid rang sor gzhag /de tshe chos nyid bsam brjod 'das pa'i sems/ /gnyis med nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa 'char/ /'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i snying po yin/ /de ltar bsgoms pas nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /gang snang phyam phyam rags pa'i 'du shes med/ /nyin mtshan mi rtog ngang las 'bral mi phod/ /dug lnga rang zhi sems rgyud 'jam la des/ /chos kun nam mkha' 'du ba'i nyams myong skye/ /de ltar mi rtog gsum la goms pa yis/ /spyan dang mngon shes ting 'dzin yon tan 'grub/ /thabs dang shes rab zhi lhag zung 'brel bas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ /gsum pa rjes kyi chos la rnam pa bzhi/ /nyams dang bogs 'byin rtogs pa 'bras bu'o/ /nyams la gnyis las skyon med sngar bstan la/ /skyon can so so'i 'dzin zhen las byung ba/ /bde chags gsal chags mi rtog chags pa dang / /mthar 'dzin zhen rtog dug dang 'dres pa gsum/ /bde log khams 'dzag 'dod chags rang ga dang / /snying mi dga' dang bying ba shas che dang / /gsal log rlung rgod zhe sdang rang ga dang / /rnam rtog rags dang rgod dang 'phro shas che/ /mi rtog log pa gti mug rang ga dang /sems bying gnyid mugs che dang 'du shes med/ /de ltar mthun dang log pa'i skyon can rnams/ /gang byung ngos gzung gnyen pos bcos par bya/ /bogs 'byin nyams bcos thabs dang gong du spel/ /nyams bcos pa yang rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /rab kyis lta pas bcos te chos rnams kun/ /blo btags sgyu 'dra ngo bo nges gzung med/ /phyam gcig mkha' 'dra snyems bral rang ngos stong/ /'dzin zhen med pa'i ngang der la bzla'o/ /gol sgrib nyams de gnas lugs chen por 'char/ /bar chad dge bskul rkyen ngan byang chub grogs/ /gzhi bde'i steng du blo bde rgyun mi 'chad/ /'bring gis sgom bas bcos te dngas rgyung la/ /༷sa

pa 'gyur la thebs shing dran pas gzung / /ma yengs bde gsal mi rtog ngang la gzhag /yengs dang 'jur la ma thebs skyon yin pas/ /skad cig ma yengs ngang la gzhag pa gces/ /khams 'dzag pa la rdo rje'i bum pa ru/ /rgyu las me 'bar lus nang khams kun bsreg/ /ci yang med pa'i ngang la bsgoms pas sel/ /nad 'dzag gdon 'dzag gang la'ang gnad 'di zab/ /bde la 'dzin pa bshig nas stong par bsgoms/ /'dod chags rang ga'i sems la cher bltas te/ /bcos bslad re dogs med pa'i ngang bzhag pas/ /'dod chags rang grol bde stong ye shes 'char/ /snying mi dga' ba thig le nyams pa'i skyon/ /de la 'bar 'dzag bde ba'i bsam gtan bsgom/ /bying shas che na dngas snyigs ma byed skyon/ /de la lus gnad drang por 'dug byas la/ /kha sbyar rlung bzung snying nang 'od kyis khengs/ /snang srid 'od khengs gsal stong bsgoms pas grol/ /gsal 'dzin nyams la 'dzin med chen por sbyang / /gsal log mugs na dngas gsal sems bsgom zhing / /rgod cing 'phro na mig btsums snying nang du/ /'od dang yi ge padma ral gri'am/ /rgya gram bsgoms pa je dma' je dma' las/ /snying gi nang nas lung thag je ring song / /'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhir bab par bsgom/ /des ni mi sel mi srid nges pa'i gnad/ /zhe ldang rang ga 'phros thog tsan ne gzhag /gsal stong me long ye shes ngang du grol/ /mi rtog ngang 'char 'dzin med gnad kyis sbyang //gti mug sems de ngos gzung cer gyis brtag /skad cig rang grol chos dbyings ye shes 'char/ /bying zhing mugs te 'du shes med pa na/ /snying nang 'od bsgoms tshangs bug nas 'thon te/ /gzhu gang tsam gyi nam mkhar lding nge gnas/ /'di ni yang zab gnang kyi gdams pa yin/ /spyir ni gang la'ang 'dzin med gnad du che/ /re dogs bral na gegs rnams kun las grol/ /stong gsal sems nyid dngas pa'i ngang nyid du/ /blo yi rnam pa spro bsdu med par gzhag /gegs dang spang bya'i 'phrang las grol bar nges/ /tha mas spyod pas bcos pa'i rim pa yang / /lta stangs rdzas dang rten 'brel gsum nyid las/ /spyi yi lta stangs rnam snang chos bdun te/ /skyil krung mig mi 'gul dang rlung dal dang / /mnyam gzhag mgrin pa gug dang rtse rtse rkan/ /sna rtser mig phab blta bas rlung sems snyoms/ /bying rgod med cing ma nor bsam gtan skye/ /'di ltar skyon kun lus gnad 'khrugs pa yis/ /rtsa 'khrugs rlung 'khrugs thig le 'khrugs pa las/ /'byung bas ma dkrugs mnyam par gzhag pa gces/ /yon tan yang ni rtsa thig rlung gsum nyid/ /mi g.yo gnad du song las 'byung bas na/ /de phyir gnad 'di rtogs pa rab tu gces/ /'khrul 'khor lus stong gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ /khyad par dal 'jam ma 'khrugs gnad du che/ /'jam la rtsub dang tsub la 'jam pa gnad/ /khams dang bstun pa shin tugaces pa yin/ /bye brag bde la lag pa gru mor bsnol/ /mig phab bde la sems gzung gnad yin no/ /gsal la lag gnyis pus mo'i steng du dgab/ /rlung dal mig ni bar snang har por blta/ /mi rtog chos bdun rang gar gnas pas 'grub/ /rdzas ni dus dang mthun pa'i gnas dang grogs/ /bza' btung la sogs nyams la gang phan bsten/ /rten 'brel khams 'dzag pa la gzhon nu mas/ /bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril sngags bzlas te/ / sked par btags pas thig le bsrung ba yi// /rtog pa 'phro na tsandan ge sar dang / /zhun chen ril bu bsten pas mi rtog 'grub/ /zugs na gur

gum ga bur byang chub sems/ /ril bus ting 'dzin 'grub par rgyud las gsung / /bde gsal mi rtog skyon med gong 'phel ba/ /dmigs pa gang rung sems bzung mchog du bsngags/ /dang por dmigs yul la gtad bsgoms pa yis/ /de rjes dmigs med ngang du lhan gyis 'gro/ /gnad 'di shin tu yang zab mchog yin pas/ /skal ldan rnams kyis dang du blang bar bya/ /mtshan bcas yin zhes spang ba blun po'i lam/ /nyams myong med pa'i lugs yin dor bar bya/ /khyad par bde ba'i bogs 'byin dam pa ni/ /'og rlung 'then la gsang ba'i gnas nyid nas/ /thig le yar thim spyi gtsug nyid du thim/ /gang yang dmigs med ngang la gzhag par bya/ /de rjes steng 'og kha sbyar rlung bzung la/ /snying gar sems gtad skye med ngang la gzhag / bde gsal spros bral ngang la gnas pa yin/ /bar bar seng ge rtsal sprugs la sogs pa/ /dbab bzlog drang zhing dgra mdang la bzla ba'i/ /'khrul 'khor dmigs gnad mthong ba brgyud bzhin bya//dbab pa 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya nyid dang ni/ /ro stod smad gsigs gnon pa lta bur bya/ /dmigs pa haṃ las byang sems babs pa yis/ /gsang bar byung dus bde la dmigs pa gtad/ /bablog pa de nas gyen du drangs ba ste/ /lag gnyis mkhal khung rgya mtsho brag la sbyar/ /'og rlung 'then la lce rtse rkan la sbyor/ /mig sprin bzlog cing mgo bsgril 'dar ba bzhin/ /dmigs pa thig le ba thag rgyus pa bzhin/ /gcig la gcig thim spyi gtsug bar du bsam/ /dgram pa gzhu 'gengs rkang lag rtsal sprugs bya/ /si zhes rtse rtse so sbyar rlung phyir 'bud/ /la bzla gan rkyal rlung sems sos dal la/ /gar yang mi rtog cir yang mi 'dzin pas/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i ngang la gzhag /'di yis gegs med bde chen byang chub 'grub/ /gsal ba rlung gi bogs 'byin dam pa yang / /'jam rtsub gcig gis gcig la bogs 'byin la/ /khyad par nang bzung phyir bzung gcig gis gcig /dal 'jam phan tshun gnad dang bsre ba gces/ /grangs dang kha dog reg bya dbyibs la sogs/ /du ma'i thabs la bslab pa'ang gsungs mod kyi/ /'dir ni gcig gis kun 'grub man ngag la/ /'di ltar bslab pa gnad kyi rgyal bo yin/ /lus gnad khyad par sngar bzhin lus mi 'gul/ /rlung ni kha sna gsum mnyam shin tu dal/ /tha mal rang grol ngang la lhan gyis glod/ /sems gnad gang du'ang mi gzung rang bzhin bya/ /de rjes gan rkyal rkang lag brgyad byas te/ /ha zhes drag la sems ni mkha' dkyil gtad/ /yeng med spro bsdu bral ba lhan der gzhag /rlung sems rang grol gdod ma'i ngang gnas pa/ /gegs med yon tan 'char sgo dpag tu med/ /lus yang rgyu ba med dang spro ba zhi/ /sems gsal rab tu dngas shing mngon shes 'char/ /rkang mgyogs 'grub cing mdog sdum ting 'dzin skye/ /rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i rtags rnams 'byung / /yang zab gnad kyi mchog yin shin tu gsang / /mi rtog nam mkha' lha bu'i bogs 'byin yang / /lus sems khong glod dmigs pa rtse gcig bzung / /gcig la ma yengs cer re bltas pa yis/ /rnam rtog gzhan rnams de yi ngang nub ste/ /dmigs rten de la rtog pa'ang rab zhi nas/ /snang la der 'dzin med pa'i rtogs pa 'char/ /'di ni gnad yin gzhan yang 'di ltar bslab/ res 'ga' dmigs pa phyir bzung rlung phu la/ phyi ru ci gnas gzhag pas mi rtog skye res 'ga' nang bzung stod smad gang rung du/ /dgigs rten gcig la ma yengs tsen de gzha/ /

res 'gal rten med shes pa rang zhir gzhag /yul snang der 'dzin med pa'i ngang la gnas/ /'di ni mi rtog chos sku'i dgongs pa ste/ /gnad la brten nas rang byung khong nas 'char/ /bde gsal mi rtog spyi yi bogs 'byin ni/ /tshogs bsag sgrib spyong bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa dang / /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog tu bsngags/ /'di ni mthar thug gnad kyi gdams pa ste/ /skal bzang thar pa 'dod pas dang du blang / de ltar bsgoms pas shar ba'i rtogs pa yang / /ro mnyam gcig ste tha dad du ma med/ /phyogs gsum gcig tu 'du ba'i don sa dang / /chu bran tha dad rgya mtshor gcig pa ltar/ /bde gsal mi rtog thabs gsum gang bsgoms spyang / /sems nyid ma skyes nam mkha'i ngang nyid du/ /blo yi 'jug pa rab zhi jim pa na/ /yod med kros dang bral ba'i byang chub sems/ /'od gsal gshis kyi nyi ma khong nas 'char/ /spub bsal 'apo 'gyur med pa'i rtogs pa ste/ /mkha' mnyam bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin no/ /de tshe rtse gcig dngas gsal rnyog med pa/ /zhi lhag spangs pa'i bsam gtan rgya mtsho la/ /phyogs bral 'dzin med gzugs brnyan rang bzhin med/ /chos kun rtogs pa'i ngo bo zung du 'brel/ /snang ba sgyu 'dra stong pa der 'dzin med/ /zung 'jug dbyer med dgongs klong yangs pa ni/ /gnad las byung ba'i 'od gsal khong nas 'char/ /bla ma'i gyin rlabs rang byung ye shes ni/ /tshig dang bsam brjod 'das tshe mthong ba ste//de lta bu nyid dus su mthong ba ni/ /dus gsum dus med phyi nang dbye gsal med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin yin dbu ma ste/ /spros dang sdug bsngal zhi gyed phyag rgya che/ /snying po'i chos nyid rdzogs pa chen po ste/ /gdod ma'i zad pa gshis kyi gnas lugs nyid/ /'od gsal sems nyid rang byung ye shes yin/ /ming mang btags kyang don gyi ngo bo gcig /sems nyid smra bsam brjod 'das byang chub sems/ /'khor 'das gnyis med nam mkha' lta bu yin/ /phyogs ris ma 'dzin grub mtha'i gzeb las 'das/ /phyogs bral gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen po ste/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma 'a bral klong yangs su/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis yongs su shes par bya/ /de dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rim pa ni/ /gnas skabs bde gsal mi rtog zung 'jug gis/ /spyan dang mngon shesta yon tan dpag mid cing / /mthar bug sku gsum yid bzhin rgyal chos 'grub/ /rang bzhin don gnyis lhun gyis spub pa yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso las/ /gang bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ste gnas gsum pa'o// //de ltar chos tshul zhi ba snying po'i don/ /zab cing rgya che bshad pa'i bsod nams des/ /'gro kun byang chub dam pa gnyis thob nas/ /yid bzhin 'azin las 'byor ba mtha' yas shog /'di sgru rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /rang gi nyams len gnad dril bcud bsdus te/ /phyi rabs don du gsal bar bshad pa ni/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /thar ba 'dod pa dag gis brtson byas te/ /yi ge 'di bzhin nyams su blang bar mdzod/ /gnas skabs mthar bug don gnyis phun tshogs te/ /bde chen gling du myur du dga' bde byed/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du legs par bkod pa rdzogs so// // dge'o// dge'o// dge'o//8

gzha /rjogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i bsdus don pyaṇḍa lbi ka'i dzreng ba zhes bya ba ba'ugs so//dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i gnas rgya cher bshad pa la gsum ste/ /bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i rgyu/ /'jug yul bstan bcos kyi lus/ /bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ skad gnyis shan sbyar ba/ /mtshan gyi don/ mdo dang / rgyas pa'i phyag gi don/ brtsam par dam bca' bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/lus rnam par gzhag pa dang / yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ dang po la gnyis te/ gnas gsum bstan bcos kyi lus la 'jug par gdams pa dang / 'jug yul lus kyi sdom rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /gnyis pa min lag rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ gang du nyams su len pa'i gnas/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag /gang nyams su blang ba'i chos rgya cher bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gnas kyi rim pa brtag pa/ spyor bsam gtan gyi khang bu bya ba gye brag tu bshad pa/ de gnyis ka'i don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dus bzhi gnas kyi rim pa/ so so gnas kyi rang bzhin/ las bzhi gnas kyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ dbyar dgun/ dpyid kyi rgyas par bshad pa don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ so so'i bye brag bstan pa dang / blang dor gyi dmigs dbye ba'o/ dang po la bcu gcig ste/ ri rtse/ gangs khrod/ nags khrod/ brag ri/ chu 'gram/ dur khrod/ grong 'dabs/ lha khang / sa sug shing gcig /mtsho 'gram gyi rang bzhin bstan pas nang gi sems kyi 'char tshul bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa blang dor gyi dmigs dbye ba la gsum ste/ dor bya/ blang bya/ bar ma'i rang bzhin no/ /gsum pa la gzhi gnas kyi khyad par la gsum ste/ gnas brtag pa'i dgos ched la spyir gdams pa/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi bye brag tu bshad pa/ skabs kyi don ngos gzung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la bsam gtan gyi khang bu bya ba la gsum ste/ bsam gtan gyi khang bu spyi'i rang bzhin/ /ma mo dang nyin mo rnal 'byor gyi gye brag gi rang bzhin/ /nye 'khor gyi rang bzhin no/ /de la gsum ste/ zhi lhag so so'i sgrub dus/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyis sgrub dus/ /bye brag shes pas bstan pa'i nye 'khor gyi rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa don bsdu ba la gsum ste/ bstan bya snying po byang chub kyi gnas/ spang bya las ngan bdud kyi gnas/ yid ches dgod pa lung gi gnas rgya cher bstan pa'o/ /gnas dang po'i bsdus don no/ don gnyis pa gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag gi gnas bstan pa la gsum ste/ gang zag gi gnas la spyir gdams/ sgrub tshul gyi gnas la bye brag tu gdams/ bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rgya cher bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/gang zag gi gdams pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa/ mtshan nyid can des bsgrub par gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa la drug ste/ gzhi rten bslab gsum la gdams pa/ dben par rang don la bskul ba/ nyon mongs gnyen pos 'dul ba/ ngo tsha khrel yod bsten pa/ grag stong bzod pa bsgom pa/ ci gyed chos la brdon

par bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa la bco lnga ste/ /dus ngan skye bo dang 'grogs par mi bzod pa/ /mngon shes med par gzhan don 'grub dka' ba/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis sgrub pa bslu ba/ 'chi dus bstongs pa'i 'khyer so ci 'dug /da res legs pa'i 'dun ma bsam pa/ phyi ma'i sa zin da lta dgos pa/ 'khor ba'i gnas las thar thabs dgos pa/ ma 'khrul don gyi btsan sa gzung ba/ dal 'byor gru bos srid mtsho brgal ba/ thar lam zhugs nas 'bad pa 'don pa/ skyo shas skye ba'i yul la bsam pa/ /las kyi rlung shugs cis kyang bzlog pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med par bsam pa/ dal khom med par brtson 'aspus bskyed pa/ chos la bsam pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ thar lam bsgrub pa'i gang zag la bsams te bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dgod pa'o/ /gnas gnyis pa'i bsdus don no/ /don gsum pa gang nyams su blang bya'i chos rgya cher bstan pa la gnyis te/ sgom pa mdor bstan pa dang / sde tshan rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dngos dang / de'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ /spyi'i sngon 'gro/bye brag gi sngon 'gro/ lus lhar bskyed pa/ spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas khyad par mchog gi sngon 'gro dgos pa dang bcas pa bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ bde ba/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa'i thabs la ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rtsa gsum gsal btab/ gtum mo'i mes byang chub kyi sems bzhu/ bde chen la sems gzung / phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa dang bzhis bde ba'i thabs bsgom pa/ thabs las thob pa'i 'od gsal bstan pa/ de las nyams kyi skye tshul bstan pa/ goms pas thob pa'i yon tan bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsal ba'i thabs la lnga ste/ rtsa gsal ba/ rlung sems gzung ba/ yon tan bsdu ba/ 'od snang bsgom pa/rtags tshad bstan pa dang lnga gsal ba'i thabs bsgom pa/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor/ ye shes dngos kyi thabs las thob pa'i 'od gsal/ de las nyams kyi skye tshul/ goms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /gsum pa mi rtog pa'i thabs la lnga ste/ ngo bo mdor bstan/ bsgom tshul rgyas par bshad/ 'od gsal ngos gzung / nyams kyi skye tshul bstan/ yon tan 'grub tshul brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ thabs kyis 'phang / ngang la glod/ bsam brjod bral bas 'phang ba/ rang dal gzhag /spros bral dag pas gzung ba/ sdod bcud sbyang / ngang la gzhag /lus sems glod/ dran bsam dag pas sbyang ba'o/ /don gsum pa rjes la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la bzhi ste/nyams bogs 'byin/ rtogs pa/ 'bras bu/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'brel pa gsum gyi ngo bo spyir bstan/ bde log /gsal log /mi rtog pa log pa gsum gyi rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad/bcos thabs nges pas don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa bogs 'byin pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang / rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis te/ nyams kyi bcos thabs dang / bogs 'byin dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rab lta bas bcos pa/ 'gring sgom pas bcos pa/ tha ma spyod pas bcos pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ye stong snyems bral du la bzla ba dang / gol sgrib chos nyid kyi rol 10

par rang shar ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gnad kyi ngo bo mdor bstan/ rnam pa rgyas par bshad/'dzin med chen por don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bde ba gsal ba/ mi rtog pa'i nyams skyon can bcos pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ khams 'dzag pa bsung ba/ 'dod chags 'dzin rtog gzung ba/'bar 'dzag gi ting nge 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rig pa dngas snyigs dbye ba/ 'dzin med gsal dngas 'don pa/ 'phro rgod brtan par bya ba/ zhe sdang 'dzin rtog sbyong ba'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/rtog med dbyings su dag pa dang / bying thugs dgra bo gzhom pa'o/ /gsum pa 'dzin med du don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ re dogs 'dzin pa gzhom pa dang / de'i ngang la gzhag tshul lo/ /gsum pa tha mas spyod pas bcos pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ lta stangs/ sdas/rten 'brel lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ chos bdun gyi rang bzhin/ lus gnad 'khrugs pa'i skyon/ ma 'khrugs pa'i yon tan/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad kyis sbyir bstan pa dang / bde ba/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa'i lus gnad kyis bye brag gi lta stangs bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa rten 'brel la gsum ste/ khams baspung /'phro rgod bsdu ba/ bying mugs bsal ba'i rten 'brel lo/ /gnyis pa bogs 'byin dngos la gnyis te/bogs 'byin gyi gnas la gdams gnad bstan/ log rtog dgag pas gnas mdor bstan pa dang / so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis te/ so so dang spyi'i bogs 'byin rna/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bde ba/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa'i bogs 'byin no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngas ma chos nyid kyi klong du sba ba dang / rlung sems skye med du sbra bas bde chen 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo bstan pa dang /chings lnga mdor bstan pa dang / dbab/ bzlog /dgram/ la bzla ba'i gnas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsal ba'i bogs 'byin pa la lnga ste/ ngo bo'i gnas spyir bstan/ khyad par gyi gnad bye brag tu gdams/ gnad mchog rgyal po'i man ngag dngos bstan/ thabs kyi yan lag rgya cher brjod/ goms pas thob pa'i yon tan la bsngags pa'o/ /gsum pa mi rtog pa'i bogs 'byin la bzhi ste/ gtso bo'i gnad/ cha shas kyi gnad/ phra mo'i gnad/ chos nyid kyi gnad bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa spyi'i bogs 'byin pa la gnyis te/ bogs 'byin dngos dang / de'i gnas la gdams pa'o/ /gsum pa rtogs pa la dgu ste/ ngo bo ris med mtha' bral/ dpe don thabs gsum don gcig /rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po/ rang dngas rang gsal zung 'jug /yul sems dbyer med zung 'jug /rig stong chos sku rjen pa/ ming don du ma ro gcig /gzhi bral nam mkha' lta bu/ blo 'das chos zad chen por bstan pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'bras bu la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang / mthar thug go/ /gnas gsum pa'i bsdus don no/ /spyi don gsum pa bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba la lnga ste/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/gang gis gang du brtsams pa'i tshul brjod pa/ skal bzang skye bo la gdams pa/ dgos ched smon pa 'grub pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa mtshan gyi don to/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i bsdus don buṇḍarī ka'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang / sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi blo'i padmo 'dzum par byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul 'od zer sprin gyi 11

skyed mos tshal gyi nang kun tu bzang po'i khang bzangs su sbyar ba'o/ //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa ging rta rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba b.lugs/rgya gar skad du/ ma hā sarnyi sgyu na tha tsānta su sboṭī ra tha tha shurtse ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag ces bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin gdod nas nyer zhi spros dang bral ba'i mkha' dbyings la/ /kun gyis spub pa'i sku dang ye shes rang bzhin nye bar mdzes pa gang / /sna tshogs mdzad pa'i 'od stong 'phro bas gdul bya'i zhing gi rjes 'gro ba/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen brtse'i nyi ma kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gis mchod/ /skal bzang skye bo thar pa'i grong khyer du/ gang gi lam nas nges par 'byung pa'i chos/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul dag las/ /shing rta rnam dag 'grel 'di rab gsal bya/ de la bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams thams cad kyi rtse mo ni/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs yin la/ de'i gnas nges par gang zag gcig gis ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i rim pa nges pa ni/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya bar gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ 'dir de'i 'grel pas man ngag gi gnas gsal bar ston pa las/ re zhig dang por phyag 'tshal ba/ gdod ma'i rang bzhin mkha' mnyam dag pa'i dgyings/ chos mchog mi g.yo shin tu spros dang bral/ /'od gsal sems nyid byang chub snying po la/ gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'añtsar med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi ni/ sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes g.yo med spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ste/ ngo bo la dgye bsal thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ stong la go 'byed pa'i nam mkha' lta bu/ gsal la 'grib pa med pa'i nyi zla lta bu/ yon tan lhun gyis spub pa'i nor bu lta bu ste/ 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma spub la gang du'ang 'char ba'i gzhi'am dbyings su gnas pa de la/ rig pa rang ngo shes pas gzhi 'pho 'gyur med pa'i don gyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /kun byed las/ kye ston pa'i bstan pa kun gyed rgyal bo khyod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings/ 'khor ba mi spang bugs rje phyogs ris med/ /ston pa kun byed rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa dang do ha las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang / rin chen 'phreng ba las/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / mar la mar ni rjes zhugs ltar/ /rang gi rang rig ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /brtsams par dam bca' ba ni/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shin tu rmad byung gang / /so so rang rig ye shes rto/sdu bya'i jir/ /rgyud lung man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus te/ /ji ltar nyams su blangs bzhin bshad

kyis nyon/ /de la so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni/ /man ngag 'di'i brjod bya yin pas/ de'i don rang gis ji ltar nyams su blangs pa ltar phyi rabs kyi don du brjod par bya ste/ don 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sdud pa las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcur gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /zhes so/ /de nyid kyang yum la bstod pa las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /'dir rdzogs pa chen po ston pa la pha rol tu phyin pas ci bya zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid rdzogs pa chen po yin te/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis rig pa'i ngor btags pa de nyid las byung ba'i phyir te/kun gyed las/ kye da ni ma bcos ji bzhin snying bo la/ /sgro 'dogs skur 'debs don las kun 'das te/ /dus gsum rgyal ba nga las byung bas na/ /rgyal ba'i yum zhes nges par bstan pa yin/ zhes so/ /de dag gis phyogs dang po bstan bcos brtsam pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu bstan te/ /da ni lus nyid bshad pa la mdo dang / rgyas par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po man ngag gi lus kyi sdom bsdu bas mdor bstan pa ni/ri rtse nags khrod mtsho gling la sogs pa/ /dus bzhi gnas dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo zhi ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /'od gsal spros dang bral ba bsgom par bya/ /gnas dang gang zag nyams su blang bya'i chos/ /rnam gsum rang bzhin dag las 'grub par 'gyur/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis dus bzhi yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas 'grub par nges pa yang / gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas dang / gang gis bsgrubs pa'i gang zag dang / gang sgrub pa'i chos dang gsum gyis cho ga rdzogs par 'grub pa na rdo rje'i lus rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /da ni de dag gi rim pa rgyas par bshad pa las/ phyogs dang po gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas las/ dus bzhi gnas kyi rim pa bstan pa ni/ dang po gnas ni dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /dus bzhi'i rnal 'byor dag dang mthun pa ste/ /dbyar ni gangs dang ri rtse la sogs par/ /sgyug ma 'od ma 'jag khang la sogs pa/ /bsil sar bsil khang nang du bsgom par bya/ /ston ni nags khrod ri ngogs brag rdzong sogs/ /bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas dang khang bu ru/ /zas gos spyod lam de dang mthun par bya/ /dgun ni nags khrod brag phug sa khang sogs/ /dma' ba'i gnas dang dro ba'i sa phyogs su /zas gos mal cha la sogs rjes mthun bya/ /dpyid ni ri dang nags 'dab mtsho gling sogs/ /bsil drod snyoms par rjes mthun khang pa ru/ /zas gos spyod lam mthun pa shin tu gces/ /'di dag ni slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dus bzhi rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa zab mo las byung ba bzhin te/ dbyar ni me'i dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun dro bas gnas dang spyod lam bsil bar bsten cing / ston ni rlung gi dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun smin pas dngas gsal phyed pa'i gnas dang spyod lam bstan par bya la/ dgun ni chu'i dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun bsil bas gnas dang spyod lam kun dro ba bsten cing / dpyid ni sa'i dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun bskyed par phyogs pas bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas dang spyod lam gces te/ phyi nang rten 13

'brel gyi 'khor lo gnyis su gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /dus 'khor las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de nas gang la shis pa gnas kyi khyad par bstan pa ni/ phyi nang rten 'brel gcig bas de phyir ro/ /yid 'ong dben la nyams dga'i gnas la brten/ /ri rtse shes pa dngas la rgya che bas/ /bying ba gsing ba'i gnas de bskyed rim shis/ /gangs khrod bskyed rim gsal zhing rig pa dngas/ /lhag mthong bsgom pa'i gnas yin bar chad nyung / /nags khrod shes pa gnas shing sems gnas skye/ /zhi gnas bsgom pa'i gnas te bde shas che/ /brag ri'i drung ni mi rtag skyo shas che/ /dngas la byin che zhi lhag zung 'brel 'grub/ /chu bo'i 'gram ni blo sna thung ba ste/ /nges 'byung skyo shas gsar du skye bar byed/ /dur khrod byin che dngos grub myur ba ste/ /bskyed rdzogs gang la'ang mchog tu shis par gsungs/ /gnas 'di dag kyang las dang po pa dang /bar pa dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis ji skad smos pa'i mtshams spyod shes pa bsten na/ lta ba dang sgom pa khyad par can gong 'phel du 'grub ste/ gnas de dag gi yon tan lam 'grub pa'i grogs su shar ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag rang gi nyams dang sbyar te shes par bya ba'i gnas bsten pa ni/ grong dang tshong dus khang stong shing gcig sogs/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po rgyu ba ni/ /las dang po la g.yeng zhing bar du gcod/ /brtan pa rnams la grogs te mchog tu bsngags/ /lha khang mchod rten rgyal 'gong gnas sa ni/ /sems 'tshubs zhe sdang rtog tshogs skye ba ste/ /sa phug la sogs bsen mo'i gnas rnams su/ /'dod chags skye zhing bying rgod lhag par che/ /shing gcig la sogs ma mo mkha' 'gro dang / /brag dang ri sna dmu btsan the'u rang gnas/ /sems 'tshubs rkyen dang bar chad tshomang bar 'dod/ /gdol pa klu gnyan sa bdag gnas pa ni/ mtsho 'gram ne'u gseng nags khrod sman ljongs sogs/ /yid dga' me tog smon shing brgyan pa ni/ /dang po dga' yang phyis nas bar chad mang //de la 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre ma rungs pa gnas pas/ de dag ni rnal 'byor pa nyams brtan nas spyod pa byed pa'i gnas las/ las dang po pa bsgom pa dang rgyun du gnas bcas nas 'dug tu rung ba ni ma yin pas dor bar bya ba kho na'o/ /ltag tu gnas pa ni lha btsan dang / klu sman dang dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i mi ma yin gnas ba'i sar bzang ste/ mthun rkyen 'grub cing 'gal rkyen mi 'byung bar bsrung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas brtag pa ni/ mdor na/ gnas khang dang po nyams dga' la/ /'dris shing mi dga' dngos grub chung ba'i gnas/ /dang por 'jigs la mi dga' 'dris shing dga'/ /byin che dngos grub myur la bar chad med/ /de las gzhan kun bar ma phan gnod med/ /'di ni gnad gal po che ste/ /zla ba phyed du brtags pas shes par nges so/ /de phyir gnas la brten nas nang gi sems 'gyur zhing / /dge ba'i sbyor ba 'phel 'grib gnyis yod pas/ /sa gnas brtags pa shin tu gces par gsungs/ de yang gsang sngags lam rim las/ /gnas kyi mtshan nyid la dge sbyor 'phel ba dang mi 'phel ba gnyis gnyis su yod do zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ /da ni las bzhi gnas kyi rim pa mdor bsdu ba ni/ de yang bsdu na las bzhi'i gnas kyang bzhi/ /zhi gnas yid ni lhan gyis 'dzin pa ste/ /rgyas gnas yid dga' gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan/ /dbang gnas yid 'phrog chags dang ldan pa ste/ /drag 14

gnas sems 'tshubs 'jigs dngangs skye bar byed/ /dbye na rnam grangs dpag med mtha' las 'das/ /'dir ni ting 'dzin zhi ba'i gnas mchog ste/ /gzhan rnams yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /phyi'i yul du snang ba'i gnas rnams kyang phrin las bzhi'i dbyings su gnas pa la/ zhi ba'i gnas ni sems rang bzhin gyis phebs la mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngang gis skye ba'o/ /rgyas pa'i gnas ni sa phyogs gzi brjid che las sems dga' bas g.yeng ba'o/ /dbang gi gnas ni yid la 'dod chags skyed par byed pa'o/ /drag po'i gnas ni 'jigs la bag dro ba ste/ /dbyibs skum po dang / gru bzhi dang / zla gam dang /gru gsum dang / kha dog dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang nag shas che ba ste/ de dag kyang zhi ba'i zhi ba la sogs pa'i dbye na bcu drug las/ yang dbye na dpag tu med de spros pas chog go/ /'dir ni zhi ba'i gnas ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba la brten par gdams pa yin no/ /gnas der bya ba bkod pa'i rim pa ni/ zhi ba'i gnas der bsam gtan khang bu yang / /dben la yid 'dzin bkod par 'tshams pa ste/ /phyogs phyed mthongs gsal che ba rab tu shis/ /del bsam gtan gyi khang bu phyogs phyed la mthongs gsal ba ni ting nge 'dzin ngang gis skye zhing bar chad nyung ba'o/ /khyad par du nyin mtshan gyi dge sbyor tha dad pas de'i gnas bstan pa ni/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor mun khang 'khor ma ste/ /mtho sar 'khor khang nang du lte ba'i tshul/ /byang du sngas gtad mya ngan 'das gzims bzhin/ /nyin mo'i gnas ni snang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gangs dang chu 'bab nags dang yul la sogs/ /khyams kyi mthongs gsal che zhing nam mkha' yangs/ /sems gsal dngas la bsil drod snyoms par bya/ /phyogs pa'i dus su mun khang 'khor ma bya ba ni/ kha cig nyi ma 'khor lo ltar 'dod kyang 'gro 'dug rab tu mi bde ba'i phyir ro/ /'dir ni dbus kyi lte ba la 'khor khang nyid rim gyis bskor ba'i sgo shar dang lho dang nub nas 'jug par bya ste/ lte ba'i phyogs re la 'dom re mda' re byas la/ sgo nub tu byas te/ 'khor khang gi bskor ba nang ma de sgo lhor bstan pa'i phyir 'khor khang shar du sgo bstan pa'i phyogs bzhi'i thad drang nas skar khung bzhi bzhi btod pas dus gzhan du snang ba gsal te/ bskor ba la sogs dgos na'ang nye bar mkho ba yin no/ /nang du yang dag 'jog cing gnas pa'i tshe bkag nas/ byang du sgo dang kha blta bar byas la bsgom par bya'o/ /nyin mo'i gnas ni 'khor khang de dag gi steng du byed phyi bas lhor blta ba/ mthongs gsal rab tu che bar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gsal lo/ /der zhi gnas thun mong ba'i gnas bya ba ni/ zhi gnas dus su dben khang ra bas bskor/ /ngang gis sems gnas skye ba'i gnas la shis/ /lhag mthong dus su mthongs gsal dngas pa gces/ /rgyun du yid dga' dus dang mthun par bya/ /dben khang de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi'i gang rung cig gi cha la/ dbye thang sa yangs phyam gyis 'ong ba'i mtha' shing la sogs pa'i ra bas sked nub tu bskor bas zhi gnas ngang gis skye ba'o/ /sa phyogs de'i mtho sar khri chung du rgyang ring po mthong sa la 'dug pas lhag mthong ngang gis skye ba yin no/ /zhi lhag skye ba'i sa phyogs bstan pa ni/ /nags rong la sogs dma' zhing 'thibs pa ni/ /zhi gnas gnas yin gangs sogs mtho sa nyid/ /lhag mthong gnas yin bye brag shes pa gces/ /phyogs gang zhig gnas la shing nags1 tweng

brag ri skal la sogs pa ste yid nang du gnas pa'i phyogs rnams zhi gnas kyi don bsgom par shis la/phyogs mtho zhing rig pa dngas yangs phyed pa thams cad lhag mthong gi gnas su shes par bya'o/ /da ni ji skad bshad pa'i gnas la blang dor shes pas don bsdu ba ni/ mdor na sa phyogs dang ni dben khang nyid//gang du nges 'byung skyo shas blo sna thung / /teng 'dzin 'phel bas dge la spyor ba'i gnas/ snying po byang chub gnas dang mtshungs pas bsten/ /gang du gnas pas dge 'grib nyon mongs 'phel/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi tshe 'di'i dbang gyur na/ /las ngan bdud kyi gnas te mkhas pas spang / /'di dag rang byung padmas gsungs de'i phyir/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis shes par bya/ /de la phyogs dang gnas khang gang du dge ba'i chos gong du 'phel zhing / dad pa dang nges 'byung khyad par can skye ba de ni snying po byang chub kyi gnas dang 'dra bas bstan par bya la/ gang du rtsod pa dang nyon mongs pa 'phel zhing tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng dang 'du 'dzi 'phel ba de las ngan bdud kyi gnas su shes pas spang bar bya ste/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis man ngag lta ba'i rdzong phreng du/ chos byed pa la gnas kyang gal che bas gong du dge ba dang ting nge 'dzin dam pa grub na de bas lhag pa gzhan du mi rnyed pas bstan pa la gdams pa'o/ /gang du rtsod pa dang mi dge ba 'phel na thar pa'i lam la bar du gcod pas spang ba la 'bad do zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /rang bzhin nye bar zhi ba'i sa phyogs su/ /chu gtsang dka' thub dpal gyis nyer 'tsho zhing / /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi kun spangs nas/ /ting 'dzin zab mo'i chos nyid bsgom par shog /sna tshogs 'char ba'i sdug bsngal kun la gnas/ /'khor ba'i grong khyer ra ba kun spangs te/ /thar pa zhi ba byang chub dam pa'i gnas/ /myang ngan 'das tshal bde ba thob par shog /ding sang 'gro la bdag 'dras phan pa med/ /dus ngan 'khor dang 'jig rten snang ba dang / /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi kun spangs te/ /sbas yul rin chen sgo bzhi 'byed par shog /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag las/ ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i sa phyogs bstan pa ste rdo rje'i gnas dang po'o//da ni gang gis bsgom pa'i gang zag bstan pa las/ mtshams bcad rgya dang ldan pa snod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa ni/ gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i gang zag kyang / /dad brtson nges 'byung skyo shas dang ldan zhing / /'khor bas skyo la thar pa don du gnyer/ /tshe 'di blos btang phyi ma byang chub 'dod/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi rgyang bsrings nyon mongs chung / /khong yangs spro ring dag snang mos gus che/ /bstan la sri zhur ldan pa de dag gis/ /thar pa'i mchog ste de nyid bsgrub par bya'o/ /de la dad brtson nges 'byung dang ldan pa ni/ chos kyi zhing sa dang 'dra bas med pa'i thabs med/ 'khor bar skyo shas dang ldan pa ni chos kyi 'jug sgo yin pas thar lam snyag pa la dgos/ zhi bde don gnyer dang ldan pa ni byang chub khyi sa bon dang 'dra/ tshe 'di blos btang gi zhen log ni 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'i thabs su 'gyur/ gtan gyi byang chub 'dod pa ni rkyen gsum gyi chu lud dang 'dra/ 'du 'dzi nyon mongs las dben pa ni 'gal rkyen rang log gi gdams ngag tu shar/ dag snang mos gus dang ldan pa ni dge pa'i lo thog gong 'phel gyi ༵ rkyen lhun gyis grub/ blo brtan sri zhu dang ldan pa ni thar lam gyi 'bras bu myur du smin par byed pas

na snod kyi mchog tu shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / kun byed las/ dad dang dam tshig brtson 'grus che ba dang / snying rje yi rang skyo dang yid sdog med/ /lus dang bu dang chung ma bran dang 'khor/ /gang la'ang ma chags dad dang dga' bas 'bul /'di dag dad dang dam tshig rgya yin pas/ /snying po'i don dang ldan pa sbyin par bya/ /zhes so/ /zhar la spang bya'i snod kyang de nyid las/ /snod min log pa'i gang zag bstan pa ni/ /grags dang 'jig rten chos la dga' ba dang / /nga rgyal dam pa mi bkur yid thung ldog /'phyar zhing rdzas dang dad par mi ldan te/ /rang tshod nyams len btsan thabs 'dod pa dang / /bstan pa yongs la 'phel zhing mi mthun zhing / /sgro skur bdag gzhan gnod sems bsgom pa ste/ /'di la mi bstan mchog tu gsang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /snod dang ldan pas ji ltar bya ba'i chos bstan pa ni/ dam pa'i bla ma rab tu mnyes byas te/ /thos bsam sgom pas rang gi sems sbyangs shing / /khyad par snyan brgyud snying po'i man ngag la/ brtson la rgyun ring sgrub pas nyin mtshan 'da'/ /tha mal phyogs su skad cig ma yengs par/ /gang zag snying po'i don la nan tan bya/ /de la thar pa'i sgor bla ma dam pas 'dzud pa'i phyir/dngos grub 'dod pas bla ma mnyes par byas la/ thos bsam sgom pa dang bstun rgyud snying por sgrub pas ma yengs par nan tan bya ste/ dpal 'byung bzhi zad pa'i rgyud las/ dngos grub 'dod pa'i dad pa can/ /dngos grub bla ma mnyes las 'byung / /de bas bdog pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mchod la yang dag brtson/ /zhes so/ /de nas thar lam gyi gzhi 'dings pa ni/ nyan thos byang chub sems dang rig pa 'dzin/ /sdom pa gsum po dag dang ma 'gal bar/ /rang rgyud sdom zhing gzhan phan ci 'grub dang / /cir snang thar pa'i lam du bsgyur par bya/ /de la gang nas bsgrubs kyang sdom pa gsum la bslab ste/ nyan thos kyi byang chub 'dod pas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa dang / bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med gsum la sogs pa na 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la bslab pa dang / tshe gcig la sogs par myur du sangs rgyas 'dod pas gsang sngags kyi sdoms pa la gnas pa ste/ de dag kyang yon tan gyi rdzas yar ldan du 'du zhing ming gi ldog pa tha dad du gnas pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims 'di gsum rten du gsungs te/ klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de la spyir rnam grol gyi byang chub lam du byed pa la sdom pa thob dgos/ sdom pas ma bsdams pa'i dge ba thams cad bar ma dge ba ste/ 'khor ba'i gnas las 'da' mi nus so/ /de la so thar gyi sdom pa lam ma nor zhing phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs na nyan rang gi byang chub thob pas 'khor bar mi 'khyam/ byang sems kyi sdom pas grangs med gsum na sangs rgya/ sngags kyi sdom pas tshe gcig na sangs rgya'o/ /sdom pa gsum yang bcas pa'i nyung ba yin pas/ sdom pa med pa la bsod nams dang lhang ba gnyis ka med/ zhing med na ston thog dang sad ser gang yang mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de la sdom pa gsum gyi go don bzhag na/ soms nyon mongs mi dge bas ma sbags par sdom pas so thar/ dge ba rgyun chags kyi gzhan don byed pas byang sems/ rang gzhan lha dang gzhal med khang du gsal bas don gnyis kun grub tu byed cing 'dod yon lam du bsgyur ba gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /de1 /ga

kyang gnod pa gzhi bcas las log pa/ phan pa bsgrub pa/ dag mnyam dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang las mi 'da' bar spyod pa'o/ /gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ji ltar bsrung ba la/ kha cig sna tshogs lam sna zin gyi bar so thar bsrung / de nas spyor lam drod ma skyes kyi bar byang sems bsung / de nas sngags 'ba' zhig baspung zer ba mi 'thad de/ rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa la las dang po pa'i dus nas sdom pa sum ldan du byas nas lam bsgom ste/ las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /zhes pas gnod do/ /kha cig gnas 'gyur du bsrung zer te/ zangs rdo bzhu ba la zangs/ rag rdo blugs na ra gan/ zha ne blugs na 'khar bar 'gro ba bzhin/ gang ma thob na 'og ma gnas 'gyur te/ sngags gcig pu bsrungs pa chog zer ba mi 'thad de/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las/khyad du gsod pa ni rang bzhin zhes 'og ma khyad du gsod na lcang bar gsung zhing / sdom pa thams cad bsrung bar bshad pas gnod do/ /la la bag la zhar 'dod pa'ang mi 'dod de/ yar zha'am mar zha ste sdom gsum mtshan nyid so sor 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzas ldog thams cad gcig par 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dang po rgyu tshogs gcig las skyes pa/ bar du 'gal bar mi gnas pa/ tha ma sgrub sde gcig pa ste chos gsum tshang bas rdzas ldog dang snga phyi thams cad du gcig pa med do/ la la gtong thob tu 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ gong ma thob pas 'og ma gtong bar bshad pa gang na'ang med do/ /'o na gang zhe na/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la sum ldan du bsrung ba la/ rang ldog ma 'dres dgag dgos yongs rdzogs/ ngo bo gnas 'gyur/ yon tan yar ldan/ sdom gsum gnad kyis mi 'gal/ dus skabs kyi gtso bor gang 'gyur bar bya ba dang drug go/ /dang po rang ldog ma 'dres te/ mtshan nyid so sor 'dzin no/ /dgag dgos yongs rdzogs ni thams cad log la mkhar rtsigs zer ba bzhin/ sdom pa gsum kas rgyud gcig po de'i dge ba sdom par gcig ste/ 'dul ba lung las/ chos gang zhig dngos dang brgyud nas kun du 'dod chags pa'i rgyur 'gyur gyi/ kun du 'dod chags dang bral bar mi 'gyur ba 'di ni chos ma yin/ 'dul ba ma yin/ ston pa'i bstan pa ma yin par shes par gyis shig /chos gang zhig dngos dang brgyud nas kun du 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rgyur 'gyur gyi/ kun du 'dod chags pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur ba 'di ni chos yin/ 'dul ba yin/ ston pa'i bstan pa yin par shes par gyis shig /de bzhin du zhe sdang la sogs pa'i bar mang du gsungs so/ /de'ang tshangs spyod la gnas pa'i dge slong dang / dbang gsum pa'i lam gyi rnal 'byor pa gnyis gnad gcig ste/ nus pa yod bzhin mi spyod pas 'dod pa'i dri mas ma gos pa dang / spyad bzhin dri mas ma gos pa gnyis ka'ang nyon mongs pa de nyid la brten nas sdom pa rdzogs par byed pa'i dgag dgos gnad gcig pa 'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa thams cad du mi spyod pa nyid gtso bo yin na ma ning dang bu chung la sdom pa lhag par skye bar rigs so/ /yang so thar dang dbang gsum po dngos 'gal du gnas pa yin na sngags kyi rten khyim pa kho nar 'ong ba rigs pa la/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ rten gsum las ni dge slong mchog /ces pa dang / sdom 'byung las/ rigs kyi bu yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba las rab tu byung ba/ so sor thar 18

pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yid kyis sngar brten nam/ brten par spro'am zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /brtag gnyis las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa gang / /e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas/ /e waṃ rnam pa'i bde chen po/ /dbang las yang dag shes par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / 'dod chags me yis tshig pa la/ /'dod chags nyid kyis grol bar 'gyur/ /ces pa dang / 'jam dpal las/stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags sogs spangs pa/ /zhes so/ /mdor na so thar gyis spangs/ byang sems kyis sbyangs/ sngags kyis lam du byed pa gsum yang / nyon mongs rang mtshan pa spong bar gcig ste/ dper na dug sbong / sman gyis spyong / sngags kyis btab ste za ba gsum dug rang mtshan pa spong ba dang / dug gis mi 'chi ba'i dgos pa bsgrub par gcig pa bzhin no/ /nyung ba nang 'dzom na sdig to mi dge pa'i phyogs kyi lcang ba rnams so thar bzhin bsrung / 'dod pas dben pa'i tsong ba rnams gong ma ltar bsrung / 'jig rten ma dad pa'i phyogs gnyis kar bkag pa rnams thams cad du 'bad de bsrung bar bya'o/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dge slong gi spyod pa kha na ma tho ba med cing /dus tshod dang 'brel par byed dgos pas/ nyams myong ma skyes kyi bar du thun mong gi sdom pa gtso bor bsrung / nyams myong skyes pa dang spyod pa phyi nang gnyis su phye la/ gsang spyod kyi dus su dbang tshogs 'khor bsnyen sgrub gnyis/ rang gzhan byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus bzhir/ sngags kyi sdom pa gtso bor nyams su blangs pas/ 'og ma gnyis kyi'ang dgag dgos yar ldan du 'gro/ dbang gsum pa lta bu la'ang rang rgyud kyis chags pa dang ma bral na sngags kyi lam du mi 'gro la/ thig le 'dzag med du brtan/ tha mal sgo gsum 'dzin pa dang bral tsam na/ mi tshangs spyod kyi skung ba gzhi med de/ dgag cha 'dod chags rang mtshan pa log pa'i phyir ro/ /gser dang rdo la khyad par med na gser la reg pas nyung ba med pa bzhin no/ /'di ni dngos po gtso bor rtsang ba yin pas pags rim 'das pas rtsang ba 'byung ngo zhe na/ de ni thabs la mi mkhas shing shes rab med pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ yang dag par na dngos po dang bsam pa khyad par med cing dbyer med pas thabs shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir nyes pa med de/sngags med pa'i dug gis 'chi yang / sngags dang ldan pa la nyes pa med pa lta bu ste/ gsang snying las/ sgyu mar shes pa mig yor tshul/ /sbyor sgrol bya ba kun byas kyang / /rdul cha tsam yang gos pa med/ /ces so/ /des na nyan thos kyi dge slong la de kho na nyid ltar yin la/ sdom pa gsum yar ldan gyi gang zag la zil gnon du log /dgos pa yar ldan du rdzogs so/ /gzhan yang nyan thos kyi nyung ba bskyed pa'i rnam gzhag gi rgyu tshogs kyang sngags kyi dge slong thabs khyad par can la spyod dus ma tshang ste/ bdag nyid dge slong yul mi/ dngos zag byed la sogs dag /lhar gsal ba dang / rdo rje dang padmar shes pa la sogs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na lam sgron las/ gsang ba shes rab dbang bskur ni/ /tshangs par spyod pas blang mi bya/ /zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ de dag ni blo chung ba rnams la dgongs te/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las/ drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta can lta bu blo chung zhing don zab mo ring du spang bar 'gyur ba rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ thog mar de skad brjod pas sngags la 'jug pa'i rgyur gsungs kyi/ rang bzhi~X du

sngags kyi dge slong dbang bzhi ma rdzogs na sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ thams cad rdzogs par thob cing lam yang thabs grol gnyis la brten dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang ba shes rab tshangs spyod kyis mi blang zhes pa yang blo chung ba dag grol du 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis mi blang zhes dus dang por len pa bkag /thams cad nas thams cad du ma yin no/ /de yang sngon jo bo bod du byon dus btsun pa rnams spyod pa cung zad lhod pa dgag pa la dgongs kyi/ gnod pa'i tshad la dge slong kho na sngags kyi rten mchog tu bshad pas shes so/ /gnad kyis mi 'gal ba ni/ gsum pa'i lam lta bu dang sbyar na/ lus sems nu bde'i nyams kyis rgyas/ rang rgyud kyi chags pa dag /thig le 'dzag med du brtan/ bud med mthong yang chags pa mi skye na gsum pa'i lam bsgom yang / so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du rdzogs te/ gsang snying las/ bla med mchog gi dam tshig tu/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis tshul khrims dang / /ji snyed sdom pa bsam yas kun/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /ces pa dang / sa ra has/ mda' mkhan ma phyag rgyar bzhes pa'i rjes la/ kha rtsang phan chad bram ze yin/ /kha rtsang phan chad dge slong min/ /di ring tshun chad dge slong yin/ /nye ru ka pa dge slong mchog /ces gsungs nas/ de'i rjes la klu sgrub kyi mkhan po mdzad do/ /gzhan yang chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas glu gar la sogs 'dod yon spyod pa rnams/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis spong ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur dus sngags su spyod la/ gzhan du 'dor pas don gcig ste/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ /ces bshad pa bzhin no/ /sdom pa gsum gar skyon dang nyes pa bskyed pa rnams bkag cing sdom la/ yon tan bskyed pa rnams bkag pa gang na'ang med do/ /yang kun rdzob smon 'jug gi sems bde ba chen por snang ba thams cad shar dus byang chub sems kyi sdom pa thams cad rdzogs te/ kye rdo rje las/kun rdzob don dam gzugs can gyi/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /kun rdzob kunda lta bu la/ /don dam bde ba'i gzugs can rna/ /zhes so/ /ngo bo gnas 'gyur ni/ gsang ba cod pan las/ dper na rdo las zangs su 'gyur/ /zangs las gser gyi rnam pa ste/ /zangs kyi dus na rdo med cing / /gser du gyur bas zangs mi snang / /rigs 'dzin nang gi dge slong la/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /gnyis po gnas pa nyid du ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gsungs so/ /zhes pas rigs 'dzin sngags kyi rang dus na so thar dang byang sems zhes rdzas gzhan tha dad pa med do/ /sngags kyi sdom pa rdzas su ngo bo gnas 'gyur du yod pa'i phyir la/ ldog pa ma 'dres par yod de/ thob la ma nyams pa de nyid/ so thar ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar khas blangs kyi/ sngags thob dus gtong rgyur ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / byang sems snying po byang chub kyi bar du khas blangs kyi/ sngags thob dus nyams rkyen dang gtong rgyur ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ngo bo sngags su rdzas gcig pas gzhan gnyis gnas 'gyur yin la/ ldog cha so sor ma 'dres te khas blangs pa'i cha las nyams rkyen ma byung bar so sor gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de la so thar gyi gtong rgyu slob pa phul ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid pa gnyis dang gzhan bdun bshad la/ byang sems kyi mchod 'os bslu ba la sdusdus pa nag po'i chos bzhi bshad de/ shing rta chen por bshad pa bzhin no/ /yon tan yar ldan ni/

jigs su gzhan gnyis 'du ba ste/ /bre gsum du do 'du ba bzhin rna/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po las/ bla med mchog gi sdom pa ru/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis tshul khrims dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa kun/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /ces pa dang / padma cos pan las/ dbang gsum bgrod pa'i rnal 'argyar pa/ /de ni dge slong chen por gsungs/ /de yis thams cad bya ba nyid/ /ces so/ /dus skabs kyi gtso bor gang 'gyur ba ni/ gsang spyod kyi dus susdom pa gsum gyi lhang ba nang ma 'dzom pa rnams ni ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su bsrung / 'og ma khyad du mi bsad/ 'doms sngags gtso cher bsrung zhing dgag dgos yar ldan du 'gyur bar bya'o/ /tshogs gseb tu'ang ma 'dzom na ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su bsrung /'doms na 'og ma gnyis gtso cher bsrungs pas sngags kyi dgongs pa shin tu gsang ba dang mthun zhing /gzhan ma dad pa spangs pas dgos pa yar ldan du 'gyur ro/ /'di dag ni sdom pa gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa ste/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa sdom pa suca/ ldan rnams la shin tu gces pa'i mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar sdom pa gsum gyis legs par bsdams pa'i gang zag /las dang po yis gtso bor rang don bsgrub/ /dben par sems bsrung rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi btang / /rkyen ngan spang zhing gnyen pos nyon mongs 'dul/ /lta spyod ma 'dzol sgom pa lhur blangs shing / /dug lnga rang rgyud gang skyes skad cig la/ /dran pas gzung zhing ma yengs gnyen po bsten/ /sgo gsum bag yod shes shing ngo tsha shes/ /khrel yod ldan pas rang rgyud gdul bar bya/ /thar lam dang por zhugs pa dag gis dngos don gtso bor bsgrubs la/rgyud dang yid kyis gzhan la phan pa bsam pa las/ mthu med pa dang / rang gi rgyud nyon mongs pa'i phyir rkyen ngan pa dang / dben sa bsten pa dang / nyon mongs la gnyen po bsten pa dang / lta spyod ma 'dzol bas nyams su blang ba dang / nyon mongs pa de gang skyes pa de dran pas bzung nas/ skad cig gnyis par rgyud la mi bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /lus ngag yid gsum dran shes bzhin bag yod gsum gyis shes par bya ba mchog tu gces te/ spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces/ /bdag ni de skad thal mo sbyor/ /ces so/ /khyad par blo rkyen khar 'chor bas rkyen snang dang rang snang gi chos la gdams pa ni/ bstod smad dgag sgrub snyan dang mi snyan la//sgyu ma mi lam bden med mgo stoms bya/ /brag ca'i sgra ltar rjes mabun bzod pa bsgom/ /nga bdag 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rtsa ba bcad/ /mdor na ci byed chos dang mi 'gal bas/ /rang gi rgyud bsdams gzhan la mi gnod cing / /nyon mongs phyogs su skad cig ma song bar/ /nyin mtshan dge bas 'da' ba shin tu gces//bstod smad dang bde dogs ci byung dus phyi nang thams cad rmi lam sgyu mar shes pas/ yu la med brag ca ltar bsam pa dang / nang sems kyi khong khro dang zug sdu de nyid ngo bo nges gzung dbyibs dang kha dog gang du'ang ma grub par brtags te/ spyod 'jug las/ ye nas skye med ngang nyid las/ /mi dgar ci yod dgar ci yod/ /thob pa ci yod shor ci yod/ /thams cad nam mkha' 'dra bar ni/ /bdag 'dras yongs su shes par bgyi/ /zhes so/ /mdor na nyin mtshan thams cad du gang ci byed kyang rang rgyud 'ba' zhig 'dul bas/ gzhan la mi gnod nyon mongs pa rang zhi/ dge ba ngang gis 'phel te/ sangs rgyas bstaṭwāṃ pa

la bslab pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /klu sgrub kyis/ nyid kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags bar gsungs/ /zhes pa dang / so thar las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /da ni de dag gi 'thad pa 'god pa las/ dang po gzhan don bsgrub dka' ba'i phyir rang don ma shor ba la gdams pa ni/ ding sang dus ngan skye bo mi bsrun pas/ /dben par rang don bsgrub pa shin tu gces/ /'dab gshog ma rdzogs 'phur bar mi nus ltar/ /mngon shes mi ldan gzhan don mi nus pas/ /rang don lhur blangs yid kyis gzhan phan bsam/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bdud kyi bslu brid 'dis/ /rang sems ma bslus sgrub la 'bad pa gces/ /'chi dus 'gyod pas gdung bar ma byed cig /ding sang ni sangs rgyas byon yang 'dul bar mi nus na/ bdag 'dra phan sems tsam yod kyang gdul bya dus la ni ma babs/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan/ stobs kyis 'god par mi nus pas/ gzhan don gyi gzugs brnyan mi nyan pa'i kha ta 'di zhog la/ dben pa'i nags 'dab bzang por sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa la bskul te/ tshe 'di rnam g.yeng bdud kyi bslu brid 'dis sngar bslus pas des chog gi /da snying nas dben par gcig pur 'gro dgos te/ 'chi ba'i dus su 'gyod pas mi gdung bar 'ong nges pas rang don bya ba la 'bad de/ gzhan don yid kyis bsam ba'i dus lags so/ /zhi ba lha'i zhal nas kyang / sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni ma mgu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /rang don bsgrub par brtsams kyang brten so zin par dka' ba'i phyir yang 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ de bas da lta sems la ser gdab ste/ /da lta 'chi na 'khyer so ci 'dug ltos/ /gar 'gro cir 'gyur brten so ma zin par/ /rnam g.yeng 'khrul pas nyin mtshan 'da' ba 'di/ /dal 'byor don med chud zos byed pas na/ /gcig pur dben par snying po'i don bsgom zhing / /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res legs dgos so/ /shi nas gar 'gro bdag la cha yod dam/ /de bas di ring nyid du brtson par bya/ /kha nang du stos shig rang nyid da lta 'chi na bde zhing skyid pa'i gnas 'dir 'gro zhe tshags su chud pa yod dam med/ nyin mtshan rnam g.yeng gis 'da' ba 'di dal 'byor chud zos su byed pa 'di soms la/gtan gyi 'dun ma da res legs pa cig bya dgos pas dus 'di nyid/ 'dug sa 'di nyid nas snying nas chos la brtson dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni/ /mi lus kyang ni thob mi 'gyur/ /mi lus thob par ma gyur na/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med/ /ces pa bzhin no/ /'khrul snang bzod dka' bas da res 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang 'dra/ /'di las thar thabs dgos sa sems la zung / /da res 'khrul na tan du 'khrul par 'khyam//de bas brtson pa skyed cig snying la zhog /'khor ba mtho dman gyi sdug bsngal bsam zhing skyi g.ya' ba lam 'phrang 'jigs pa can nam g.yang sa chen po dang 'dra bas/ da res ma thar na gtan du thar dus med pa'i phyir 'bad dgos te/ zhi ba lhas/ g.yang sa tha mal chung ngu la'ang / /bag yod gnas par byed da/ṭwāṃ na/ /dpag tshad stong du lhung pa yi/ /yun ring g.yang sar smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /

srid mtsho brgal dka' bas da res 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ nyon mongs bdag 'dzin brgal bas dka' ba'i mtsho/ //dal 'byor grub bos da res brgal bar bya/ /thar lam byang chub brgya lam res 'ga' zhig /bsod nams dbang gis snang ba'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas phan bde bsgrub par bya/ /nyon mongs pa ni rgya mtsho'i bying dang 'dra ba la/ da res kyi dal 'byor spu dang 'dra bas sgrol dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces so/ /de'ang dal 'byor thob dka' ba thob/ 'khor 'das la skyon yon shes/ chos bsgrub dgos snyam pa'i blo bring tsam cig skyes pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje rang gi snying la zhugs pas mun rum gyi glog dang 'dra zhing / bsod nams kyi blo 'byung dka' ba sems la byung ba'i dus 'di nas mgo bzung la 'bad dgos te/ de nyid las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu don grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ phyis nas yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur/ /ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig bar snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /de ltar dge ba nyam chung nyid la brtag /ces so/ /'gal rkyen 'byung nye bas chos la 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ tshe yang mi rtag skad cig 'gyur ba ste/ /rnam g.yeng bslu mkhas phyi bshol dge la byed/ /'khrul ba rgyun ring goms pa brtan pa na/ /nyon mongs tshogs ni skad cig ngang gis 'byung / /bsod nams dge la 'bad kyang 'byung dka' bas/ /las kyi rlung shugs bzlog la 'bad pa gces/ /dus skad cig tsam mi rtag pa skyes bu'i tshe/ rnam g.yeng chos la bslu ba 'jig rten gyi snang ba/ phyi bshol dge ba la byed pa byis pa'i skye bo/ 'khrul snang yun ring la goms pa 'khor ba'i sems can/ nyon mongs char bzhin 'bab ba khams gsum gyi 'gro ba/bsod nams brgya lam byed pa rgyal ba'i phrin las/ rba brgal bzlog par dka' ba nyon mongs kyi rgya mtsho ste/ dus res 'ga'i chos su ma song bar/ brtson pas chos la 'bad pa shin tu gces pa lags so/ /ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ kye ma 'du byed rnam mi rtag /skye zhing 'jig par 'gyur ba ste/ /skyes nas 'jig par 'gyur ba pas/ /de bas myur du zhi ba bde/ /zhes pa ltar bsam 'tshal lo/ /'khor bar snying po med pas chos la 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba cung zad med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal la bsams na bzod glags med/ /'di las thar thabs da lan btsal bar bya/ /snying nas snying po'i don la ma 'bad na/ /dal khom res 'ga'i chos kyis phan mi thogs/ /de bas mi rtag skyo shas cher bskyed de/ /skad cig ma yengs sgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed/ /khams gsu ma 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams na/ bzod pa'i glags med pas/ 'di las da res thar ba'i thabs btsal ba la dal khom med par chos la brtson dgos so/ /de'ang byas blo dang shes blos mi chog ste/ phal po che las/ ji ltar mnyen pa mkhas pa zhig /skye bo mang po sgrol byed kyang / /rang nyid de na 'chi ba ltar/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de dang 'dra/ /ji ltar 'on pa rol mo mkhan/ /skye bo mang po mgu byed kyang / /rang nyid kyis ni ma thos ltar/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de dang 'dra/ /ji ltar skye bo skom pa dag /chu ni mthong dang thos pa yis/ /23

skom pa'i sdug bsngal mi sel ltar/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de dang 'dra/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /da ni de thams cad kyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar dang po nyid du rtogs byas nas/ /byis nas 'phags pa'i go 'phang myur du 'thob/ /rang don 'grub cing gzhan don ngang gis 'byung / /'khor ba'i gnas las thar ba'i lam mchog rnyed/ /de phyir ci byed chos dang bstun pa ni/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag yin/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar pa'i phan yon/ da res 'bad pas chos bsgrub dgos par gdams pa rnams legs par rtogs nas 'bad na/ rang gzhan gyi don 'grub/ thar pa'i lam sna zin/ gtan gyi 'dun ma legs pa'i phyir/ gang ci byed kyang chos dang mthun pa ni byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu mdo rgyud thams cad las gsungs pa bdag gis de ltar bya ba la gdams so/ /sdug bsngal me tshogs srungs pa'i 'khor ba 'dir/ /bdag blo skyo bas zhi ba'i nags tshal du/ /da res tshe 'dis bgrod par bya'o zhes/ /snying nas brtson pas 'du 'dzi spang bar shog /rang don dam pa bsgrub pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /gzhan don ltar snang mngon par skyo ba can/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal mang ldan 'dis ci byed/ /de bas gcig bur nags su gnas par shog /da res 'bad kyang gzhan la ci zhig phan/ /phyi nang gang na'ang bsam zhing skyo ba 'phel/ /de bas gcig pur brag ri'i drung 'dug ste/ /srog dang bcas pa'i lus 'dir 'dor bar shog /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag las/ ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i gang zag brtan pa ste rdo rje'i gnas gnyis pa'o//da ni gang bsgrub par bya ba'i chos bstan pa las/ re zhig mdor bstan pa ni/ gsum pa nyams su blang bya'i chos la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang /mjug gi rim pa dang gsum las/ re re zhing rgyas par dbye ba'i/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bstan pa/mi rtag skyo shas phyi yi sngon 'gro ste/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa gting nas zlog par byed/ /snying rje sems bskyed bye brag sngon 'gro ste/ /theg chen lam du chos rnams 'gro bar byed/ /de phyir thog mar sngon 'gro rnam gnyis sbyong / theg pa chen po'i lam ji ltar bsgom yang de'i sngon du/ tshe mi rtag pa bsam pa dang / 'khor ba sdug bsngal du bsam pa dang / de la snying rje bsgom pa dang / de'i ched du rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par sems pa'i byang chub sems bsgom pa gces so/ /tshe mi rtag par shes pas sgrub pa long yod la mi 'chor ba dang / 'khor ba sdug bsngal du shes pas tshe 'di las blo ldog pa dang / snying rje phyogs med du bsgoms pas theg pa dman par mi nyung ba dang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed pas myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de la thabs snying rje chen po dang / shes rab mtha' gnyis las mi gnas pa ni theg pa chen po'i khyad par gyi chos te/ sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du snyung / /zhes pa dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes pa dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang / /thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang / /thabs kyi ring ba ma yin nyid/ /ces pa dang / do ha las/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig 24

bsgoms na yang / /srid pa 'dir gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gang dag gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa de/ /srid par mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes so/ /de nas mchog gi sngon 'gro bstan pa ni/ de rjes khyad par mchog gi sngon 'gro ni/ /dbang rdzogs thob nas bskyed pa'i rim gnyis te/ /rang lus lha dang snod bcud lhar gsal bas/ /tha mal 'dzin pa'i zhen pa zlog par byed/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yis/ /byin rlabs tshad med thugs rje shugs las 'char/ /bar chad kun sel dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /de phyir de rjes sngon 'gro rnam gnyis bsgom/ /dbang legs par thob nas bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa la dang por zhugs pa ni tshogs lam chung ngur tshud nas thar pa'i lam sna zin par 'dod pas/lam gyi gzhi dbang yin la/ de thob nas sngags thun mong du lam dngos bskyed rdzogs spel ma stan thog gcig tu sgom par grags kyang / 'dir rdzogs pa chen po'i rnam gzhag gis/ lha bskyed pa dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / rtsa thig rlung gsum phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa thams cad rdzogs pa chung du dmigs bcas su bsdus nas lam gyi sngon 'gror bstan pas de dag gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad na/smin byed dbang dang grol byed bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ snang ba rdo rje 'char ba'i rgyud las/ gang phyir rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /gsungs pa'i don ni rnam mang po/ /mdor bsdus rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /smin pa dang ni grol ba'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang la grangs nges pa/ go rims nges pa/ sgra don bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dag bya nyon mongs pa bzhi dang / sgrub byed phyag rgya bzhi dang / nyams dga' ba bzhi dang / 'bras bu sku bzhi la sogs brtson par byed pa la dbang bzhir grags so/ /go rims nges pa la lta ba dang sbyar ba dang / rten dang brten pa dag tshul dang sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni bum dbang gis snang sems sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gnas pas sems tsam gyi lta ba rtogs/ gsang dbang gis chos thams cad spros bral rab tu mi gnas par bstan pas dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs/ shes rab ye shes dbang gis bde stong dbyer med du bstan pas gsang sngags nang pa gnyis kyi lta ba rtogs/ tshig dbang gis blo 'das rig pa byang chub kyi sems su bstan pas rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba rtogs so/ /gnyis pa rten dang brten pa dag tshul dang sbyar na/ lus sems tshogs pa gcig gis rten dang brten pa byin gyis rlob cing 'dag par byed de/ lus kyi ngo bo rtsa/ de la rlung dang thig le/ de la rig pa byang chub kyi sems brtan pas/ lus dag cing smin par byed pa la bum dbang / rtsa dag cing smin par byed pa la gsang dbang / thig le dag cing smin par byed pa la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / rig pa byang chub kyi sems dag cing smin par byed pa la tshig dbang rin po che'o/ /sgra don ni a bhi ṣiñtsa dang ṣe ka ta ste dri ma 'khrud cing skal ba 'jog pa'i phyir dbang ngo / /de yang tshe 'dir sa rab tu dga' ba'i bden mthong la sbyor bar dbang bas kyang dbang du bshad de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dkyil 'khor cho ga ji lta bu/ /cho ga chos dang rnal 'byor te/ /gsang ba thar pas yang dag 'byung / /skye ba 'di nyid kho na la/ /rab dga' sgrub par byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /dbang ma thob pa'i nyes pa ni/ /gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa rnams/ /'bras bu med cing rlag par 'gyur/ /ces pa 25

dang / sgyu ma bde mchog las/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni ma mthong bar/ /rnal 'byor ba ni dngos grub 'dod/ /mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdog dang / smongs pa phub ma brdungs dang mtshungs/ /zhes so/ /dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ /gsang ba mchog las/ dbang bskur yang dag snyin ldan na/ /ma 'bad par yang dngos grub thob/ /ces so/ /dbang gi rnam gzhag go /grol byed lam gyi rim pa ni/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ gsang 'dus las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag bstan/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po ste/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bskyed rim ni/ kun rdzob lha'i snang ba la brten nas tha mal gyi rtog pa spang zhing phung po khams dang skye mched kyi tshogs bdun pa'i chos dag par sbyangs la/ rdzogs rim ni phra mo'am bsam gyis mi khyab don dam pa'i dbyings dang mthun pa la brten nas nang sems kyi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin du shar ba ste/ zung du 'brel pa ni dngos grub kyi lam du bshad pa ni/ gur las/ phyag rgya chen por rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje'i sku ni bsgrub par bya/ /rin chen bzlas pa'i bzlas pa las/ dri med rdo rje'i gsung du 'gyur/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bsams na/ /rin chen sems su rab tu 'grub/ /ces pa dang / de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nga rgyal gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid yun ring mi 'gyur/ /ces so/ /de la bskyed pa med par rdzogs par mi rung ste/ mkha' 'gro sdom pa las/ lha dang bral ba'i lam de ni/ /log pa'i lam du byung ba ste/ /sngags kyi lam du de mi rung / /zhes so/ /de la gdod ma nas sku gsung bugs rdo rjer gnas kyang bag chags kyi sgrib pas mi gsal ba nyid/ gsal bar byed pa la rim gnyis kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa yin te/ kye rdor las/ lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bskyed pa tsam gyis rnal 'byor gnas/ /gzhan la kha dog gnas pa ni/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas sangs/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i yon tan ni/ gur las/ sangs rgyas da nyid gang bsgoms pa/ /byang chub ma thob na yang skye/ /skye zhing skye ba rnams su de/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i go 'phang 'gyur/ /yang na sa bdag nyid du'am/ /dag pa'i gnas su nges par 'gro/ /zhes so/ /de ltar go don spyir bzhag nas/ thun mgor ji ltar bsgom pa'i rim pa ni rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhi khro gang rung ngam/ rigs thams
