thim/ 'a khog pa la thim/ khog pa zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes bin dhu la thim/ bin rnyu chos kyi dbyings su thim pas/ bltar med bsam du med pa'i ngang la gzhag go/ /rjes bsngo ba bya'o/ /shin tu zab lam mo/ /khrid rkang dgu bcu rtsa bdun pa'o/ /de nas gnyis su med pa bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi don sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po bsgom pa la/ bskyed rdzogs spyir bsgom pa dang / zab lam bye brag tu bsgom pa sanyis las/ dang po la/ skye ba bzhi'i bag chags sbyong tshul la stos nas bsgom tshul bzhi las/ sgong skyes sbyong ba rgyas pa chen po'i bskyed rim ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa dang gsol ba gdab pa dang sdom pa bzung ba rnams ye shes sku mchog gi tshig gi phyir sems gzhol bas byas te/ slar yang badzra muḥs stong pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas/ de bzhin nyid dang / kun du snang dang / rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i a dkar las lha'i sa bon dkyil 'khor so so'i gdan la babs nas/ lhar gyur pa'i tshul gyis sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la/ ye shes pa bstem nas/ mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / 'phro 'du 'dzab kyi bzlas pa'i bar/ rgyas par byas nas tshogs la rol ba'am med kyang rung ste/ rdzogs rim gnyis po bsgoms la bsngo ba bya'o/ /'di dag rgyas par zhi ba rin po che'i dra ba dang / khro bo snang ba rgyan du blta bar bya'o/ /khrid rkang dgu bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ /de nas mngal skyes spyong ba rgyas pa 'bring gi bsgom tshul ni sngar las/ bsod nams zhing bsam ste mi dmigs pa bor la/ gzhan de dang 'dra bar bsgom pa'o/ /khrid rkang dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa'o/ /de nas drod gsher skyes kyi bag chags sbyang ba'i phyir bsdus pa bsgom pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor rnams so so'i mtshan brjod pa tsam gyis zhi khro'i lhar gsal btab pas/ 'di ni dbang rdzogs zhes pa nas/ /thams cad lha dang lha mo'i ngang / /zhes pa'i bar lan cig brjod pa rang nyid ye nas lha'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bor rtogs pa las/ thugs ka'i padma nyi zla'i steng gi kun bzang yab yum gyi hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ lhar gyur/ 'phags pa mchod/ sngags kyi rang sgras 'jig rten khyab 154

par bsams la/ oṃ āḥrdu/ oṃ rgyu tsā trīḥ.aḥzhes ci 'grub bzlas la/ rdzogs rim gnyis gang rung bsgoms nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /khrid rkang brgya tham pa'o/ /de nas rdzus skyes kyi bag chags sbyang ba shin tu bsdus pa ni/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis gsal btab nas sngags bzlas te rdzogs rim bsgoms pa las/ skabs 'dir sems bskyed nas nam mkha'i dkyil du nyi zla'i steng na kun bzang yab yum zhal sbyar rdo rje skyil krung mnyam gzhag mdzad pa las/ 'od 'phros snang srid thams cad ye shes lnga'i zhing khams su dag par byas/ 'khor 'das thams cad ro gcig ye nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas su gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥrgyu zhes ci 'grub bzlas nas de'i ngang la glod pas bsam mi khyab pa'i 'od gsal 'char ro/ /rjes la bsngo ba bya'o/ /'di ni rgyal ba gcig bsgoms kun gyi ngang / /zhes bya ste/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dbang phyug /rang byung gdod ma'i mgon po/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mes po dam pa bsgom pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang snying las/ mkha' dkyil dngas pa'i dbyings nyi zla/ /ye shes rgyal po stong gsal bsgom/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /thams cad 'di yis bsgom par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khrid rkang brgya dang gcigapa'o/ /de nas zab lam bye brag tu bsgoms pa la / byin rlabs dngos spub kyi gnad/ sngon 'gro lam sel gyi gnad/ dngos gzhi khyad par gyi gnad dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid lhar bskyed pa'i spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ yab yum 'khril spyor can dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zung 'jug mdzad par bsgoms la/ mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / gsol ba btab nas/ sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas lus ngag yid gsum la thim/ dbang dang po gsum thob/ de thams cad bde ba'i ngo bor zhu ba rang gi snying gar bab pas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin tshig dbang rin po che rang 'khrungs su thob par bsams la dar cig glod la bzhag /rjes la bsngo ba bya'o/ /'di ni byin rlabs dngos su 'bab/ rtogs pa shugs las 'char/ lam gyi bar chad sel/ gegs dang gol sa chod/ dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pa'i phyir rab tu gsang ba'i gnad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang gnyis pa'o/ /de nas sngon 'gro lam sel gyi gnad la gsum las/ rtsa sbyang ba stong ra'i gnad ni/ sngon 'gro bshad ma thag pa ltar bsgoms la/ 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus na ro rkyang kun 'dar ma gsu ma ka ba'i tshul du yod pa'i nang sbug ma stong sang nge ba la dmigs pa 'dzin pa yin te/ gtso mo dbu ma'i nang phru ma phus btab pa lta bu/ dang po mda' smyug gi nang tsam/ de nas spos dong tsam/ de nas bzho zo'i nang tsam/ de nas lus thams cad dbu ma'i nang tsam du bsgom mo/ /'dis ni rlung sems thams cad ngang gis dbu mar tshud pa'i gnad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang gsum pa'o/ /de nas rlung sbyang ba srog gi gnad ni/ de ltar dbu ma dang 'khor lo bzhi stong par gsal ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi ro rkyang yar sna gnyis smin mtshams nas sna bug gi nang gnyis la zug cing / mar sne gnyis lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi'i cha spu na gu'i thad nas dbu mar gug pa'i sna tshud par bsams la/ rlung ro bus nas phyir 'phang dus nad dang sdig sgrib thams cad phyir sangs/ nang du 'dren dus snod bcud brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i yon 155

tan dang bcas pa rlung gi rnam pas sna bug nas ro rkyang gi nang la byung ba dbu ma'i nang du tshud pa la dmigs pa bzung nas/ 'jam rlung dal bus 'dzin cing / rang bab kyi 'byung cub las cha babs su 'dzin pa ni gnad yang dag pa'o/ /de ltar byas pas rlung skyon med par ngang gis rlung zin cing 'phyongs pa'i gnad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas thig le sbyang ba rtsol ba'i gnad ni/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ste/ rlung bsgoms pa yan chad sngar bzhin byas pa'i lte ba'i thad sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus dbu ma'i nang na/ me'i dngas ma rgya khab kyi rtse'am nyungs kar gyi yang zhun tsam la/ a shad kyi rnam pa can reg bya shin tu tsha ba zhig bsgoms la/ ro rkyang gi rlung dbu ma'i mar snar zhugs pa'i dngas ma des spar bas me rta rnga'i nyag tsam 'bar ba/ dbu ma'i nang bde chen 'khor lo'i thad ka'i dkyil na ha mgo thur du blta ba sran ma'i ga'u tsam la reg pas/ thig le dkar dmar gyi thigs pa phra mo mar bab lte ba'i me'i gsos byas/ de bas kyang me cher 'bar ba bzhin/ ha las thigs pa cher bab pas dbu ma'i nang khengs/ dngas ma 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa 'dab stong pa rnams gang ba la ma yengs par bsgoms pas/lus sems bde ba chen po ngang gis 'char ro/ /khrid rkang brgya dang lnga pa'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi khyad par gyi gnad la/ yas bstan gyi ye shes/ mas bstan gyi ye shes/ kun du bzang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes dang gsum las/ dang po la bzhi las/ bde chen 'khor lo'i man ngag ni/ 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus na dbu ma ye shes kyi rtsa la/ dngas ma'i dngas ma dkar dmar 'dres pa nyungs 'bru tsam gyi rten la/ 'od lnga'i gong bu sran ma rdog po tsam re bsams pa'i spyi gtsug gi dngas ma nyungs 'bru tsam la mgrin pa'i dngas ma 'od dang bcas pa'i drod kyis bzhu bas/ byang chub sems kyi thigs pa spa'i nyag tsam babs spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab dang / mgrin pa'i rten gyi dngas ma la zhugs/ tshad med pa'i bde bas khyab par bsams la 'jam rlung rang zhir bzung ngo / /khrid rkang brgya dang drug pa'o/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od dang dngas ma'i drod kyis mgrin pa'i rten gyi dngas ma zhu bas/ longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dang snying ga'i rten la zhus/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyes par bsam mo/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bdun pa'o/ /de nas lte ba'i 'od dang thig le'i drod kyis snyir ga'i rten gyi dngas ma zhu bas/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dang / lte ba'i rten gyi jig le la zhugs/ mchog tu bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /khrid rkang brgya dang brgyad pa'o/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od dang rten gyi dngas ma'i drod mar song / lte ba'i rten gyi dngas ma zhu ba'i dngas ma rlangs kyi tshul du rags pa ma yin phra la dngas par sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dang / ro rkyang dbu ma'i nang kun khyab par zhugs pas nye bar zhi ba'i bde bas khyab ste/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /khrid rkang brgya dang dgu pa'o/ /de nas mas bstan gyi ye shes la'ang bzhi las/ dang po snying ga'i 'od las zer 'phros te lte bar song bas thig le rten dang bcas pa je phra je chung la yar 'dus snying ga'i 'od dang thig le la thim pa'i ngang la gzhag go/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bcu pa'o/ /de nas 'od zer mgrin par 'phros je phra las snying gar 'dus pa'i ngang la gzhag go/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bcu gcig pa'o/ /de nas yang 'od zer spyi bo'i thig le rten dang bcas pa la phog pas/ je phra je chung las snying gar 'dus pa'i ngang la gzhag go/ /156

khrid rkang brgya dang bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de nas snying ga'i rtsa 'dab kyi dngas ma la 'dus/ de yang brten pa thim le sran ma tsam la 'dus/ /'od lnga po'ang dbus kyi mthing ga nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du 'dus/ de yang gdangs je phra las mthar yid la mi byed pa kun du bzang mo chos nyid stong pa chen po'i dgyings su dag pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bcu gsum pa'o/ /de nas kun du bzang mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes ni/ de'i tshe lus ri rgyal ltar mi g.yo/ ngag skugs pa ltar mi brjod/ sems nam mkha' ltar mi rtog pa'i rang la bzhag pas/ gang yang yid la mi gyed pa'i stong pa ni kun du bzang mo chos nyid don gyi ye shes la/ rang gsal dngas dang bcas pa'i rig pa gsal dngas zud pa'i snang cha ni kun du bzang po chos sku gzhi'i ye shes te/ de gnyis dbyer med rig pa phyi nang bar med du phyam gdal ba ni dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kun bzang pab yum zung 'jug gnyug ma'i ye shes rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /tshul 'di ni sgyu 'phrul don gyi rdzogs rim bla na med pa'i mthar thug nges pa don gyi bcud kyi snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i gnad bstan pa'o/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bcu bzhi pa'o/ /tshul 'di gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ /zab cing rgya che gsang ba mchog gi gnas/ /myur du rdzogs ba'i sangs rgyas sgrub byed yin/ /skal bzang skye bos dang du blang bar mdzod/ /dge ba 'di yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg la rab zhugs te/ /nyin mtshan rim gnyis 'khor lo'i bzhon pa yis/ /dngos grub yid bzhin gling du phyin par shog /sna tshogs khams can 'khor ba'i rang bzhin ngang / gnyis med mya ngan 'das pa ro gcig tu/ /nam zhig nus ldan thabs kyis 'dres pa'i tshe/ /gzhan don kun grub chos kyi char 'bebs shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i don khrid byang chub lam bzang las bar du dge ba 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo je thig pa'i gnas bstan pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa gsang ba nges don snying po'i 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa tha mar dge ba'i khrid kyi rim pa rgya cher bstan pa las/ de'ang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa blang dor bya rtsol dang bcas pa las ches naphags pa/rang byung gi ye shes la lhun gyis grub par ye nas gnas pas sgo gsum bya rtsol las 'das pa'i chos nyid rdo rje rtse mo a ti don gyi snying po nges don mngon du ston pa'i tshul nyams su blang ba la don rnam pa gnyis te/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang gdams khrid bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rdzogs pa chen po sems sde klong sde man ngag gi sde gsum bsdus pa'i snying po yin pas rgyud rim tha dad du bgrang du yod na'ang /gtso bo gnad thog gi me btsa' ltar ston pas man ngag gi sde yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang bla na med pa man ngag gi sde las/ dmigs pa yul gyi blo can rnams 'jug pa dang khregs chod dbang po yang rab kyi chos su bstan pa dag gi nyams len dang mabun par bstan pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos sku kun du bzang po/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen mkhas pa shrī sgridha/ rgyal ba sto na sru tra/ paṇa chen tha ma la mi tra'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ gnas 157

brtan ldang ma lhun gyi rgyal mtshan/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston/ gu ru mkhas pa nyi 'bum/ chos bdag gu ru jo 'ber/ 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa/ spub chen zla ba mun sel/ rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs pa chos kyi rje rin po che ku mā rā tsa/ kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po man chad gong bzhin rna/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chos sku kun bzang ngang / /lhun grub 'od gsal bde chen longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /brgyud gsum bla ma rnams la gus byag 'chal/ /don gnyis pa gdams khrid rgya cher bstan pa la gsum ste/ lta bas thag bcad/ sgom pas ngang skyong /'bras bus re dogs spang pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ phyi gzung ba yul med stong par bstan pa dang /nang 'dzin pa gzhi med rtsa bral du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la'ang / snang ba bden med kyi gzugs brtan sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du bstan pa dang / de nyid dpyad na mi rnyed pa yul med stong par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs sogs yul lngar snang ba'i cha thams cad ni med bzhin rang snang tsam du snang ba ste/ de'ang bde bar gshegs pa la dag pa'i snang ba dang / sems can la 'khrul ba'i snang bar snang ngo cog thams cad sems dang ye shes kyi snang bar bstan la/ de gnyis ka yang ji ltar snang bzhin pa'i dus nas snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar gnas te/ ye shes kyi dag snang la gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma med pas yod med kyi mtha' las 'das shing / skye 'jig dang 'pho 'gyur med pas 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid chad pa/'dus ma byas kyi stong gzugs snang ba/ kun du spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin can no/ /sems 'khrul snang la bdag 'dzin gyi yul du byed pa/ yod med kyi ris su chad cing 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid chad pa/ rkyen snang glo bur ba'i rang snang bag chags brtas pa ba'i rang bzhin du de ltar snang ba tsam ste/skabs 'dir gzung ba sems kyi 'khrul snang bden med du shes par byed do/ /de'ang 'di ltar phyi rol dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba 'di dag rmi lam ltar bag chags brtas pa ba'i snang ba ma rig pa'i gnyid kyis myos pa la snang ba tsam las/ don la grub pa ni cung zad kyang med la/ snang ba'i dus nas sems kyang ma yin te/ kha dog dang che chung dang ngos gzung la sogs pa sems kyi mtshan nyid dang sdas 'gal bar 'jug pa'i phyir dang / sems las gzhan yang ma yin te 'khrul pa'i snang ba tsam las don gzhan bden pa gang du'ang ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /sems la snang ba ni thog ma med pa nas brgyud pa'i bag chags brtas pa ba goms pa'i rnam pa tsam ste/ sgyu ma'i ltad mo khar rtsang mthong ba'i bag chags mdang gi rmi lam du snang ba'i rnam pa dang 'dra'o/ /de'i phyir ji ltar snang yang med pa gsal bar snang ba/mi lam dang / sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / brag ca dang / mig yor dang / chu zla dang / sprul pa dang / dri za'i grong khyer gyi rnam pa ltar/ rten med pa/ gnas med pa/ rang bzhin med pa/ ngos gzung med pa stong pa'i rang bzhin gsal bar snang ba tsam mo snyam du/ bdag gzhan/ dgra gnyen/ yul grong /gnas khang /bza' btung / longs spyod/ za nyal/ 'gro 'dug la sogs pa gang ci byed ci snang ba thams cad la bden med du lam lam rtsal sbyang zhing / spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo / /khrid kang brgya dang 158

bco lnga pa'o/ /de nas dpyad na yul med stong par bstan pa ni/ 'di ltar snang ba thams cad kyang rags phra rdul phran du brtags na cha med ci yang ma grub pas gzugs stong pa dang / kha dog ngos gzung gis brtags pas sgra stong pa dang / rnam pa ngo bo brtags pas dri stong pa dang / myong ba cha shas la brtags pas ro stong pa dang / khyad par skye mched la brtags pas reg stong par thug ste/ yul du snang ba mi 'dra yang rang ngo stong par khyad par mtshungs pas/ yul tha dad kyi stong pa la ris so so ba med par bar snang dag pa ltar tha dad ma yin gcig las 'das pa'i rang bzhin ni/ yul snang ngo bo nyid kyis stong par gnas pa'i rang bzhin la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo / /khrid rkang brgya dang bcu drug pa'o/ /de nas 'dzin pa gzhi med rtsa bral du bstan pa la gnyis las/ shes pa rang gsal rten med du bstan pa ni/ 'di ltar gzugs sogs lngar 'char ba dbang po'i shes pa lnga dang / don spyi sems kyis brlabs shing yul du byas pa yid kyi shes pa dang / dgag sgrub chags ldang du rtogs pa nyon yid kyi shes pa dang / bar ma yul du byed pa yid kyi shes pa tshogs drug gi rjes las skyes can dang / rtog med rang gsal yul dang ma 'brel ba kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ tshogs brgyad dam drug gi rang dus na shes pa'i rnam pa cir rtogs kyang sal le ba/ wal le ba/ rten med la rang gsal ba/ gsal bar 'char yang dngos po med pa/ med la snang la bar snang dag pa dang ser bu rdul med lta bu/ gsal cha rang gnas pas nam mkha' sprin dengs lta bu/ 'gyu cha ngos gzung gi dngos por med pas rlung lta bu/ 'dzin par snang ba'i dus nas rang sangs ngos gzung med pa la/ 'char dus blta/ gnas dus blta/ phyam me glod nas kyang 'dzin pa rang gi snang tshul la bltas pas/ med pa gsal snang / stong pa ris med/ rang gsal rten med tsam gyi ngo bor rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /'di yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo / /khrid rkang brgya dang bcu bdun pa'o/ /de nas dpyad na rtsa bral stong par bstan pa ni/ de ltar rang gsal rten med kyi shes pa'ang phyi snang ba/ nang phung po/ bar 'gyu ba/ rang gnas shes pa rang gi ngo bol/ dbyibs kha dog /skye 'gag gnas gsum/ ngo bo ngos gzung la sogs par gzhig cing brtags pas ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub par rtsa ba med pa/ rten med pa/ yod med kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i gnas lugs rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gi dus na bla ma'i mos gus kho na gal che ste/ khrid rkang brgya dang bco brgyad pa'o/ /don gnyis pa bsgoms pas ngang la bskyang ba la gnyis te/ dbang po gsum gyi bsgom tshul spyir bstan pa dang /thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni gzhung du lta ba rtogs pa dang 'brel bas go sla bar bya ba'i phyir dbang po yang rab nas sngon la smos kyang / skabs 'dir 'jug tshul go rims kyi dbang du byas te/ dbang po tha ma/ 'bring / rab kyi bsgom tshul rim pas bstan par bya ba las/ dang po dbang po tha ma'i rim pa la/ zhi gnas btsal/ lhag mthong bskyed/ zung 'jug bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ rnam rtog gdul ba ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ rnam snang gi chos bdun las/ khyad par du lag pa gnyis pus mor bkab/ mjing pa cung zad dgye bar byas te/ rtsa gsu gsal btab pa'i ro rkyang gi mar sna nas 'od gsal gyi rlung du ba lta bu dkar la dngas pa sngo la 'phyur ba/159

dmar la gdangs pa/ ser la gsal ba/ ljang la gnag pa/ mthing la skya ba lnga sgril thag pa brkyang ba ltar phar song / rlung tshur 'jug dus nang du zhugs pa'i khug pa la sems kyis gcig nas lnga'i bar bgrang zhing phreng ba re bsgyur bas rnam rtog rags pa kun ngang gis zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /khrid rkang brgya daja bcu dgu pa'o/ /de nas sems gzung ba ni/ sngon 'gro de dang 'dra ba las/ dngos gzhi mdun du bris sku'am po ti'am rde'u shing bu la sogs pa'i mtshan ma gcig bzhag pa la/ sems ma yengs par ce re mig mi 'gul bar blta ba'i ngang la gzhag go/ /de'i dus su dgra lhang ba'am/ dri'am/ rtog pa 'phro ba gang byung yang de dag ling bamyur rbad bcad nas/ dmigs rten la ha re cher blta'o/ /de nas sems rtse gcig tu 'dug na mig btsums nas de'i rnam pa lam me ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas bsgom mo/ /'phro na yang mig phye la rten la blta'o/ /de ltar byas pas dbang po lnga'i snang yul lnga dang / yid kyi yul chos la sems rtse gcig 'dzin pa'i zhi gnas skye'o/ /khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu pa'o/ /de nas zhar la sgra'i yul la'ang de ltar bslabs te/ sngon 'gro 'dra ba las/ dngos gzhi mi sgra rlung sgra khyi sgra la sogs pa la rna ba ma yengs par gtad nas bsgom/ yang de'i rnam pa yid la byas la nang du blta zhing sgra dngos kyi nyan 'phro bor la bsgom/de gnyis res mos su byas pas sgra la soms zin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dri dang ro dang reg la'ang sbyar nas nyams su blangs pas/ phyis bsgom dus yul lngas mi gnod cing grogs su 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnad gal po che'o/ /khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /de nas chos la sbyang ba ni sngon 'gro sngar bzhin byas nas/ dngos gzhi la bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'i ngang las ma yengs par bzhag pas rtse gcig tu zin dus dmigs pa bsgyur te/ 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus sems can gyi don byed pa'am/ byams sogs tshad med bzhis sems can la bsgoms pa'i sems rtse gcig pa sa la la ba de ngos gzung zhing ma yengs par bya'o/ /de gnyis spel mar sbyangs pas 'phro gnas mnyam pa'i ngang la sems zin pa'i zhi gnas skye'o/ /'di ni dmigs gnad gal po che'o/ /gnad 'di dag gis zhi gnas skye ba la thogs pa med par 'aspub bo//khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /de nas lhag mthong bskyed pa la gnyis las/ phyi gzung ba yul med nam mkha' ltar mnyam pa'i ngang la gzhag pa ni/ sngon 'gro sngar bzhin/ dngos gzhi 'di ltar sna tshogs su snang ba'i yul rnams rmi lam sgyu ma ltar snang la/ dpyad na rdul phran cha med du'ang ma spub pa stong pa ste/yul snang du 'jal ba gzung ba'i shes pa dang bcas pa rang gsal stong pa'i ngang la phyam gyis mnyam par gzhag go/ /des na yul dang gzung ba'i shes pa bdag med par rtogs pa'i gnad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o/ /de nas nang 'dzin pa rtsa bral stong par bstan pa ni/ yul dang yul can du 'jal byed sems kyi rang bzhin la/ 'das ma 'ongs/ dngos po dngos med/ byung gnas 'gro gsum/ dbyibs kha dog la sogs par brtags shing btsal bas gang du'ang ma rnyed pa'i tshe/ rten med kyi shes pa 'dzin med kyi ngang du lhod kyis glod la gzhag go/ /'dis ni nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa stong nyid du rtogs par byed do/ /khrirdo rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ /de nas zung 'jug bsgom pa ni/ sngar zhi lhag so sor bsgoms pa ste ༵/ra gcig tu bsres nas bsgom pa yin te/ sngon 'gro sngar bzhin/ dngos gzhi gang snang la dpyad ra

med par rang babs su phyal le/ bde lugs su shigs se rjes med du sangs te/ rgya yan du phyal le/mtha' bral du khrol le gzhag go/ /de'i tshe phyi nang bar med nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa 'char te/gnas pas zhi gnas/ gsal bas lhag mthong / tha dad thed pa zung 'jug gcig gi rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ /de nas dbang po 'bring gis bsgom tshul la gsum las/ stong pa nam mkha' lta bu'i bsgom tshul ni/ lus mi g.yo ba ri rgyal ltar rnam snang chos bdun bca'/dbang po ma 'gags pa rang gsal du dngas pa rdzing bu'i zla gzugs ltar bzhag nas/ gang snang yang snang thog der mi bzhag par stong thog gi steng phyi nang bar med har sangs su bun ne shigs se lta stangs gcun nas bzhag pas/ thams cad stong pa bar med nam mkha' ltar rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o/ /de nas gsal ba me long lta bu'i bsgom tshul ni/ lus gnad dbang gnad de dang 'dra ba la/ stong thog tu mi gtad par snang ba rang gsal 'dzin med kyi ngang la sal le wal le yer re bsgoms pas/ snang la 'dzin med khral ma khrol gyi rtogs pa 'char ro/ /khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o//de 'char ba rba rlabs lta bu'i bsgom tshul ni/ lus dang dbang gnad sngar bzhin/ khyad par rig pa'i dngas nas 'phro 'du'i rtog pa 'char ba la gtad pas/ rten med du 'dzin med grol ba rba rlabs chur jim pa lta bu'i rtogs pa 'char ro/ /khrid skang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ /de nas dbang po yang rab kyi bsgom pa ni/ bar med chu bo rgyun gyi rang bzhin gtsang chab kyi gzhung lta bu ste/ rig pa chos skur rtogs pas 'du 'phro chos nyid rol par shar cing nub pa'i phyir/ spang blang dang go sgrib gang yang med par thams cad rtogs pa'i gsal sbyang du shar ba ni/ rin po che gser gling du phyin dus sa rdo phal pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa ltar/ blo la ci shar rang byung gi ye shes su shar bas 'dzin rtog ye grol kun bzang gi dgongs pa las ma 'das/ yul du ci snang stong pa'i rang gzugs su shar bas gzung rtog ye grol kun du bzang mo'i klong yangs las ma 'das/ yul dang sems zhes tha dad du 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad gnyis med rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das te/ phyi dang nang med par ye shes kyi klong du shar/steng dang 'og med par gdal khod kyi khod du snyoms/ phyogs dang mtshams med par rang byung gi ye shes su shar/ phyogs dang ris med par chos nyid kyi rol bor shar/ bdag dang gzhan med par gnas lugs kyi ngang du phyin/ gnas dang dus med par gdod ma'i klong du phebs te/ blo zad kyi rnal 'byor pa chos zad kyi ngang na bsams kyang bde ba'i dus so/ /'di nyid rtogs pa bar med dang ngo sprad de rig pa rjen la phud nas zang nge thal le gcer bu lding ba'i shes pa/ rang bab ma bsgoms rnal ma la thag bcad nas skyosbru du gzhug go/ /khrid rkang brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o/ /de nas thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ bsgom tshul dang po gnyis kyi grogs dang rtsal sbyang bstan la/ tha ma'i rkang stegs tsam du byung ste/ 'di la zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel la bzla dang bzhi las/ dang po la'ang zhi gnas bsgrub pa dang / de'i bogs 'byin gnyis las/ dang po la snang bcas snang med kyi yul gnyis las/ snang med la beems gzung ba la/ phyi'i dmigs rten snang bcas bris sku la sogs pa ste sngar smos pa bzhin no/ /nang gi 161

snang bcas ni shes pa ha cang 'phros te mi gnas pa'i tshe/ snying gi nang nas padma dkar po'am/ rdo rje rgya gram la sogs pa rtsa ba zug pa mar mar nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du song bas shes pa brtan par bsam mo/ /sems zin pa dang snying gar bsdus la rtse gcig tu bsgoms na mi rtog pa skye'o/ /khrid skang brgya dang sum cu pa'o/ /de nas snang thed kyi yul la gzung ba ni/ gang yang yid la mi byed pa'i ngang la 'jog pa ste/ de'ang phyi nang gi dngos po gzhig nas stong par song ba'i ngang lta bu'am/ lha'i zhal phyag bsgoms pas rtog pa gzhan rnams der nub/ de nyid kyang rnam pa mi gsal ba'i ngang der 'jog pa lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /dmigs pa med pa'i zhi gnas skye'o/ /'di nyid mthong mthong 'dra la ma nges pa'i gnad zab yang dag pa'o/ /khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /de nas bogs 'byin ni/ 'gro 'dug cung zad byas la sngar gyi de nyid la blta/ smra brjod dang dran rtog cung zad bsres la zhi gnas la bltas pas goms te gong 'phel du 'gyur ro/ /ltengs na lus sems g.yengs nas rgod du bcug la/ de nas bsgoms pas mchog tu gsal lo/ /khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /de nas lhag mthong la bskyed pa dang / bogs 'byin gnyis las/ dang po la'ang snang ba dang stong pa gnyis kyi snang ba ni/ 'di ltar chos can yul gyi snang ba 'di dag sgyu mar 'dug /rmi lam du 'dug snyam du gang snang snang bden med dus la la bsgom mo/ /de yang sgyu ma lta bu dang sgyu mar 'dug snyam pa la khyad par che bas/ sngar lta bur bstan yang /'di dngos su bsgom pa la sbyar ro/ /khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o/ /de nas stong pa la sbyang ba ni/chos su snang dus nas cher cher bltas tshad stong sang sang rjes med du blta zhing yid la mi byed pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la gzhag go/ /sngar dpyad cing gzhig pa'i stong pa yin la/ 'dir rang sangs thug phrad kyi stong par bstan pas khyad par che'o/ /khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ /de nas bogs 'byin ni/spyod lam gang byed dang snang stong gtad yal stong pa gnyis bsres nas bsgom zhing / ltengs nas gzugs sogs du ma'i yul la skad cig kyang ma yengs par gsal stong 'dzin med du phyam phyam sbyang bas 'grub bo//khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o/ /de nas zung 'brel la'ang / dngos dang dgos 'byin gnyis las/ dang po ni lus gnad bcas la/ gang snang gang shar la 'dem kha mi byed par de nyid kyi rang dus char gzhi'i rig pa la cher cher blta zhing / phar mi dpyad pa tshur bzhag pa ni/ gnad kyi yang zab gal po che'o de nas 'phro gnas mnyam pa'i ngang la rtag tu gnas pas/ 'gyu bas gnas pa la mi gnod pa/ rig pa stong gsal 'char ba gsum 'dres kyi ngo bo sku gsum rang mal gyi dgongs pa la slebs pa yin no/ /khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa drug pa'o/ /de nas bogs 'byin ni/ nam mkha' dngas shing sprin med pa'i tshe/ nyi ma la rgyab phyogs pas nam mkha'i thongs su lta stangs gcun nas bltas pas/ phyi'i dpes nam mkha' dag pa ltar/ nang shes pa'i nam mkha' dag dus/ gsang ba 'od gsal snying po'i nam mkha' dag pa mtha' dbus thams cad las 'das pa'i chos nyid skad cig la 'char ba ni/ bal po kā ma shrī'i gdams pa mchog tu zab mo'o/ /ltengs na zhi lhag so sor rtsal sbyang / bying na gseng / rgod na dbab/ spyod lam kun datwe sdusre brtsal sbyang gi gnad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o/ /de nas la bzla ba ni/ de ltar

bsgom dus nyams dang sems gnas kyi sgom pa dang / bzang rtog ngan rtog dag snang 'khrul snang thams cad rten med stong pa chen po/ chos zad blo 'das chen po/ ris med mnyam pa chen po/ gzhi bral yangs pa chen por ro gcig pas/ gang du'ang ma 'dzin/ ci la'ang ma rtog /su la'ang ma 'dri/ gar yang ma brten/ snyems dang re dogs kyi 'khri ba chod la chos zad blo 'das chen po'i ngang la skyol cig /gdod ma byar med chen po'i dgyings su la smos shig /phyir ma ldog cig ces yin thog tu blo bral gyi gding bca' 'o//khrid skang brgya dang sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ /don gsum pa 'bras bu re dogs spang ba la gsum ste/ chos nyid dbyings kyi rang ngo / /dbyings snang sku'i rang bzhin/ sku las ye shes kyi rol pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma grub la gar yang rgya chad dang phyogs lhung med pa/ gang gi'ang 'char gzhi'i byed pa ni dbyings don dam pa'i bden pa/ rtogs bya rnams kyi mthar thug zad pa rnams kyi phyi mo/ thug pa rnams kyi mthar thug /gdod ma'i chos dbyings zhes bya ste/ de nyid kyang so so rang byung gi ye shes las gzhan na med de/ bla mas ngo sprad pa'i rang rig spros bral/ rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa 'di rang yin no/ /gzhan nas btsal du med do/ /gsang snying las/ sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal du med/ /btsal yang rgyal bas mi rnyed do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang sangs rgyas kyi dbyings de glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pas rang bzhin rnam dag tu bzhag pa tsam las ngo bo la bzang ngan med par shes par mdzod cig ces da ltar gyi rig stong chos dbyings lhun spub chen por thag bcad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang sum cu rtsa dgu pa'o/ /de nas dbyings snang sku'i rang bzhin la lnga las/ de yang dbyings de lta bu'i ngang la sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs par bzhugs pa las/ chos kyi sku ni dbyings de'i rang bzhin skye 'gag 'pho 'gyur med pa smra bsam brjod med chen por gnas pa'i cha de yin la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ 'od gsal dbyings na 'khyil ba/ rtag chad mtha' las 'das shing mtshan dpe lhun spub tu 'char ba'i cha de yin no/ /sprul pa'i sku ni 'char tshul go ma 'gags pas thugs rje phyogs med du 'phro ba'i cha de yin no/ /mngon par byang chub kyi sku ni dbyings na dri ma ye nas dag cing stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed lhun spub du mnga' ba'i cha de yin no/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ni dgongs pa dbyings kyi chos nyid dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med bar bzhugs pa de yin no/ /de'ang glo bur ba'i dri ma dag ma dag tsam las/ sems can pa'i dus kyi rig pa'i rang ngo stong / rang bzhin gsal/ 'char tshul la ma 'gags/ gang yang 'byung / shes pa'i rang bzhin las mi 'gyur ba 'di kho na sku lnga'i char da lta nyid nas gnas pas/ sku lnga gzhan nas mi tshol bar rang chas lhun grub chen por thag chod cig ces rig stong zang ka sku lnga lhun grub tu thag bcad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bzhi bcu pa'o/ /de nas sku las ye shes kyi rol pa ni/ chos kyi sku'i ye shes smra bsam brjod 'das chen po/ longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i ye shes mtshan nyid lnga ldan/ sprul pa'i sku'i ye shes ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa zhes bya ba yang / glo bur ba'i dri mas dag ma dag las/ rang chas su dbyings la cha tshang du yod pas/ da lta'i gnas skabs kyi rig pa la tshang ste/ rig stong so so rang rig /dug lnga rang grol rjes 163

med/ ngo bo dang khyad par ram/ chos can dang chos nyid rig pa'i cha cha tsam las tshang zhing / khyad par du'ang 'dod chags kyi rtog pa rang kar skyes pa de nyon mongs rang mtshan yin yang / de'i ngos zin nas ngang la bzhag dus bde la 'dzin med du shar ba de so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ yul la sdang par skyes pa de zhe snang rang ka /ngos zin nas dngas gsal spros dang bral ba de me long ye shes/ gang yin ngo mi shes par skyes pa de gti mug /ngos zin nas rtog med rang gsal du shar ba de chos kyi dgyings kyi ye shes/ kho bas nga mchog tu rlom pa de nga rgyal rang ka /ngos zin nas gnyis med rang mnyam du rtogs dus mnyam nyid ye shes/ gzhan la 'gran sems su skyes pa de phrag dog rang ka /ngos zin nas ris med du dngas pa de bya grub ye shes te/ rig pa la rang ma rig pa'i rtsal dug lngar shar yang / rang rig dus ye shes lnga'i rtsal lam rol par 'char bas/ da lta nyid nas sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i don rang chas su yod par thag chod la/ re dogs dang som nyi ma byed/ thag chod dpa' gding bskyed cig ces legs par ngo sprad do/ /khrid rkang brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /'di ni yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa kun las 'phags pa ste/ /blo rab skal ba can gyi spyod yul las/ /kun gyi yul min rdo rje rtse mo yin/de ltar bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /kun bzang rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas thob shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i don khrid byang chub lam bzang las/ tha mar dge ba bla na med pa rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas bstan pa ste gsum pa'o/ /de ltar rgyu 'bras lam bzang snying po'i don/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag rgya che las/ /yang zab gnad rnams phyogs gcig 'dir bsdus te/ /khrid du bsdebs nas skal bzang rnams la 'bul/ /phyi rabs dad ldan rjes 'jug rigs kyi bu/ /thar lam 'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog rnams kyis/ /skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams 'khrid pa na'ang / /lo khrid la sogs shin tu 'phyong par gdab/ /bsdus 'bring rgyas pa shin tu rgyas pa bzhi/ /bsdus khrid zhag re dmigs pa re re dbog /zla ba bzhi dang zhag grangs nyer gcig na/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i chos kyi mdzod khang bye/ /'bring khrid zhag gsum dmigs pa re re ste/ /lo gcig zla ba gnyis dang zhag gsum na/ /rgyu 'bras bla med theg pa'i drod tshad rnyed/ /thar lam byang chub snying por nges pa lags/ /rgyas khrid zhag lnga dmigs pa re re ste/ /lo gcig zla ba bcu gcig de bzhin du/ /zhag gi grangs ni bco lnga rdzogs pa na/ /mchog gsum snying po'i nges don mchog la reg /shin tu rgyas khrid zhag bdun dmigs pa re/ /lo gnyis zla drug zhag grangs nyer bdun na/ /theg mchog snying po'i don khrid rab rdzogs pas/ /mi sdog byang chub snying po'i sa la zhugs/ /de 'dra'i skye bo skal bzang brtson 'grus can/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rigs mchog 'dzin pa des/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs pa'i sar gzhol te/ /myur tu zhi ba byang chub snying por 'gro/ /de phyir phyi rabs skye bo'i tshogs rnams la/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag nges don snying por gdams/ /nyin mtshan mi dal dad brtson ldan pa yis/ /thar lam sgrub ces de skad thal mo sbyor/ /tshul 'di blo gros yangs pa'i nam mkha' las/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal rtogs pa'i nyi 'od can/ /dri med 'od zer stong ldan shar ba des/ /gangs ri ṭwāṃ/ dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i nags

khrod thibs po rab brgal te/ /zhi ba thar lam byang chub mchog nugs nas/ /rnam grol rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /chos tshul 'di yang bstan pa gnas kyi bar/ /'jig rten kun du 'gro la snang gyur te//dad brgya'i gtsug gi gus pas 'dzin byed cing / /phyogs dus kun du dar zhing rgyas par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i gnas gsum dge ba gsum gyi don khrid byang chub lam bzang zhes bya ba/bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi gnas la mang du thos pa'i nor gyis myug pa/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ me tog sprin gyi skyed mos tshal gyi nang /kun du bzang po'i khang bzangs su chos mtho ba'i khri rab tu bzang po la sbyar ba/ phyogs dus kun du bkra shis kyi dpal du 'bar bas shin tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā sarnyi tsisgyu bi sranta nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso zhes bya ba/ dpal kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma'i mgon po yon tan gang chen mtsho/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin gting mtha' dpag yas shing / /rgyal ba rgyal sras yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gnas//phan bde'i spren gung 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od gsal chos sku dri med rgyal ba'i khams/ /ma rig 'dzin pas srid pa 'dir 'khyams te/ /las dang nyon mongs mya ngam thang dkyil du/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal gso bya/ /grogs dag dal 'byor rin chen snying po'i lus/ /'gro drug nang nas rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /ji ltar long bas rin chen gter rnyed bzhin/ /rab tu dga' bas phan bde bsgrub par bya/ /dal dang 'byor pa de yang gang zhe na/ /bdag ni sems dmyal yi dwags ma skyes shing / /dud 'gro tshe ring lha dang kla klo dang / /log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs skugs pa ste/ /mi khom brgyad po dag las rab 'das shing / /mir gyur yul dbus skyes dang dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad pa ste/ /rang 'byor dam pa lnga yang tshang gyur cing / /sangs rgyas byon dang chos gsungs bstan pa gnas/ /gnas phyir zhugs dang gzhan gyis snying brtse ba/ /gzhan 'byor lnga ste dal 'byor bco brgyad po/ /rang la legs par tshang ba'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas thar pa bsgrub par bya/ /gal te tshe 'dir phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis nas bde 'gro'i sgra yang mi thos shing / /ngan 'gror rgyun ring yang dang yang 'khor te/ /spang blang mi shes log pa'i lam 'gro zhing / /thog mtha' dus med 'khor bar 'khyams 'tshal lo/ /de bas da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir/ /legs pa'i lam la mthun pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /dge chos mi zad tshogs gasgros bsten byas te/ /srid pa'i grong las rab tu 'da' bar mdzod/ /'khor ba'i chu gter pha mtha' yas 'di las/ /rin chen gru bo thob dus ma brgal na/ /gtan du nyon mongs sdug bsngal dba' klong du/ /rab tu 'khrugs tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /de bas myur du brtson pa'i go bgos te/ /sems dang 165

sems byang stog pa rab zhi'i phyir/ /ye shes dri med 'od gsal lam 'dzogs te/ /byang chub lam la bar chad med par mdzod/ /gang la bde legs chos kyi gzhir gyur ba/ /rin chen dri ma med pa'i snod rnyed nas/bdun ji'i chos char bsil ba mi 'dzin na/ /'khor ba'i gdung bas rang nyid brlag par zad/ /dpal ldan bde chen phan bde'i sprin tshogs can/ /ye shes chu bsil dam pa'i char chen yang / /dal 'byor sa gzhi 'gro sems gtsang mar 'bab/ /de phyir spro bas snying nas chos mdzod cig /ji ltar mtsho dbus g.yengs pa'i gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbral mgrin chud srid pas kyang / /mi nyid rnyed dkar lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /dal 'byor rin chen lus rnyed smos ci dgos/ /de bas di ring nyid nas brtson 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar mi yi lus rnyed tsam po dang / /khyad par can dang mi lus rin po che/ /rim bzhin dge sdig mi shes chos min spyod/ /dbang po tshang yang mi lus phal pa ste/ /yul dbus skyes kyang mtha' 'khob kla klo nyid/ /bstan la ma zhugs pa dang dge sdig 'chol/ /tshi 'di gnyer zhing 'du 'dzis rnam par g.yengs/ /mi bsrun 'phyar la phyi ma rgyang bsrings te/ /thar pa mi gnyer de dag chos thos na'ang / /mchog gi lus min rang bzhin bar ma ste/ /skabs 'gar dge la cung zad sems gzhol zhing / /phal cher sdig pas blo mig khebs pa'i phyir/ /rtags tsam bzung bas rang gzhan phan ci yod/ /de dag khyim pa'am dge sbyong gzugs gzung rung / /ngan 'gro rnams las cung zad 'phags pa'i phyir/ /mi lus khyad par can zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /rab mchog skye bo dri med chos kyi snod/ /thos bsam snying po'i don la dbang 'byor zhing / /rang nyid btul nas gzhan dag dge la 'god/ /sgrub pa'i ri rgyal rab tu mi g.yo ba/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan rnam pa de dag kun/ /khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba'i gzugs sla yis/ /mi lus rin chen lags par ston pas gsungs/ /de phyir dam pa rnams las chos thos te/ /chos bzhin bsgrub phyir chos la gnas pa dag /chos ldan rgyun bsring chos min 'gog byed cing / /chos don bsgrubs pas chos la gnas par mdzod/ /ring por mi thogs srid mtsho mthar brgal nas/ /zhi ba'i gling du myur 'gro mya ngan 'da'/ /gang zhig mir gyur dge goms mi byed na/ /de las blo gros blun pa gzhan med de/ /rin chen gling nas stong log byed pa bzhin/ /dal 'byor don med chud gson byed par zad/ /de bas rtag tu zhi ba'i chos mdzod cig /chos kyang sems la rag las de yang ni/ /dal 'byor la brten rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /rgyu dang rkyen rnams du ma tshogs dus 'dir/ /chos kyi gtso bor rang gi sems thul cig /'chi bas 'jigs pa'i skye ba mtha' med du/ /phongs dang sdug bsngal char bzhin 'bab pa yang / /dal 'byor don med rnam par g.yeng las byung / /de phyir mngon mtho nges legs chos rnams kun/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsams las byung bas na/ /nyin mtshan mi dal brtson pas spro ba bskyed/ /'dir ni 'dren pa mthong ba don yod cing / /chos thos pa dang bsgrub pa'ang don yod la/ /tshe 'di don yod phyi ma 'bras bcas kun/ /dal 'byor lus rnyed las byung de yi phyir/ /rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang sgoms shig /lhar bcas 'jig rten dbus na 'gro ba'i gtso/ /nyan rang sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po yis/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i go 'phang brnyes pa yang / /mi lus rin chen mchog las byungu bas na/ /lha bas lhag pa'i 166

lus zhes dal 'byor bsngags/ /de phyir mi nyid thob la rjo ba bskyed/ /rnam par mi rtog bden mthong ye shes sa/ /lha mi'i nang nas mir gyur rnyed sla ste/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab snying po yang / /mi yi lus rnyed 'bras bu 'grub par sla/ /de phyir theg pa che chung chos kyi rten/ /dal 'byor mi lus mchog tu 'phags par gsungs/ /ji ltar phongs pas nor mchog rnyed pa ltar/ /rmi lam nyid ces dogs dang 'jigs bzhin du/ /dga' zhing spro bas dal 'byor bsam par bya/ /'di phyir phan bde dam pa'i chos 'grub po/ /de ltar dge legs snyan pa'i bdud rtsi 'dis/ /'gro kun don med g.yeng ba rab zhi nas/ /nags mthar song ste nyon mongs tshang tshing gis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i le'u ste dang po'o/ /de ltar rnyed dka'i dal ba thob gyur kyang / /skad cig mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te/ /rnam par brtags na snying po 'ga' med la/ /dbu ba rdos 'dra yid brtan mi rung bas/ /nyin mtshan kun du nges par 'chi ba bsam/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde ba kun gyi gzhi/ /nyon mongs 'byung khungs cher gyur lus 'di la/ /gos rgyan me tog phreng sogs bklubs gyur cing //bzang btung bzang dgus mchod cing bsnyan bkur yang / /dus mthar mi rtag 'jig cing 'bral ba ste/ /wa dang bya rgod ce spyang zas 'di la/ /gces spras rtag 'dzin gtsang ba'i sems bor la/ /da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /sa gsum 'byor ba dam pa'i gzhir gyur ba/ /tshangs dang bde 'byung mig stong dbang po sogs/ /grags dang bsod nams gzi 'od 'bar ba yang / /'chi bdag gnas las rgyal ba'i skabs med la/ /bsam gtan grub pas bskal par gnas pa yang / /las zad tshe na 'chi ba'i skabs mchis shing / /lha dang lha min grub pa rig sngags 'chang / /mi dbang 'gro ba phal pa ji snyed kyang / /'chi bas 'jigs pa'i skye ba pha mtha' yas/ /tshe 'di mi rtag rol pa'i char spren nang / /'chi bdag glog gi phreng ba gar byed cing / /nyin mtshan dus rnams 'gyur ba'i char 'bab pas/ /sa gsum myu gu ji snyed brlan par gyur/ /snod bcud mi rtag srid ba chags 'jig gi/ /me bdun chus gcig rlung gis 'thor ba'i tshe/ /khor yug rgya mtsho gling dang ris bskor ba'i/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi yang mi rtag cing / /thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skabs/ /nges par bsams te snying nas chos mdzod cig /'jig rten 'dren pa rang rgyal slob ma'i tshogs/ /thub dbang sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /dngas pa'i mkha' la sdon med ri bong 'dzin/ /rgyu skar phreng ba rnams kyis bskor ba bzhin/ /lham me lhang nge lhan ner gsal ba yang / /mi rtag mya ngan 'da' tshul ston mdzad cing / /bstan pa rin chen nyi ma dpag med kyang //sngon rabs sngon rabs nub par gyur la stos/ /chu shing snying po med 'dra rang gi lus/ /sgyu ma'i khang pa 'dra ba cis mi 'jig /de phyir nges par 'chi dang nam 'chi dang / /'dir 'chi 'dis 'chi nges pa 'ga' med de/ /tshe 'di snon med rtag tu god 'gyur zhing / /'chi ba'i rkyen mang 'tsho ba'i shas nyung bas/ /tshe la long med blo sna bstungs byas te/ /di ring nyid nas chos la brtson par rigs/ /'byung bzhi 'dus ba'i lding khang sems pa can/ /g.yo ba'i kun rtog skye bos brgyan pa yang / /rkyen las skyes phyir 'dus byas 'jig pa'i chos/ /grong khyer rnying pa bzhin du mi rtag gis/ /myur ba nyid du dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /ji 167

ltar rlung dmar nang zhugs mar me bzhin/ /skad cig mi rtag g.yo ba'i rang bzhin dang / /glo bur 'chi rkyen drag pos gtugs pa'i tshe/ /yun du mi gnas nges par 'chi bas na/ /da lta nyid du dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /'khor dang longs spyod nye bar 'brel ba'i gnyen/ /gzugs dang lang tsho dbang phyug rigs bzang yang / /thams cad bor te gcig bur 'gro dgos shing / /gang gis mi bstongs dkar nag rjes 'brang ba/ /de tshe chos las skyabs gzhan 'ga' med na/ /ding du brtson pas ci phyir 'da' mi gyed/ /'di ltar 'jig rten snga phyi'i rgyud soms dang / /snga rabs skye bo dpag med 'das gyur cing / /da lta'i sa steng 'gro ba phal cher yang / /lo brgya'i nang du nges par mi rtag la/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang tshul de'i rjes su 'gro/ /rgan rabs gzhon rabs skal mnyam 'das la ltos/ /bdag kyang rang bzhin de las ma 'das pas/nges par 'chi ba bsams nas chos mdzod cig /sa gsum dmyal ba srid rtse'i bar dag na/ /'chi bdag gnas las thar pa 'ga' med de/ /kun kyang mi rtag 'gyur zhing snying po med/ /yid brtan mi rung shing rta'i 'phang lo 'dra/ /khyad par mi yi 'jig rten 'tshe ba mang / /nad gdon gnod pa du ma'i gzhir gyur cing / /mtshon dang me dang g.yang sa gcan gzan dug /rgyal po dgra dang chom rkun la sogs kyis/ /'tsho ba'i srog 'joms phun tshogs 'jig par byed/ /'tshe ba med kyang skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ste/ /nyin mtshan skad cig thang cig 'gyur bas spyang / /'chi bdag gnas su nye bar gyur pa ni/ /'bab chu'i tshogs rnams rgya mtshor snyeg pa'am/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub rir cing ba bzhin/ /zas bcas 'tsho ba'i rkyen rnams phun tshogs kyang / /dug bzhin sdug bsngal byed pa'i skabs mchis na/ /mi mabun gnod mang phun tshogs cis mi 'jig /des na 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur med/ /gar 'chi cis 'chi nam 'chi cha med kyi/ /don med slu ba 'jig rten chos spongs la/ /snying nas mi rtag 'chi chos bsgrub par mdzod/ /'dir ni bdag gis dal 'byor gru rnyed cing / /bla ma'i man ngag spu 'dzin yod bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal chu bo brgal phyir mi brtson na/ /de las bslus pa 'di na gzhan med do/ /gang phyir ston pas rab bsngags rin chen snod/ /nyes kun mthar 'byin yang dag thob bzhin du/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa mi 'dzin na/ /'khor ba'i btson rar rang nyid 'ching bar zad/ /kye ma ji ltar rdo la 'doms pa bzhin/ /'jig rten phal cher bsams shing skyo ba 'phel/ /bstan pas mi rtogs bshad pas go ba med/ /sang nyin 'chi yang rgyun ring rtag par 'dzin/ /'khor bas mi skyo nges 'byung rdul tsam med/ /shes bzhin nga rgyal go bzhin 'khrul ba byed/ /'du 'dzis g.yengs la nyon mongs char 'bab pa'i/ /'gro la nam zhig bdag gis phan thogs 'gyur/ /'dir ni nyes pa'i chu gter brgal 'dod cing / /legs pa'i yon tan rmad byung bsgrub 'dod pas/ /da lta nyid du nges par 'chi ba bsam/ /nyin mtshan kun du mi rtag 'ba' zhig bsgom/ /yang dang yang du nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed/ /des ni 'di phyir phan bde'i chos 'grub cing / /brtson 'grus drag pos sgrub la brtson pa dang / /tshe 'di blon thongs bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa 'jig /mdor na legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'grub/ /nyes kun mthar 'byin thar pa dam pa'i rgyu/ /chos kun rtsa ba mi rtag blos ba/༵8sa/ /de ltar chos tshul sprin gye rnga sgra las/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag zab cing snyan bsgrags pas/ /

'gro kun rnam g.yeng nyen mongs rtag 'dzin gyis/ /dub pa'i soms nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs 4 chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /tshe mi rtag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar mi rtag khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ /rnam par 'gyur bas shin tu kug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed nyid gsum gyis/ /grong khyer drug gi 'gro kun nyam re thag /ji ltar me nang gcan gzan mi rgod khrod/ /rgyal po'i btson rar chud pa'i 'gro ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal snga phyi brgyud mas mnar bzhin du/ /da dung thar pa'i skabs med skyo ba 'phel/ /bde thob sdug bsngal bral 'dod blo yod kyang / /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras nyid la mngon par rgyug /mar me'i 'od la gye ma leb bzhin du/ /'dod pa'i yul la chags sred 'dzin pas bslus/ /de bzhin ri dgas bung ba nya dang glang / /sgra dang dri ro reg gis slu ba ltar/ /'dod ba'i yul lnga dag gis 'gro ba bslus/ /nam yang bde med sdug bsngal gyur la stos/ /lha dang lha min dmyal ba yi dgas mi/ /byol song rigs drug zo chun rgyud mo bzhin/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud sdug bsngal pha mtha' yas/ /tshe rabs bgrangs tshe sems can re res kyang / /mdza' bshes dgra dang bar ma'i khur khyer nas/ /bde sdug phan gnod sbyin pa grangs mtha' yas/ /pha nyid mar gyur ma nyid sring mo nyid/ /de nyid bur gyur nges pa ma mchis shing / /mdza' bo dgrar gyur pa yang thug pa med/ /'di ltar 'jig rten snga phyi'i las bsams na/ /skyo ba bas kyang shin tu skyo ba 'phel/ /rang nyid grog zhur gyur pa'i lus rnams kun/ /gcig tu bsdoms te phung por byar yod na/ /lhan po rin chen bzhi bas ches mtho zhing / /ngus pa'i mchi ma rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag /sems dmyal yi dgas gyur tshe 'thungs gyur pa'i/ /zangs zhun rnag khrag mi gtsang khu ba rnams/ /phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i chu klung char mi phod/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams dpag yas nam mkha' 'dra/ /'dod phyir mgo dang yan lag bcad pa'i grangs/ /'jig rten rdul phran snyed kyis char mi phod/ /byol song spul bum gnod sbyin sto 'phye sogs/ /'gro ba'i khams gyur bde sdug grangs med myong / /tshangs dang brgya byin bsam gtan gzugs med dang / /sa gzhi rin chen bdun gyis legs skyong ba'i/ /mi dbang dpal sde gun tshogs de thob kyang / /ngan 'gror nyung bas ches cher sdug bsngal lo/ /tshe 'dir 'byor pa mtha' yas nyams dga' ba/ /mthon po'i rang bzhin can rnams tshe 'phos nas/ /dbul bas nyam thag yang bran nyid gyur pa/ /rmi lam 'byor pa gnyid sad med pa bzhin/ /bde sdug mi rtag 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /shin tu bsams na ches cher skyo ba 'phel/ /de bas grong khyer gsum gyi sems can rnarmas/ /'khor ba'i bde la chags med byang chub bsgrub/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'dod gzugs gzugs med de/ /snang dang byed snang mi snang grong khyer na/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed gsum gyis gdungs/ /sems dang yid dang rnam shes mched pa yis/ /yul rnams bde sdug 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi 'chad/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes yid dang sgo lnga'i shes/ /rim bzhin mched pa mched pa'i rim pa yin/ /de las srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'byung / /rtsa ba ma rig gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa can/ /yul dang don dang sems su bag chags pas/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin pas 'khor ba grub/ /sems nyid 'gyur med yongs grub chos sku yang / /ma rig 'dzin pas kun brtags goms pa yis/ /ma dag gzhan dbang ltar snang 'khrul pa can/ /169

yul don bdag gzhan gnyis snang gnyis su gzung / /de las sug bsngal dpag med lhun gyis grub/ /nam zhig 'gyur med sems nyid don rtogs nas/ /phyin ci ma log yongs grub lam bsgoms pas/ /dag pa gzhan dbang zhing du legs son te/ /srid pa'i grong las ngal gso byed par 'gyur/ /ye ma brtag dana' 'khor ba'i pha mtha' yas/ /srid lam dub pa dag gi kug bsngal ni/ /gang du skyes kyang bde ba 'ga' med de/ /mi dges bskyed pa'i 'bras bu mi bzad pa/ /rang snang log pas mi lam nang bzhin du/ /'gro drug so sor myong ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /med snang 'khrul bas sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /re zhig mdor bsdus lung bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /yang sos lcags kyi mdag me 'bar ba'i steng / /phan tshun 'dus nas mtshon gyis srog dang 'bral/ /yang sos sgra yis sngar bzhin sdug bsngal ba/ /las zad bar du de ltar myong 'tshal lo/ /tshe tshad mi yi lo grangs lnga bcu la/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha yi nyin zhag gcig /de nyid sum cu zla ba bcu gnyis lo/ /lnga brgyas yang sos zhag gcig gong 'phel bas/ /rang lo lnga brgyar sdug bsngal brnag dgos so/ /de nyid rab tu dbye ba'i grangs bshad pa/ /mi lo gye ba phrag 'bum drug khri dang / /stong phrag gnyis su nges par mdo las gsungs/ /jig nag 'bar ba'i sog les gshags bzhin 'byar/ /'byar bzhin gshog pas shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ /mi yi lo brgya rtsa gsum zhag gcig ste/ /de yi lo stong thig nag zhag gcig la/ /rang lo stong bub mi lo bye ba phrag /sa ya nyis 'bum dgu khri drug stong rtsa/ /bcu gnyis bar du zub par ston pas gsungs/ /bsdus 'joms brag ri rta dang rnga mo dang / /stag dang seng ge la sogs 'dra ba'i bar/ /rdul phran bzhin 'arjoms gyes pas sngar bzhin 'tsho/ /lcags kyi ljongs su tho bas rdul bzhin thag /rab tu bcir bas khrag gi rgyun 'bab pa/ /mi lo nyis brgya 'thab bral zhag gcig ste/ /mtshe ma'i nyis stong bkus 'joms nyin zhag gcig /rang lo stong phrag gnyis su sdug bsngal lo/de yang mi lo bye ba phrag sum 'bum/ /drug khri brgyad stong rtsa gcig thub par gsungs/ /ngu 'bod 'bar ba'i mes 'tshig 'o dod 'bod/ /lcags zhun bskol bar 'chod pas sdug bsngal ba/ /mi lo bzhi brgya dga' ldan nyin zhag gcig /de yi bzhi stong ngu 'bod zhag gcig ste/ /rang lo bzhi stong bar du sdug bsngal ba/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gnyis dang / /bye ba phrag dgu 'bum bzhi khri stong dang / /bye ba bdun rdzag bar du zub pa'o/ /'bod sgrogs chen po lcags khyim 'bar ba ru/ /'bar ba'i mes bsregs gshin rjes 'tshog bar bgyid/ /mi lo brgyad brgya 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig ste/ /de lo brgyad stong ngu 'bod che'i zhag gcig /rang lo brgyad stong nyid du sdug bsngal ba/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gsum dang / /bye ba phrag lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong / /drug cu rtsa drug bar du thub pa yin/ /tsha ba lcags khang nang zhugs mdung thung gis/ /klad pa 'gems shing tho bas rab tu brdung / /'bar ba'i me lces phyi nang kun du bsreg /mi'i lo stong dang drug brgya gzhan 'phrul zhag /de yi lo khri drug stong tsha ba'i zhag /rang lo khri dang drug stong bar thub pa/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya brgyad dang / /bzhi 'bum dang ni gye ba khrag khrig phrag /drug stong lnga brgya sum cu snyed mchis so/ /rab tu tsha ba lcags khyim nyis rim nang / /'bar ba'i the dang mdung rtse gsum pardo7 ṭwāṃsdun/ /snyi bo phrag pa gnyis byung leb mas dkris/ /zangs chen khol mar 'tshed pas sdug bsngal ba//

tshe tshad bar gyi bskal pa gyed thub ste/ /mi lo'i grangs kyis gzhal ba'i yul las 'das/ /'jig rten chags gnas 'jig stongs bskal chung bzhi/ /bar bskal gcig ste brgyad cu bskal chen no/ /mnar med lcags khang me rtse 'bar ba'i nang / /sems dmyal ku co smre sngags 'don pa las/ /me dang sems can so sor mthong pa med/ /mar me 'bar ba snying po la zhen bzhin/ /srog gi zungs tsam me nang dbus gnas pa1bar bskal gnas pa'i yun gcig brnag dgos te/ /de las che ba'i sdug bsngal gzhan med pas/ /mnar med bster med ces su bshad pa yin/ /gong du smos pa'i dmyal ba de dag kyang / /rim bzhin me rtse bdun 'gyur gyis tsha la/ /'og mar snga ma'i sdug bsngal lhag dang bcas/ /ji srid las ma zad par sdug bsngal myong / /nyi tshe ri dang ljon shing nam mkha' dang / /brag bar me chu nges med gnas rnams su/ /nyung ngur gnas dang 'dus dang gcig pur gnas/ /der ni sdug bsngal gang rung re res gdungs/ /de phyir nyi tshe ba zhes bshad pa yin/ /gzhan dag tshe dang kha cig 'dus pa nyung / /de yis nyi tsher 'dod pa 'khrul pa ste/ /brag bar sdig gzugs tshe yang ring yod la/ /nyi tsher gdugs tshod 'dus pa'i nyan thos gzugs//lnga brgya phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs bar gsungs/ /nye 'khor mnar med khang ba'i phyi rol bzhir/ /me mar mur dang ro myags mtshon cha'i thang / /chu bo rab med bzhi bzhi bcu drug go/ /mnar med sgo bye snyam las phyir 'thon pas/ /'obs bzang grib ma mthong nas phyin ma thag /mdag me bar ba pus mo nus brgal bas/ /sha kun tshig nas rus pa kunda'i mdog /yang sos sngar bzhin shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /yang ni bsil ba'i 'dam mthong zhugs ma thag /ro myags rul dri nga ba'i 'dam bying nas/ /lcags zangs gser gyi mchu can srin bus 'dzigs/ /slar yang thang nyams dga' mthong phyin ma thag /spu gri 'bar bas dum bur gtubs shing 'tsho/ /nags 'dab yid 'ong gang du phyin pa las/ /ral gri'i nags tshal las rlung 'khrug pas bcom/ /de 'das ri bo rab tu nyams dga'i rtser/ /sngon gyi yul 'bod mthong ste phyin pa las/ /lcags kyi thur ma rnon pos sha khrag gzags/ /steng du son tshe bya rgod klad pa 'gems/ /slar yang ri yi drung nas 'bod pa snyam/ /'thur du babs pas thur mas gyen du gzags/ /thang mtshams skyes pa bud med mche rnon can/ /'bar bas 'khyud de shin tu sdug bsngal zhing / /khyi dang ce spyang mang pos za bar bgyid/ /yang ni bsil ba'i chu klung 'bab mthong nas/ dga' bas song ste rab tu 'bog ma thag /thal tshan rted nub sha rus tshig gyur cing / /'gram gnyis gshin rje'i skyes bus bsrung bar mthong / /der ni lo stong mang por sdug bsngal lo/ /de lta'i dmyal bar su zhig 'jigs mi byed/ /srid na de 'dra'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /rang bzhin shes nas 'da' ba'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /grang bas nyam thag pa yang rnam pa brgyad/ /gangs sogs shin tu grang ba'i gnas dag tu/ /mun nag bu yug 'tshubs pas thebs pa'i lus/ /chu bur can dang chu bur rdol pa can/ /grang bas so 'thams smre sngags a chu zer/ /kyi hud utpal ltar gas padma dang / /padma che ltar gas pa'i rma nang du/ /srog chags mchu rnon 'bar bas za ba ni/ /ji srid las mtha' gtugs tshe g.yo bar 'gyur/ /tshe yi tshad ni ko sa la yi khal/ /bcu tshad nyi shu shong ba'i til nga nas/ /lo brgyar til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can tshe lhag ma nyi shur 'gyur/ /sems 171

ldan dag gis sems dmyal 'jig rten las/ /rab tu rgyal phyir brtson pa'i stobs skyed cig /yi dgas dbyings mkhar rgyu ba'i dbyings gnas pa/ /lus che rkang lag phra zhing sto ba yangs/ /mgrin pa phra zhing khab kyi mig tsam kha/ /zas skom mi rnyed bkres skom 'bar bas gdungs/ /sman shing me tog la sogs mthong bas bskams/ /phyi rol yid du mi 'ong ngan sgyugs za/ /zas skom mthong yang bsung bar snang ba dang / /nang gi sgrib pas lto bar me 'bar zhing / /kha nas me rtse dud bar bcas pa 'thul/ /spyi mabun sgrib pas dbur phongs 'jigs sngangs 'tshe/ /nyam nga'i gnas su mgon med sdug bsngal nyen/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags 'dre rnams dang / /gnod sbyin srin po btsan dang rgyal po sogs/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul thogs med kun du rgyu/ /gnod pa sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa ste/ /nad gtong mdangs 'phrog tshe la bar du gcod//tshe tshad mi yi zla bar nyin zhag gcig /rang lo lnga brgya mi lo khri lnga stong / /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag tu sdug bsngal lo/ /de lta'i rang bzhin skyo ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /don mthun skye bos thar pa bsgrub pa'i phyir//srid par dga' ba'i blo gros rgyang bsrings te/ /nges bar zhi ba dam pa'i chos bsgrub po/ /dud 'gro dbyings gnas chu gter bzhi yi khyon/ /gcig gis gcig za sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /gling bar mun nag rgya mtshor gnas pa yang / /tsha grang bkres skom gcig za'i 'tshe bas 'jigs/ /kha 'thor mi yul bya dang ri dwags sogs/ /rngon pas gtse zhing rang rang gnod pas nyen/ /rta glang rnga mor dang bong bu sogs//bkol spyad deg 'tshog sdug bsngal mtha' yas shing / /sha dang pags pa rus pa'i phyir 'chi bas rang bzhin sdug bsngal pha mtha' mi mngon zhing / /klu rnams nyin mtshan gyed ma'i bde sdug dang / /snga dro phyi dro 'gyur ba'i bde sdug dang / /kha cig gnas su bye tshan char 'bab la/ /la la gcig pur grogs bral phongs pas nyen/ /phal cher rmongs dang mkha' sding 'jigs la sogs/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs du ma ldan//tshe yang ma nges kha cig nyin re la/ /'jog po la sogs bskal par gnas pa'ang gsungs/ /'di dag bsams nas byol song 'jig rten las/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam bzang srol btod la/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas dge la gzhol bar mdzod/ /mi rnams la yang bde ba'i skabs med de/ /mya ngan yid mi bde dang 'khrug la sogs/ /gcig ma sangs par gcig gis sdug bsngal dang / /zas sogs rug 'dres zos pas 'gyur ba dang / /zas gos spyod lam nyes bas nad sogs su/ /phyi ma'i sdug bsngal 'du byed mtshon pa ste/ /sdug bsngal nyid gsum dag dang de bzhin du//skye rga na 'chi mi sdug phrad pa dang / /sdug bral 'dod pas phongs dang nye bar len/ /rnam pa brgyad kyi sdug bsngal tshad med de/ /ma rig rnam shes rlung sems zig ler 'dus/ /mer nur ltar mkhrang gor nya rus sbal 'dra/ /rim bzhin bdun phrag bdun du chags pa'i lus/ /ma yi ngal dung bkros skom tsha grang sogs/ /cung zad tsam la'ang sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /mun nag dog cing nyam ba dri mi zhim/ /'khums pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad brnag dgos so/ /bdun phrag bdun nas nyi shu rtsa drug par/ /dbang bo yan lag ba spu la sogs 'grub/ /bdun phrag sum cu rtsa drug bar snyed du/ /lus zungs brtas dang cher bskyed g.yo btwe ṭwāṃd/ /de nas rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcir ba'i bar/ /las kyi klung gis mgo mjug slog pas

btsa'/ /'chi bas nyen pa'i sdug bsngal bsdus 'joms 'dra/ /btsas nas reg pas pags pa bshus pa bzhin/ /khrus byas sha bur spu gis reg dang mtshungs/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /lang tsho nyams pas kun gyi yid mi 'ong / /stod smad mi theg 'khar ba la brten cing / /lus kyi drod nyams zas kyang 'ju bar dka'/ /mthu stobs nyams pas 'gro 'dug bsgrul bskyod dka'/ /'dod sar mi phyin ku tshigs rnam par 'gyur/ /dbang po nyams pas mig 'grib gzugs mi mthong / /sgra skad mi thos dri ro reg mi tsho/ /dran pa mi gsal gti mug gnyid du bying / /yul gyi longs spyod nyams pas yon tan chung / /zas sogs zhim po'ang de las log par snang / /tshe nyams 'chi bas 'jigs dang 'du shes 'khrug /byis bzhin bzod stobs chung la bsran mi bzod/ /snum zad mar me ji bzhin myur du 'gro/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur dang yid mi bde/ /yul gyi longs spyod yid du mi 'ong zhing / /srog dang bral bar dogs pas mya ngan skye/ /sdug bsngal mi bzod smre sngags 'byin par byed/'chi ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu chen po yang / /zas gos gtam dang mal gyi tha mar nyal/ /srog lus 'khor g.yog gnyen 'dun longs spyod 'dor/ /gcig pu sa tshugs med par 'gro bas 'jigs/ /mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal yang / /yid du mi 'ong gnod 'tshe'i 'jigs pas nyen/ /byams shing sdug pa'i yul dang bral ba yang / /myang ngan smre sngags yid mi bde ba'i gzhi/ /yon tan rjes dran 'dod pas gdung bar byed/ /'dod pa rnams kyis phongs pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ /don ma grub pas sems kyi zug rngu ldang / /dbul bas nyam thag bkres skom yi dwags 'dra/ /gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes te/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po yang / /zag bcas nyid phyir sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas/ /rten dang snod dang 'byung khungs lags par gsungs/ /de ltar mi yi 'jig rten mtha' dag na'ang / /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras nyid phyir bde ba med/ /de las thar phyir legs pa'i chos bsams te/ /'khor ba'i gnas las thar pa'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /lha min rnams la'ang bde ba'i skabs med de/ /don med 'thab rtsod 'khrug cing zhe snang la/ /lha yi dpal la mi bzod phrag dog ldan/ /g.yul ngor sdug bsngal brgya phrag brten 'tshal lo de bas dge legs zhi ba'i 'gro ba dag /myur ba nyid du thar pa'i chos mdzod cig /'dod lha'i gnas na'ang sdug bsngal tshad med de/ /bag med 'dod pas myos dang 'chi 'pho nyung / /me tog brnyings dang stan la nyams mi dga'/ /grogs kyis spong dang phyi ma'i gnas la 'jigs/ /tshor ba mi bzad lha yi zhag bdun 'byung / /tshangs ris la sogs gzugs khams bsam gtan lha/ /snga ma'i las zad srid pa 'og mar nyung //'gyur pa'i sdug bsngal mthong nas sdug bsngal la/ /gzugs med zhi gnas las zad tshul mthong nas/ /srid pa phyi mar 'du byed sdug bsngal ldan/ /mtho ris thob kyang yid brtan mi rung bas/ /skal bzang rnams kyis thar pa bsgrub par bya/ /'khor ba'i bde la chags pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /me yi 'obs su sred pas gdung bar zad/ /'di ltar thar pa rang la rag las shing / /thar pa'i thabs ni lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/gzhan gyis glo bur 'byin pa'i skabs med de/ /gnyid myos rmi lam sus kyang dgag med bzhin/ /gal te nus na bde gshegs sras bcas kyi/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis 'khor ba stongs zin nges/ /de bas rang nyid 173

brtson pa'i go bgos te/ /thar lam 'dzeg la brtson pa'i dus la bab/ /grangs med 'das pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis/ /gso ba'i spyod yul ma gyur bdag lta bu/ /sdig pa'i rang bzhin srid lam dgon par 'khyams/ /sngar bzhin brtson pa med yang dang yang / /'gro drug gnas su sdug bsngal gyed 'di soms/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mkha' ltar mtha' yas shing / /me ltar mi bzad yul ltar sna tshogs la/ /bzod pa'i sems khyod gnas min smad pa'i gnas/ /ngo tsha mi shes khrel bag bral ba la/ /thugs rje'i go skabs 'jug par ga la 'gyur/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i phrinalas de yang ni/ /gdul bya'i las rkyen dag las 'byung bar gsungs/ /de bas rang gi nyes kun shes byas te/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal snying nas dran byas la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun srid las thar bya'i phyir/ /zhi ba'i lam la yang dag 'jog par gyis/ /da lta'i sdug bsngal cung zad mi bajod na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad ji ltar bzod/ /de ltar bshad dang cung zad mi skyo ba/ /bdag snying lcags kyi gar bu chen po'am/ /rdo yi khams bzhin sems pa med par mngon/ /'khor ba mi bzad sdug bsngal can phung po/ /ston mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs kun nyon mongs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma'i 'byung khungs la/ /sems shes su zhig sred pa 'phel bar byed/ /de bas myur du srid las rgyal bar mdzod/ /de ltar bde 'byung chos kyi dga' ston gyis/ /grong khyer gsum gyi 'gro ba ji snyed kun/ /bde dga'i shas 'tsho sna tshogs sdug bsngal gyis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /'khor ba kug bsngal gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de ltar srid pa'i bde sdug mthod dman rnams/ /sngon bsags las las byung bar thub pas gsungs/ /'khor bar 'du byed las de dkar nag gnyis/ /dge dang mi dge bcu bcu'i rang bzhin no/ /de yi rten gzhi kun gzhi lung ma bstan/ /me long dang 'dra rtog med ngo bo'i steng / /shes pa gsal la yul du mi rtog cing / /'char gzhi byang pas me long dngas dang 'dra/ /de las gzugs sogs yul 'dzin dbang shes lnga/ /rang ngo mi rtog me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /de rjes bzung 'dzin yul 'byed shes pa rnams/ /skad cig rjes bzung de la 'dzin mi 'dzin/ /rtog dang mi rtog nyon yid yid shes te/ /de yang chags rtog rags pa'i dge sdig gis/ /'dod par 'du byed bag chags kun gzhir brten/ /mi rtog gsal snang gzugs su 'du byed la/ /mi rtog rtse gcig gzugs med bag chags brten/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin glo bur sgrib pa gnyis/ /dus rnams kun du nye bar brten pa yin/ /shes pa gang du'ang mi rtog yengs thabs tshe/ /snang yul mi 'dzin rtse gcig kun gzhi'i dus/ /gsal snang gang la'ang der 'dzin mi 'jug pa/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes dngas gsal g.yo ba med/ /sgo lnga'i yul dang dgag sgub gzung 'dzin gyis/ /tshogs bdun yul la rags par rtog pa na/ /rnam shes bdun zhes nye bar btags pa yin/ /'di dag goms pas khams gsum srid pa ru/ /sgo gsum 'khrul zhing sdug bsngal 'du byed yin/ /de yang 'dod par tshogs bdun gtso bo la/ /gzugs su kun gzhi'i rnam shes gzugs med du/ /mi rtag kun gzhi 'ba' zhig gtso bor ldan/ /gzhan gnyis 'khor gyi tshul du bag la nyal/ /rang rang sa der ldan par shes par bya/ /'di ltar 'a/ṭwāṃ na mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe/ /yul lnga'i shes pa rim gyis yid du thim/ /de yang kun gzhi thim pas mi

rtog pa/ /rtse gcig snang yul med pa'i ngang de nyid/ /chos dgyings thim pas rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /slar yang mched pas kun gzhi'i rnam shes las/ yid gnyis gcig pu langs pas mi lam sems sna tshogs dga' sgrub med bzhin snang ba byed/ de las mched pas gnyid sad tshogs drug gi /rnam shes yul la 'jug pas las 'du byed/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug de ltar snang ba yin/ gzugs su rang sa'i shes pa bsam gtan bzhi/ /kun gzhi'i shes nyid ngang du gnas pa las/ /yul rnams 'dzin pa'i shes pa phra mo rnams/ /skabs 'gar nye bar 'byung gis phal cher ni/ /ting 'dzin goms pas nye bar gnas pa yin/ /gzugs med rang sa'i shes pa kun gzhi'i ngang / /mkha' sogs rnam bzhi zhi gnas rtse gcig tu/ /nye bar gnas pas shin tu phra ba yi/ /tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming bzhi'i gung pong sems kyi rgyud brten nas/ /zhi gnas rtse gcig bskal bar mi sad de/ /rnam daphyod dge ba'i sa bon 'debs pa'ang med/ /de ltar bsam gtan gzugs med sems de yang / /snga ma'i 'bras yin zad nas tshe 'pho la//ngo bo lung ma bstan yin gti mug phyir/ /'khor ba'i gnas su phyin ci log rgyu 'bras/ /yang yang bskyed phyir de las thar dgos so/ /'dod pa'i sems de goms tshul ji bzhin nyid/ /yin phyir mtho dman thar pa'i rgyu yang byed/ /nyin dus phal cher tshogs bdun shes pa gtso/ /gzhan gnyis ngo bo gcig pa'i 'khor du yod/ /de yang gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam shes te/ /der gsal rtog bral cha ni kun gzhi'i shes/ /de yi mi rtog cha nyid kun gzhi'o/ /lhag ma drug kyang de bzhin shes par bya/ /gnyid du rtse gcig rmi lam sad dus na/ /kun gzhi kun gzhi'i rnam shes yid dang ni/ /tshogs drug rim bzhin gcig dang gnyis gcig dang / /thams cad ngo bo gcig pa'i dus shes bya/ /rten chos las kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa/ /ngo bo 'dod chags zhe ldang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed srid par 'du byed dkar nag gnyis/ /'khor bar mtho dman skung phyir mi dge ba/ /dbye na bcu nyid so sor snang ba yin/ /mi dge'i las bcu lus gsum ngag gi bzhi/ /yid gsum rim bzhin so sor dbye ba ni/ /srog gcod bsams bzhin ma nor gzhan bsad la/ /phyogs mthun deg 'tshog la sogs srog la 'tshe/ /ma gyin len pa gzhan nor brku ba ste/ /phyogs mthun g.yo sgyus pha rol nor la len/ /'dod log gzhan gyis bdag bzung nyid la spyod/ /phyogs mthun bgrod min rtsol sogs 'khrig pa'i chos/ /brdzun tshig 'du shes gzhan bsgyur tshig don go/ /phyogs mthun drang sogs gzhan soms slu ba nyid/ /phra ma pha rol 'byed tshig smra ba ste/ /phyogs mthun gzhan tshig gzhan zlos mi mthun byed/ /ngag 'khyal bstan bcos ngan dang bre mo'i gtam/ /phyogs mthun 'brel med brjod sogs chos min gtam/ /tshig tsub pha rol zher 'debs rtsub mo'i tshig /phyogs mthun 'jam sogs gzhan yid mi bde'i gtam/ /brnab sems gzhan 'byor mi bzod bdag gir byed/ /phyogs mthun thos sogs pha rol dpal la brkam/ /gnod sems gzhan la gnod 'tshes zhe snang zhing / /phyogs mthun phan par mi 'dod khro ba'i sems/ /log lta rtag chad sgyu 'bras med par blta/ /phyogs mthun sgro skur 'debs sogs phyin ci log /yul dang kun slong bsam sbyor ngan pa yis/ /mi dge'i las bcu spyad pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /rnam smin rgyu mabun dbang dang byed pa bzhi/ /las bcu chung dus dud 'gro 'bring yi dgas/ /chen pos 175

dmyal bar sdug bsngal rnam smin 'bras/ /rgyu mthun gnyis las gang byed der skye ba/ /byed pa rgyu mthun 'bras bu lags par gsungs/ /mtho ris thob na'ang tshe thung nad mang zhing / /yo byad mi 'byor dgra dang thun mong 'gyur/ /khyim thab mi mjos dgra zlar 'gyur ba dang / /skur pa mang la gzhan gyis spu ba dang / /g.yog 'khor mi 'dum 'khor g.yog ngan pa dang / /mi snyan thos dang 'thab mo'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /tshig gzung mi 'os ma nges sbobs pa dang / /chog mi shes dang 'dod pa che bar 'gyur/ /phan pa mi tshol gzhan gyis gnod pa'i gnas/ /lta ba ngan dang g.yo sgyu che ba ste/ /mi dge bcu la rim bzhin gnyis gnyis ldan/ /myong ba rgyu mthun 'bras bu lags par gsungs/ /dbang gi 'bras bu phyi rol yul la smin/ /de yang ma dag gzhan dbang gnas skabs 'dir/ /srog bcad pas ni sa phyogs gzi bajid chung / /sman shin lo 'bras me tog bzang btung sogs/ /mthu chung 'ju dka' tshe la bar du gcod/ /ma byin len pas lo thog 'bras mi smin/ /sad ser mu ges 'jigs pa'i yul du skye/ /log par g.yem pas bshang gci 'dam rdzab khrod/ /ljan ljin mi gtsang dri nga skye ba'i yul/ /dog cing nyam nga nyams mi dga' bar skye/ /brdzun gyis yul rnams mi mthun 'jigs dang bcas/ /'byor ba g.yo zhing gzhan gyis slu bar skye/ /phra mas sa phyogs bgrod dka' mtho dman can/ /ngam grog g.yang sa gcong rong la sogs pa/ /reg na mi bde sna tshogs yul du skye/tsub mos sdong dum rdo gseg tsher ma dang / /rdul dang nyal nyil 'bras ngan rtsub pa dang / /tsha sgo la sogs mi dge'i yul du skye/ /bkyal pas lo 'bras mi smin dus tshigs log /ring du mi brtan mi gnas yul du skye/brnab sems 'bras sogs nyung zhing cun pa mang / /bzang po'i dus tshigs 'gyur ba mthong bar skye/ /gnod sems lo thog 'bras bu tsha zhing kha/ /rgyal po chom rkun mi rgod sbrul la sogs/ /rang bzhin gnod pa mang ba'i yul du skye/ /log ltas rin chen 'byung khungs mi ldan zhing / /sman shing me tog 'bras bu nyung ba dang / /skyabs dang skyob pa dpung gnyen med par skye/ /skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu mi dge ba/ /gang byas de nyid 'brel bas sdug bsngal bskyed/ /mdor na rang bzhin mi dge bcu po rnams/ /dug dang 'dra ste gang gis longs spyad pa/ /che 'bring chung ngus sdug bsngal cher bskyed pas/ /dgra bzhin rab tu spangal 'bad 'tshal lo/ /mtho ris 'phen pa dge ba'i las bcu yang / /mi bcu spong sems pa dge ba ste/ /srog mi gcod dang ma byin len pa spangs/ /log par mi g.yem brdzun dang phra ma spong / /ngan 'khyal tshig rdzub mi smra brnab sems med/ /gnod sems log lta ring du spangs pa ste/ /chung ngus mi dang 'bring gis 'dod pa'i lha/ /chen pos bsam gtan gzugs med ting 'dzin 'brel/ /gong ma'i khams gnyis bde ba 'dzin par byed/ /'bras bu bzhi ste sngar gyi ldog pa'i dpes/ /dge bcu'i 'bras bu mtho ris shes par bya/ /de ltar dge ba bsod nams cha mthun bcus/ /bde 'gror 'phen zhing rang bzhin mi dge bcus/ /ngan 'gror nyung ba'i rgyu 'bras dkar nag las/ /blang dor byed pa 'jig rten dge ba'i lam/ /lha mi'i theg pa lags par thub pas gsungs/ /'dis ni phyi mar bde 'gro bsgrub pas na/ /thar pa'i rten du yang dag gzhag par mdzad/ /legs ldan 'gro ba rnams kyis bsten par mdzod/ /thar pa'i dge mchog 'khor ba risdo 7twe byed/ /de yang srid par 'du byed mtho dman las/ /dkar nag gnyis ka las 'das zhi la gzhol//

thar pa'i cha mazun la sogs zag med rgyu/ /dge ba bcu dang bsam gtan gzugs med dang / /pha rol phyin drug la sogs lam lngas bsdus/ /de yang gang zag chos bdag med rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel dge ba yis/ /srid zhir mi gnas 'gro ba'i don byed cing / /rgyal ba'i go 'phang mtha' yas bsgrub pas na/ /rnal 'byor dge ba 'jig rten kun las 'das/ /de yang dmigs bcas bsod nams tshogs yin la/ /dmigs med ye shes tshogs te zung 'brel gyis/ /sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas sku gnyis mngon du byed/ /de yang so so skye bo'i zag bcas te/ /'phags pa'i zag med mnyam rjes spyod yu la can/ /rim bzhin spyad pas thar pa thob pa yin/ /thar pa dge ba'i rten ni rigs yin la/ /de yang sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /dri med khams te rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs/ /de yi snang cha sku gnyis dpe rnam dgu/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin ye nas gnas pa ni/ /rgyas 'gyur rigs zhes bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /rtsa ba rig pa'i ye shes 'od gsal la/ /ngo bo dug gsum med pas dge ba yin/ /rigs de sad las sems gnyis rab bskyed dus/ /snying rje mngon bsgrubs kun rdzob bsod nams tshogs/ /bum sogs gsum dbang bskyed rim dag pa ste/ /stong pa rang bzhin don dam ye shes tshogs/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang rdzogs rim phyag rgya che/ /legs par bsgoms shing rim gnyis spel ba yis/ /nyin mongs ye shes gatshas gyur dge ba rnams/ /ches cher 'phel bas khams kyi sgrib sbyangs te/ /chos gzugs dri med nyi ma mthong bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten chos rab dge ba rnam pa bcu/ /bsam gtan gzugs med la sogs snang bcas tshogs/ /'jig rten 'das gang shin tu spros pa med/ /don dam ye shes tshogs te mnyam rjes yul/ /zung du 'brel par spyad las legs dgu 'grub/ /de yang srid par 'du byed dge ba ltar/ /zhi bar 'du byed tshul gyis las su bshad/ /srid las 'da' phyir las las thar pa lags/ /lam zhugs dge ba bcu yi 'bras bu yang / /rnam srin rgyu mthun dbang dang byed las te/ /de dag chung 'bring chen por spyad pa yis/ /gnas skabs lha mi mthar thug nges legs 'gyur/ /rgyu mthun byed pas ngang gis dge la gzhol/ /myong bas tshe ring ba dang longs spyod che/ /mthun pa'i khyim thab dgra zla med pa dang / /skur pa mi 'byung phan tshun mdza' bshes bzhin/ /tshig gzung 'os dang kun gyi rna bar snyan/ /chog shes byams ldan lta ba bzang por 'gyur/ /dbang gis yul bzang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs/ /bza' btung sman sogs 'ju sla mthu che zhing / /phyogs gtsang sman sosas dri zhim ngad dang ldan/ /ga'an gyis mi slu 'jisas bral sanod 'tshe med/ /skye dgu mthun dang reg na mchog tu bde/ /dus kyi rjes 'gro legs smin 'bras bus phyus /sa phyogs mnyam la mtsho bsil rdzing bus brgyan/ /me tog 'bras mang bzang dgu 'phel pa mthong lo 'bras sman sogs ro mchog bda' ba dang / /'byung khungs bzang zhing dpung gnyen ldan bar skye/ /skyes bu byed pa dge las dge 'phel bas/ /legs dgu'i bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa yin/ /gzhan yang snyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang brtson 'grus yon tan brjid/ /bsam gtan sems zhi blo yis grol ba 'thob/ /byams pas yid 'ong snying rjes phan pa 'grub/ /dga' bas phun tshogs btang snyoms rnyog pa med/ /mdor na bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab 'bras/ /gnas 177

skabs mngon mtho mthar thug nges legs 'grub/ /'di ni lam bzang shing rta chen po'i srol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phun tshogs sgrub byed yin/ /de ltar srid zhir 'du byed las rnams ni/ /beems la brten zhing sems nyid 'od gsal la/ /mkha' bzhin gyed po mi dmigs kros dang bral/ /bden pa gnyis don rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /gdod nas rnam dag med bzhin snang ba yi/ /las ni kun byed ri mo mkhan 'dra zhing / /rtag tu rjes 'gro lus kyi grib ma 'dra/ /gzhan du mi 'pho lus kyi bde sdug bzhin/ /rang bzhin bzlog dka' chu klung 'bab 'dra zhing / /mtho dman nyung gyed 'gro kun dbang po 'dra/ /shin tu rgya che nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra zhing / /dkar nag mi 'gyur kunda utpal 'dra/ /las rnams brtags na ngo bo 'ga' med kyang / /mi lam bzhin du bde sdug sna tshogs byed/ /blos btags las rnams dngos po mtshan ma med//rgyu 'bras mi slu rten 'brel zab mo nyid/ /yod min med min rang bzhin gnyis su med/ /ji ltar spyad pa de ltar rnam par smin/ /'di ni ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa'i yul/ /rnam kun mkhyen pa de yis legs par gsungs/ /gang zhig las 'bras khyad du gsod ba dag /mu stegs chad par lta ba'i slob ma ste/ /stong ba'i lta la gdeng tsam su 'cha' ba/ /chad pa'i mthar lhung 'og nas 'og tu 'gro/ /lam ngan zhugs pa de dag gnas ngan las/ /nam yang mi thar bde 'gro ring du byed/ /rgyu 'bras snying rje bsod nams tshogs 'di dag /drang don byis pa'i chos te sangs mi rgya/ /nges don byar med nam mkha' lta bu'i don/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnams kyis sgoms shig lo/ /chad pa las kyang chad pa'i lta ba can/ /dman pa las kyang dman pa'i lam zhugs dag /rgyu nyid bkag nas 'bras bu bsgrub pa mtshar/ /nam mkhar yin na bsgom yang ci zhig dgos/ /min nang bsgoms kyang ngal ba don med do/ /cang med bsgoms pas thar ba thob 'gyur na/ /nam mkha'i yid can rnams kyang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bsgom par khas blangs nas spyang rgyu 'bras grub/ /de phyir lam ngan de 'dra rgyang srings shig /yang dag lam ni rgyu 'bras rten 'bres te/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor lhun gyis grub/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i las 'bras kyis/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i lam bsgoms te/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'bras bu 'thob/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sems can don/ /snang la rang bzhin med par mdzad pa ni/ /dag pa'i rgyu 'bras zab mo'i rten 'brel yin/ /de bas nges don mdo rgyud snying po'i don/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'jug rim gnyis bskyed rdzogs kyis/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub byed yin/ /'dir ni srid par 'du gyed rgyu 'bras kun/ /cha dang bcas pa ma lus rab spangs nas/ /thar pa'i rgyu 'bras nan tan snying por bya/ /myur du mngon mtho nges legs byang chub 'grub/ /de ltar bde chen chos kyi char bsil bas/ /'gro sems sa gzhir tshogs gnyis rab rgyas te/ /las dang nyon mongs yongs gang srid pa 'dir/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /las rgyu 'bras kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /de ltar las 'bras ma nor legs pa'i lam/ /dam pa rnams la nye bar brten las 'byung / /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang tshogs/ /byang chub gsum brnyes dge ba'i bshes las byung / /srid na mngon ma/ sdude ba'i shas thob pa/ /de yang dam pa dag la brten nas 'byung / /de phyir skye bo dam pa bsten par

bya/ /ji ltar tsandan shing la 'khri shing dang / /mi gtsang 'dam du brten pa'i ku sha ltar/ /dam pa bsten pas rang nyid dam par 'gyur/ /ngan pa bsten pas rang nyid ngan par 'gyur/ /de phyir skye bo dam pa bsten pa dang / /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen spangs la nan tan bya/ /dam pa de yang chos tshul du zhe na/ /'jig rten 'dren phyir kun dang cha mthun la/ /'jig rten 'das phyir kun dang cha mi mthun/ /sgo gsum spyod pa kun las khyad par 'phags/ /zhi sku kun spyod gtsang zhing skyon med la/ /the tshom gcod mkhas gsung snyan dri ma med/ /thugs ri zab zhi kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod/ /yon tan mtha' yas thos dang snying rje che/ /shes rab rgya che dgongs spyod nam mkha' 'dra/ /phrin las tshad med 'brel tshad don dang ldan/ /byams ldan skyo ngal spangs shing rtag tu brtson/ /'gro ba'i kha lo gyen du bsgyur la brten/ /khyad par gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dbang dang sdom pa dam tshig gtsang ldan zhing / /rgyud don man ngag rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor phrin las mnga' brnyes shing / /lta sgom spyod 'bras nyams rtags drod tshad thob/ /brtse chen thabs mkhas gdul bya smin grol 'god/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs spren sung ma yal ba/ /de 'dra'i mkhas grub dpal ldan bla ma bsten/ /gang gi yon tan shin tu mtha' yas te/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur phyogs tsam rab bsngags na/ /srid mtsho sgrol bas gru chen mnyen pa ste/ /lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon bla na med/ /rgud pa sel bas yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /las dang nyon mongs me 'jil bdud rtsi'i chu/ /chos char bsil bas char smrin bzang po ste/ /'gro kun dga' bskyed lha yi rnga bo che/ /dug gsum nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po ste/ /ma rig mun sel sgran me 'od po che/ /skye dgu'i bde 'byung dpag bsam shing chen te/ /'dod dgu lhun grub rin chen bum pa bzang / /byams chen nyi ma 'od zer dpag med de/ /gdung sel zla ba phan bde'i 'od dkar can/ /dgongs klong yangs pas dri med mkha' 'dra la/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal gza' skar lhun grub 'dra/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin dpag med mtsho 'dra zhing / /thugs rje'i rlabs chen g.yo bas chu klung 'dra/ /rnam g.yeng mi bskyod gangs ri'i dpal 'dra zhing / /mchog tu mi g.yo ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ /srid gnas mi gos 'dam skyes pad 'dra zhing / /kun la thugs snyoms byams sdug pha ma
