'dra/ /yon tan mtha' yas rin chen gter 'dra zhing / /'jig rten 'dren pas rgyal ba'i dbang po 'dra/ /de 'dra'i bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ /gang na bzhugs rnams sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /mthong thos dran reg 'khor ba phyir bsnyil zhing / /rlabs chen phrin las khur chen dpag tu med/ /sa chen 'gro ba kun gyi rten bzhin no/ /dkon mchog bzhi pa bla ma sangs rgyas te/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug nye ru ka dpal nyid/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba gdul dka'i don mdzad pas/ /gdul bya'i ngo ni sangs rgyas kun bas lhag /dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la/ /sgo gsum zol med gtsang ma'i spyi bos bsten/ /de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i lam 'gog cing / /bde 'gro'i skas 'jugs 'di phyir phan bde mdzad/ /yang dag don ston sems rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir zin grol lam la 'god pas na/ /rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dad pa yis/ /dus rnams kun du skyo ngal med par bsten/ /ji ltar nad pas sman pa'i rgyal po dang / /dmangs kyi rgyal po 'gron bas skyel ma dngan /tshong pas ded dpon gru pas 179

mnyen pa ltar/ /nyon mongs zhi phyer nyes kun gnod bral phyir/ /skye shis 'jigs phyir don gnyis lhun grub phyir/ /srid mtsho brgal phyir bla ma bsten par bya/ /bla ma sman pa gdams ngag sman dang ni/ /rang la nad pa'i 'du shes nyer gzhan ste/ /nan tan brtson pa sman nyid bsten tshul dang / /zhi bde nad las grol ba'i 'bras thob bzhin/ /bsten tshul gzhan rnams tshul des dpag byas la/ /dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi yis bsten par bya/ /gzhan du skal ngan slob ma nyes kun gzhi/ /dad dang ngo tsha khrel med snying rje chung / /rigs dang rang bzhin kun spyod skal pa ngan/ /sems dang las dang nyon mongs dug lnga rags/ /chos dang chos min dge sdig bslab pa 'chal/ /sdom dang dam tshig mi bamung gnyen po med/ /rab smongs blo gros chung zhing dgang dka' ba/ /khro dang tshig rtsub 'phel ba de dag gis/ /bla ma ri dgas chos la gla rtsi dang / /rang la rngon pa nan tan mda' 'phen dang / /chos grub 'bras bu gzhan du 'tshong ba'i tshul/ /'du shes log pa lnga yis bsten pa ni/ /dam tshig med pas 'di phyir sdug bsngal 'thob/ /la las thog mar ma brtags bab col 'jug /gsar ngas yon tan brjod cing phyi nas smon/ /kha cig 'dres mas ngo skog ngan g.yo'i tshul/ /zur gyis bla ma nye 'khor sun 'byin pa/ /de dag gis ni 'bras bu mnar med nyid/ /skal bzang slob ma dad dang shes rab che/ /brtson 'grus bag yod dran dang shes bzhin ldan/ /bka' las mi 'da' sdom dang dam tshig bsrung / /sgo gsum dul zhing snying rje phan sems che/ /khong yangs spro ring gtong phod dag snang che/ /brtan zhing mos gus che ba de dag gis/ /rtag tu bla ma'i yon tan dran bya zhing / /skyon la mi rtog mthong yang yon tan bsam/ /rang snang yin nges khong la mi mnga' zhes/ /snying nas bsam zhing bshags bsdam gnyen po bsten/ /bla ma min nyes cha dang bcas spang zhing / /ji ltar mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ /bla mas bka' stsal nam yang mi bcag cing / /bla ma'i nye 'khor sdug pa'ang bla ma bzhin/ /bla ma'i 'khor g.yog slob mar mi bsdu zhing / /chos bshad dbang bskur la sogs zhus te bya/ /bla ma'i spyan sngar lus ngag yid bsdam zhing / /rkang pa brkyang dang skyil krung rgyab mi bstan/ /ngo 'dzum mi gnag khro gnyer bstan mi bya/ /bab col mi smra brdzun tshig phra ma dang / /gzhan gyi skyon brjod mi snyan rtsub mo'i tshig /ma brtags 'brel pa med rnams smra mi bya/ /bla ma'i rdzas la brnab sems mi bya zhing / /sder bcas gnod sems cha dang bcas kun bsdam/ /bla ma'i mdzad spyod sna tshogs cho 'phrul la/ /kha zhe 'dzol bas 'khrul par mi brtag cing / /'di ni mi rigs khong rang mdzad mod snyam/ /cung zad 'gal 'du nyes skyon log lta dor/ /gal te bla ma sngar bar mngon na yang / /rang skyon yod nges brtags la bshags bsdam bya/ /spyi gtsug bsgoms la gsol ba drag bo gdab/ /de yis mnyes shing dngos grub myur du 'thob/ /bla ma mthong tshe ldang dang phyag 'tshal zhing / /bzhugs tshe stan sogs mkho ba'i yo byad dbul/ /snyan par smra bas bstod cing thal mo sbyor/ /bzhud tshe ldang dang zhabs 'bring bsnyen bkur bya/ /rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod cing / /gus dang 'jigs bcas zhum pas gnas par bya/ /ji ltar bag ma gsar pa'i tshul bzhin du//sgo gsum zhi bas bla ma'i drung 'dug gis/ /'phyar zhing g.yeng la rgad bag bya ba min/ /phyogs ris ma yin khe ༵sdu grags pas min/ /g.yo sgyus ma yin de bzhin tshul mchos min/ /ngo lkog ma yin nye ring chags sdang

min/ /rang la 'byor pa yod na bla ma mchod/ /lus ngag zhabs tog bsnyen bkur sri zhu dang / /tshe 'di blo btang bsgrub pas mnyes par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi snyan brjod na'ang de bzlog cing / /nus pa med na slar yang yon tan bsam/ /rna ba dgab cing snying rjes phan pa bsgrub/ /de la mi brten bag phebs smra ba min/ /des ni tshe rabs kun du phan pa 'grub/ /dam pa rnams dang phrad cing chos rab thos/ /sa dang lam dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sna tshogs yon tan 'byor pas yongs gang zhing / /'gro la zhi bde'i dga' ston 'gyed pa yin/ /de ltar dam pa rnams la legs brten pas/ /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen ngan pa'ang kun du spang / /de yang sngar bshad yon tan mi ldan zhing / /log pa'i skyon mang sdom dang dam tshig 'chal/ /byams dang snying rje shes rab thos pa chung / /le lo snyom las mi shes nga rgyal che/ /ko long gdug rtsub nyon mongs dug lnga rags/ /tshe 'di don gnyer phyi ma rgyang ring 'phang / /chos ltar ston yang chos min zog po'i rigs/ /mi gtsang phung po lta bu'i bla ma ni/ /gdul bya'i bung ba mang yang ring du spatha / /dad ldan log lam ngan 'gror 'khrid pas na/ /thar lam 'dod pas nam yang bsten mi bya/ /sdig pa'i grogs po de yang spang bya ste/ /ji tsam 'gogs pa de tsam sdig pa 'phel/ /dge ba 'grib cing nyon mongs char bzhin 'bab//bde 'gro 'gog cing ngan 'gro'i 'bab stegs te/ /dam pa smod cing dkar po'i chos la sdang / /ngan pa bstod cing nag po'i chos la bsten/ /skal mnyam mi dge spyod rnams bsngags pa ste/ /rtag tu log lam ngan 'gror 'khrid pas na/ /blo mig ldan pas ring du spang bar bya/ /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen grogs bcas spangs pa yis/ /'di phyir bde zhing legs pa'i yon tan 'grub/ /rtag tu dge 'phel thar lam zab mo zen/ /skye bo ngan pa nam yang mi mthong zhing / /bde gshegs sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po yis/ /bdag la dgongs shing byin gyis rlob par mthong / /bde bar tshe yi dus byed mtho ris 'gro/ /de sogs bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ dge ba'i grogs po dam pa rtag tu bsten/ /de dag gis ni dge ba'i las 'phel zhing / /sdig dang nyon mongs 'grib la nyes pa 'gog /srid las mthar 'byin mngon mtho nges legs 'grub/ /tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi ma 'bras dang bcas/ /rtag tu don yod lha mi'i 'dren par 'gyur/ /dge ba'i bshes dang dge grogs bsten pa yis/ /dge tshogs 'phel zhing 'bras bu bde ba 'thob/ /srid na mi 'jigs phan bde dpag med cing / /'gro ba'i don gnyis 'byor pa mtha' yas 'grub/ /'di ni rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i sprul pa ste/ /snyigs ma'i dus su de ltar snang ba yin/ /de bas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skye bo dam pa rnams la brten par bya/ /de yis dag snang phyogs med 'char ba dang / /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /nyams dang rtogs pa rang bzhin gong du 'phel/ /gzhan don dpag med ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub/ /ji ltar bsgom zhing gsol pa gdab pa ni/ /rgyun du tshogs bsag sgrib pa sbyong ba la/ /nyin mo spyi gtsug mtshan mo snying nang du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma gang mos yi dam dang / /mkha' 'gro gnyis med mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i mthar/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor//yid kyis mchod cing 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /mtshan de rgya skad thog mar oṃ sbyin zhing / /tha mar aḥrdu gang 'dod sham bur gdags/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar 'dod pa yis/ /thams cad dkar po 181

'od zer rab 'phos pas/ /mi mthun phyogs zhi dngos grub thob par bsam/ /tshe dpal 'byor sogs rgyas pa'i las 'dod pas/ /ser po 'dod dgu'i char pa 'baibs par bsam/ /dbang dang dgug pa la sogs dbang rnams la/ /thams cad dmar po 'od zer lcags kyu'i tshul/ /bgegs dang gdon sogs tshar gcod mngon spyod la/ /thams cad mthing nag 'od zer mtshon cha 'phro/ /me dpung rtsibs stong 'khor los 'arjoms par bsam/ /sngags bzlas stong gsum g.yo 'gul ldeg cing 'phar/ /las rnams spub cing lhag pa'i bskyed rim bsgom/ /rjes rnams rim bsdu mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /dar cig glod la dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /so so'i las dang rjes mthun rtags rnams 'byung / /'di ni zab lam bde chen rgya mtsho yin/ /khyad par nad gdon bar chad 'chi blu'i tshe/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar pad sdong seng ge'i khri/ /mi 'jigs yangs pa can steng bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas dang dbyer med 'dzum mdangs ldan pa la/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma byang sems mkha' 'gros bskor/ /'og tu regs drug lan chags snying rje'i mgron/ /dus gsum pha ma 'khor ba'i sems can bsam/ /rang sems spyi gtsug rgyu 'thon dpa' bo'i sku/ /chu gri thod pa thogs pa'i rnam pa yis/ /lus kyi thod pa smin mtshams mdzod spur bcad/ /thod pa'i snyed pu gsum steng bzhag pa'i nang / /lus kyi sha khrag rus pas khengs pa la/ /bdud ji'i char bab 'og nas me 'bar bas/ /thod pa stong gsum dang mnyam bdud rtsis khengs/ /rang sems dipa' bo grangs med sprul pa yis/ /thod pas thams cad dus mnyam bdud rtsi bkye/ /zhi ba'i mgron mnyes tshogs rdzogs dngos grub thob/ /srid pa'i mgron mnyes thog med lan chags 'khor/ /khyad par gang gnod gdon mnyes bar chad zhi/ /thams cad mnyes pa'i 'od zer bdag la phog /nad zhi gdon zhi bar chad rang sar zhi/ /'chi ba kus shing dngos grub thob par bsam/ /rjes la thams cad mi dmigs sems kyi ngang / /sems nyid mi dmigs chos dbyings mnyam par gzhag /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dag pas bsngo ba bya/ /'dis ni mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /tshogs chen rab rdzogs sgrib kun bral ba ste/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa rgyud la skye/ /bdag 'dzin med cing nges 'byung blo sna thung / /bsam pa 'aspub cing snang srid bla mar 'char/ /nad gcod med cing 'chi ka'i 'od gsal 'grub/ /bar dor grol zhing don gnyis sun sum tshogs/ /de phyir bla ma bsgrub la nan tan bya/ /gang gis bskyed rim bskal par bsgoms pas kyang / /bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog tu gsungs/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa dam pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /yon tan yongs gang phan bde'i sprin tshogs can/ /sa gsum bdud rtsi dam pa'i char 'dod pas/ /thugs rje'i ngang can rnams la brten par bya/ /thog med dus nas nye bar goms pa yi/ /yid mkha'i nyon mongs gdung ba zhi bya'i phyir/ /nor bzang rtag tu ngu bzhin chos tshol bas/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /de ltar don spyod dbang po'i rgyud stong ldan/ /skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsir lhung ba las/ /nyes gyur log pa'i lam la brten pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ /thar pa'i lardo sdu rim gyis bslab par bya/ /lam rnams kun gyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro/ /skyes bu chung rnams ngan

'thos 'jigs pa ste/ /'bring gnyis srid pas 'jigs dang chen po rnams/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal cha dang bcas mthong nas/ /gzhan gyi sdig bsngal mi bzod zhi bdes 'jigs/ /rgyal sras theg pa che rnams 'gro ba'i phyir/ /skyabs su 'gro byed gsum dang bsam pa gsum/ /phal pa mchog dang bla na med pa'o/ /dus kyang bsam pa'i jes 'gro chung ngu rnams/ /phyi ma'i bde 'bras bar du 'gro ba ste/ /'bring gnyis gnas skabs ji srid 'tsho ba dang / /mthar thug nyan rang 'bras thob bar du 'gro/ /mchog rnams byang chub bar du rtag 'gro zhing / /ye shes gzhal med bsam yas bar du'o/ /yul rnams gnyas te bun mong rgyu dang ni/ /thun mong ma yin 'bras bu'i skyabs gnas gnyis/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur dam 'cha' de yang ni/ /dus gzhan 'grub 'dod rgyu yi theg pa dang / /da lta nyid grub rang sems 'bras bu'i tshul/ /rdo rje theg pa dag gi dbye bas bzhag /mtshan nyid theg las de nyid gsungs pa ni/ ming tsam mthun pas phyogs gcig nges par bya/ /rgyu yi yul ni dmigs bcas dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku mchog yin mtshan dpes brgyan/ /chos rnam gnyis te dri med lung gi chos/ /mdo dang rgyud sde theg pa sna tshogs don/ /gsung rab yi ger snang ba'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /de yang mdo sdi gsung rab bcu gnyis te/ /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyan lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod rtogs pa brjod dang de ltar byung / /gleng gzhi shin tu rgyas dang skyes rabs bcas/ /gtan phab rmad du byung ba'i sde rnams so/ /rgyud ni bya spyod rnal 'byor zub pa rgyud/ /thabs shes gnyis med pha ma gnyis su med/ /nang pa sngags te rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /de yi yig ge glegs bam la sogs yin/ /rtogs pa'i chos ni sa lam bskyed rdzogs te/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin ye shes snying po can/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin thabs tshul dpag med do/ /de yang rab dga' dri med 'od byed pa/ /'od 'phro sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring du song / /mi g.yo legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /slob pa'i sa bcu bcu gcig kun du 'od/ /sprul sku'i sa ste rgyu yi theg pas bzhag /rdo rje'i theg par yon tan rigs dbye bas/ /bcu gnyis la sogs rnam gzhag dpag tu med/ /tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam lnga dang / /rim gnyis la sogs zab mo sems kyi yul/ /dam chos nyi ma dri med 'od mnga'o/ /dge 'dun nyan rang skyes bu zung bzhi dang / /rgyal sras sar gnas phyi ste mkha' 'gro dang / /gsang sngags rjes slob 'gro ba nang du 'dod/ /'di dag dmigs pa'i yul te nam mkhar bsam/ /khyad par bla ma sangs rgyas gtso bor 'dod/ /rnam pa dngos yid gsang bas rab mchod de/ /bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas thal sbyar zhing / /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub bar du gzhan don skyabs su 'gro/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas yang yang bya/ /dgyes shing 'od zer bkye bas rang gzhan gyi/ /sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs dngos grub thob par bsam/ /de yis bsod nams tshogs rdzogs gzugs sku 'grub/ /mthar thug 'bras bu'i skyabs gnas chos sku ste/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs snying po don gyi lha/ /rang sems 'od gsal spros kun bral ba yin/ /de yi lam 'khyer skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ /rgyu yi thun rjes thams cad rang gi sems/ /don la 'gro bya 'gro byed gnyis med pas/ /ji bzhin ngang la de bzhin mnyam par gzhag /yul sems gnyis su 'dzin na mthar thug min/ /'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro smon pa med pa yin/ /des ni ye shes tshogs 183

rdzogs chos sku 'thob/ /rjes snang mi lam sgyu mar bsngo ba bya/ /bslab bya gnyis las rgyu yi rim pa ni/ /srog dang rgyal srid bya dga' la sogs phyir/ /bla ma dang ni dkon mchog spang mi bya/ /bla mar skyabs song mchod 'os mi slu zhing / /dam pa rnams la skur 'debs mi snyan spang / /sangs rgyas skyabs song lha gzhan phyag mi btsal/ /chos la skyabs song sems can 'tshe ba spang / /dge 'dun skyabs song mu stegs can mi 'grogs/ /de dag gzugs la'ang dad pas rab mchod cing / /nyin mtshan rjes dran rtag par skyabs su 'gro/ /'bras bu'i bslab bya mnyam nyid nan tan bya/ /bzang ngan mi rtog mchog dman blang dor min/ /spros la mi brten chos nyid gnyug mar sbyang / /thams cad lhun rdzogs dkyil 'khor gcig tu spyad/ /gtong rgyu btags pa khas len 'das pa dang / /mtshan nyid pa ni log lta skyes pas gtong / /bslab bya nyams pas dman par lhung ba ste/ /bag yod dran pas bsgrims te blang dor bya/ /skyabs gzhan gang gis slu ba de mthong nas/ /lhag par thugs rje'i lha la dad pa nyid/ /tshe rabs kun du 'jigs bral skyob pa ste/ /de las phan bde byed pa gang zhig yod/ /de na sems gtsang dad pa'i sa gzhi la/ /bsod nams ye shes char chus legs bran te/ /chos khams dge ba'i myu gu cher 'phel bas/ /rgyal ba'i phun tshogs lo thog smin par byed//chos tshul dge ba ngo tsha khrel yod shes/ /bag yod dran pa yon tan tshogs mang zhing / /gzungs sprin ye shes nyi ma sems la 'char/ /mi lam na yang mi 'bral mthong ba dang / /tshe rabs dran zhing rigs dang 'byor pas maldas/ /'gro kun dga' bas don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /mthar yang rang nyid lus can kun gyi skyabs/ /dpung gnyen byed pas sku gsum 'byor pa 'dzin/ /skyabs song yon tan gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkhas ches lhag bsod nams pha mtha' yas/ /legs pa'i yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhig brten mi bgyid/ /nyes spong zhi ba 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos rab tu phyag 'tshal zhing / /sa gsum bsod nams 'dren mchog dpag bsam shing / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /de lta bde chen yon tan mchog bsgrags pas/ /skye dgu dam pa'i spyod la legs gzhol zhing / /nyes gyur dman pa'i yul la brten pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ /de ltar skyabs sor rten gyi gang zag gis/ /byams pa'i sa gzhir snying rje'i me tog bkram/ /dga' ba'i grib bsil btang snyoms chu gtsang gis/ /'gro la phan phyir rang gi sems sbyang ngo / /de yang thar pa'i lam dang ma 'brel na/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi ste srid pa'i rgyu/ /zhi ba'i lam gyis zin pa'i de rnam bzhi/ /srid pa'i chu gter 'da' phyir tshad med bzhi/ /dmisas yul mtha' yas 'gro ba chos nyid la/ /rnam pa kun khyab dmigs bcas dmigs pa med/ /snga ma tshad yod nyung zad 'gro ba la/ /dmigs rnams ma dag dmigs bcas tshangs pa'i rgyu/ /'di ni dmigs med thur bar gzhol bas na/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bslab par bya/ /bde ba mi ldan sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag /skyid cing 'byor la nye ring chags sdang can/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms yul/ /rnam pa bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang / /dga' dang ma 'bral sems snyoms las rung 'dod/ /sgom tshul go rims nges pa med na yang / /dang po'i gang zag 184

thog mar btang snyoms te/ /nye ring bsnyams nas de nas gzhan gsum sgom/ /de yang dmigs yul sems can thams cad la/ /blo yi rnam pa 'di ltar brtag par bya/ /da lta pha dang ma dang bshes la chags/ /dgra la ldang ba 'di 'dra'i sems khyod ngan/ /thog mtha' dus med 'khyams tshe dgra 'dis kyang / /pha ma la sogs bshes byas phan pa bsgrubs/ /de yi drin lan gnod sems sgom byed dam/ /gnyan 'dis kyang ni dgra byas gnod pa bsgrubs/ /da lta na yang de yi sdug bsngal 'go/ /de yi lan du phan pa ji ltar rigs/ /bar ma yang ni mdza' dang mi mdzar 'gyur/ /phan gnod ma nges chags sdang rigs pa min/ /de bas thog mar mdza' bshes phyogs rnams la/ /bar ma bzhin du chags pa spang bya zhing / /de nas dgra la bar ma bzhin du ni/ /sdang ba spangs la nye ring med par bya/ /bar ma'i phyogs la'ang gti mug dbral ba'i phyir/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs snyam du sel ba'i blo/ /srid dang bral ba de 'dra rnam par bsgom/ /thams cad bde 'dod sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod gcig /'on kyang mi shes sdug bsngal rgyu la spyod/ /kye ma nyam thag 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tshogs/ /bag chags bcas kun zhi la sems snyoms shog /chags ldang drang pos gzer ba'i lus can kun/ /nye ring sems snyoms chags sdang bral bar shog /ces bsam 'gro ba gcig gnyis dang gsum/ /yul gru gcig nas gling gcig gling bzhi nas/ /stong gcig gnyis gsum 'jig rten kun la bsgom/ /'byongs ba'i tshad ni bdag gzhan dgra gnyen mnyam/ /rjes la dmigs pa med pa'i btang stoms yul/ /thams cad sems te sems nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ /don dam ma skyes stong pa'i ngang de la/ /blo yi rnam pa spros dang bral bar gzhag /'byongs pa'i tshad ni bra bzhi'i rtogs pa skye/ /'bras bu nye ring dzhag pa med pa'i sems/ /gnas lugs don la rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar kun la sems snyoms gyur pa na/ /rang nyid ma la bde dang phrad 'dod ltar/ /lus can kun la de bzhin bsam par bya/ /byams pa'i dmigs yul sems can thams cad la/ /rnam pa gnas skabs lha mi'i bde ba dang / /mthar thug byang chub bde dang 'phrad par shog /snyam du gcig nas 'gro ba kun gyi bar/ /phyogs mtha' gtugs par de snyed bsgom par bya/ /rtags ni kun la khyab pa'i byams pa mchog /bu gcig brtse ba'i ma bas lhag pa 'byung / /de rjes thams cad mnyam pa'i ngang la gzhag /dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa chen po ste/ /byams dang stong pa zung du chung ba rtags/ /'bras bu mthong na yid 'od dag pa 'thob/ /byams pas 'gro la khyab pa'i rjes nyid du/ /pha ma'i sdug bsngal blos mi bzod pa bzhin/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsams la snying rje bskyed/ /de yang bdag gi pha ma drin can rnams/ /bdasagi ched du sdig pa'i las byas pas/ /tsha grang bkres skom gsad gcad las kyis mnar/ /skye rga na 'chi'i chu chen 'khrug par bying / /sdug bsngal sna tshogs du mas nyam re thag /de las thar 'dod zhi ba'i sems med la/ /yang dag lam ston dge ba'i bshes med pas/ /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /'di dag mthong nas yal bar 'dor phod dam/ /de bas bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge bas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dag /skad cig nyid la 'bral bar shog cig ces/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bsam par bya/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod rtags su bshad/ /dmigs med snying rjes de rjes mnyam par gzhag /rtags ni stong 185

nyid snying rje zung du 'bral/ /'bras bu gnod sems rnam 'tshe bral ba'i sems/ /las rung gdod nas dag pa nyid du 'grub/ /de ltar snying rjes brlan pa'i 'gro ba la/ /rang rang bde bas gnas te dga' ba bsgom/ /de yang dmigs yul bde ldan sems can te/ /rnam pa e ma 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bdag gis bde la dgod par ma dgos par/ /rang rang bde ba bdag gis rnyed pa rab/ /da ni ding nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bde zhing skyid pa 'di dang mi 'bral shog /snyam du gcig nas kun la bsgom par bya/ /rtags su phrag dog med cing dga' ba skye/ /de rjes mi dmigs bsam gtan dga' ba nyid/ /lus ngag sems la zhi bde kun gyis grub/ /'bras bu 'byor pas brtan la dga' ba 'grub/ /de ltar goms rjes byams nas rim par bsgom/ /de yis bzhi po'i zhen pa rim gyis 'gog /byams bsgoms gnyen bzhin kun la chags pa na/ /snying rjes sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras zhen pa 'gog /snying rje dman pas dmigs dang bcas pa na/ /dmigs med dga' bas skyo ba rnam par 'gog /dga' bas sems g.yengs spros la 'chel ba na/ /nye ring chags bral btang snyoms chen po bsgom/ /btang snyoms bar ma lung ma bstan bzhin na/ /sngar bzhin byams sogs rim pas bsgom par bya/ /de yis 'byongs par sla zhing brtan pa 'thob/ /goms pa shin tu brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rim dngarim min spel ma thod rgal bsgom/ /de yis rtogs pa so mar bogs 'byin zhing / /shin tu brtan pas ches brtan nyid du 'gyur/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu bzhi dag las/ /rnam smin mngon mthe nges legs gnyis 'thob la/ /'dod par lha mi'i lus 'grub phan bde byed/ /rgyu mthun byed pas de nyid byed pa dang / /myong bas mi mthun phyogs bral bde ba 'thob/ /dbang gis yid 'ong bde zhing rab dga'i yul/ /'gro ba mthun cing 'byor pas brgyan par skye/ /byed pas bzhi po ches cher rab 'phel bas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa kun grub 'gyur/ /byams pas zhe ldang med cing longs spyod rdzogs/ /me long ye shes rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni mtshan dpes brgyan/ /snying rjes 'dod chags med cing chos kyi su/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed/ /chos kyi sku ni stobs sogs ma 'dres chos/ /dga' bas phrag dog med cing sprul pa'i sku/ /bya grub ye shes dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /sprul pa'i stu ni ma nges sna tshogs gzugs/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sku ste phrin las yin/ /btang snyoms nga rgyal rmongs med ngo bo nyid/ /mnyam nyid chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byed/ /ngo bo nyid su chos nyid spros dang bral/ /de ltar byams sogs yon tan mtha' yas shing / /mtshungs bral lha mi'i ston pas rab bsngags mdzad/ /de dag mi ldan lam de phyin ci log /ston pa gzhan la skyabs song lam ngan yin/ /des gzung lam ni thar pa dri ma med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba snga phyi'i gshegs shul yin/ /rgyu yi theg pas sa bon myu gu bzhin/ /thabs shes sku gnyis bskyed par 'dod na yang / /'bras bu'i theg pas sku yi sgrib pa gnyis/ /sel byed rkyen gyi rnam par khas len pas/ /thabs nyid snying rje tshad med lam la brten/ /don la gcig ste stong nyid snying rje can/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis kas mthun par nyams su len/ /gzhan yang thog med dge ba sa bon tshul/ /ma byas ye nas gnas par mdo nas gsungs/ /de dang sku ga/༵ ye ldan glo bur gyi/ /sgrib pas bsgribs te sel 'dod sngags nyid mtshungs/ /mdor na mdo rgyud

lam rnams gcig nyid du/ /mkhas grub rnams kyis phyi nang bshad pa mdzad/ /de phyir rgyal sras dam pa'i rjes 'gro zhing / /tshad med rnam pa bzhi la 'bad par mdzod/ /de ltar legs gsungs zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro kun sems kyi rgyog pa rab zhi nas/ /lam gol log dang dman par zhugs pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /tshad med bzhi'i le'u ste bdun pa'o/ /de ltar tshad thed legs par goms pa yis/ /chos kun rtsa ba byang chub sems gnyis bsgom//de yang nyon mongs srid mtsho mthar 'byin zhing / /'jigs dang mya ngan sdig kun sel byed de/ /las dang sdug bsngal 'du byed rnam par 'joms/ /srid nas zhi bar 'gro ba 'dren byed yin/ /gang la sems pa mngon gyur med na yang / /snying rje'i dge rgyun gong nas gong 'thel zhing / /mnyam gzhag na yang thabs shes zung du 'brel/ /lus ngag rtsom pa thams cad don yod cing / /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi mchod sdong 'gyur/ /dge gzhan 'bras bu dman te zad pa ltar/ /rin chen thems zin dge ba mi zad 'phel/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho dngas pa'i chu 'bab dang / /sa gzhi bzang por lo thog sun tshogs bzhin/ /kun gyi rtsa ba sa bon snying rje'i bdag /srid pa na yang bde ba'i 'bras mang zhing / /zhi ba'i rang bzhin byang chub mchog gi rgyu/ /rin chen sems legs bskyed la 'bad par mdzod/ /de ni dpal rgyas yid bzhin bum pa bzang //'gro ba'i nad gso bde 'byung sman gyi mchog /ye shes nyi ma gdung sel zla ba ste/ /mkha' bzhin dri med yon tan rgyu skar tshogs/ /rtag tu phan bde byed pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bsam yas bsod nams sprin tshogs dpag tu med/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan shin tu rmad byung dang / /chos kyi dbyings ltar dpag yas rgya che'o/ /sems bskyed pa ni tshad med 'gro ba'i phyir/ /yang dag sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ste/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin gnyis yin no/ /de yang bsam pas smon dang sbyor bas khyab/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba nyid bzhin no/ /smon pa tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo la/ /'jug pa pha rol phyin pa drug tu 'dod/ /gang gis phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por banyen bkur te/ /rang nyid legs pa tsam zhig don gnyer ba'i/ /bsod nams de yis smon pa'i char mi phod/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal nyung zad sel ba'i blo/ /skad cig skyes pas ngan song thar gyur cing / /lha mi'i bde ba dpag thed phyong bar gsungs/ /de bas 'jug pa'i phan yon mtha' yas te/ /dngos su sbyor bas yang dag khyab pa'i phyir/ /skad cig sbyor bas khyab pa'i sems mchog gis/ /bskal pa mang po'i tshogs gnyis bskums par bshad/ /de phyir grangs med gsum sogs gsungs pa kun/ /myur du rdzogs dang ring du rdzogs pa dang / /tshe gcig grol ba blo yi stobs la rag /de yang thabs dang brtson 'grus shes rab mchog /gsum gyis bsgrub gang bla med stobs che'o/ /'di ni snying rje'i ljon shing snying po can/ /'gro ba'i khur chen legs par khyer ba ni/ /tshangs sogs 'jig rten na yang sngon med cing / /rang nyid phyir yang mi lam ma mis na//gzhan phyir smos ci 'tshal ba'i byang chub sems/ /snga na med pa 'khrungs la dga' ba bskyed/ /de yang dge ba'i bshes las 'byung ba ste/ /yid bzhin dag las 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bzhin/ /skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma yis/ /skal bzang slob ma spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i 187

phan yon sogs/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge'i chos rnams dang / /byang chub sems kyi bsngags pa mtha' yas brjod/ /gnas gtsang mchod pas mdzes shing nyams dga' bar/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs la sogs sta gon bya/ /nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rgya mtsho'i spriṣka phung bsam/ /'di ni rang gi sems stobs dri med dang / /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rnams kyi thugs rje yis/ /ji ltar bsams pa de bzhin 'grub par gsungs/ /de nas thal sbyar me tog snyim bkang nas/ /spyan drang bzhugs gsol khrus rgyan gos sogs dbul/ /yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi/ /'char ka'i padma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas/ /mus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /sa 'di rir bcas rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du/ /bsod nams de 'dra 'jig rten gsum na med/ /lus btud dbang chen bar gyi rdul rnams dang / /mnyam pa'i grangs snyed 'khor los sgyur 'gro zhing / /mthar thug zhi ba mchog gi go 'phang 'thob/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /mchod pa bla med rgya chen rnams kyis mchod/ /me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas chu/ /bla re 'phan lding gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra/ /rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdza rnga la sogs dang / /lus dang longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog sras bcas mchod/ /lha sogs 'jig rten kun na yid 'ong ba'i/ /gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen dra ba can/ /glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bab cing / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag mnga' ba rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen ri bo nags tshal padma'i mtsho/ /ngang mo'i 'gros kyis gnyer ba de dag dang / /sman sogs dri zhim ngad ldang dpag bsam shing / /me tog 'bras bu dud pa'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /'dab stong g.yo bas bung ba bzung ba yi/ /lag pa'i gdu bu ku mu tas mtshan zhing / /sprin bral nyi zla'i zer gyis rab phye ba'i/ /utpal la sogs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /tsandan bsil ba'i kha yi spubs bskyod pa'i/ /dri zhim ser bu bde ba'i ngang rnams dang / /phug dang brag ri sman ljongs nyams dga' ba/ /chu bsil rdzing bu gang ba rnams kyis mchod/ /ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar ba'i ri bong 'dzin/ /gza' bral rgyu skar phreng bas bskor ba dang / /nyin byed 'od stong dra bas mdzes 'bar ba/ /gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ /khor yug ring bcas bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing / /ma lus yongs bkod 'dod dgus 'byor ba dang / /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kun/ /blo yis blangs te thub dbang sras bcas mchod/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang / /nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs rgya che bas/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams mchod/ /teng 'dzin yid kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /me tog sprin mdzes lding khang mdzes 'bar ba/ /spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung dang / /gzi ldan sgron me zhal zas rol mo'i sprin/ /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod/ /'jug pa'i sprin can shin tu mtha' yas pa/ /sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar sogs/ /mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro bas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus mnyes gyur cig /tho/ 8sdud dus nas goms pa'i bag chags kyis/ /las dang nyon mongs sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /srid pa'i

rgyur gyur de kun bshags par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams phung po mtha' yas la/ /rtag par bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /ma lus skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul/ /ding nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs par gsol/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ji ltar khrus kyis sbyangs pa'i ras yug dag /tshon gyis bsgyur bas kha dog gsal ba bzhin/ /de ltar sngon du 'gro bas thems sbyangs pa'i/ /rgyud las dngos gzhi'i sems mchog gsal bar skye/ /'di ni bsod nams 'bras bu tshad med de/ /chos dgyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /de nas sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /lan gsum bar du skyabs su 'gro byas te/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyis/ /byang chub thugs bskyed bslab la gnas pa ltar/ /ding nas bdag gis 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems bskyed bslab la gnas par bgyi/ /ma bgol ba rnams bdag gis bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol bgyi zhing / /dbugs ma phyung rnams bdag gis dbugs dbyung ste/ /sems can rnams ni mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /de ltar nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /byang chub sems gnyis bskyed la 'bad par bya/ /brjod pa dang pos smon pa sems bskyed la/ /gnyis pas 'jug pa sems bskyed gsum pa yis/ /gnyis ka brtan zhing dag pa thob par 'gyur/ /ding nas bdag ni 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang thob/ /srid na mi 'jigs 'gro ba'i don byed cing / /rtag tu phan pa 'ba' zhig kur len pas/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas par gyur/ /da ni sems gtsang dge ba'i sa gzhi la/ /byang chub sems gnyis myu gu rab bskyed de/ /de gzung dag pa spel phyir brtson par bya/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag gis blang bya zhing /bdag gi bde bas 'gro ba bder gyur te/ /byang chub bar du de dang mi 'bral shog /snyam du gtong len spel mar sbyang bya zhing / /smon pa'i bslab bya tshad med bzhi po bsgom/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs spang sems bsrung bya/ /'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol phyin drug srud/ /de yi mi mabun phyogs spang brtson par bya/ /rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod kyis/ /mi dge spang zhing dge chos rgya mtsho bsgrub/ /byang chub sems gnyis mi nyams bslab bya ste/ /log par lta sogs rgyal po'i nyung ba lnga/ /grong sogs blon po'i lnga dang phal pa'i brgyad/ /thun mong gnyis te nyi shu nyung byed la/ /de dang phyogs mthun nyes byas shes par bya/ /de dag ma ldan nyung dang nyes med de/ /dge ba'i phyogs mabun bslab byar shes par bya/ /mdor na nag po'i chos bzhi spang bya zhing / /dkar po'i chos bzhi dag la nan tan bya/ /mchod 'os slu dang 'gyod pa med la bskyed/ /dam pa rnams la mi snyan sgrogs pa dang / /'gro ba'i nang na g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa/ /nag po'i chos bzhi lags pas spang 'tshal lo/ /dam pa bsten zhing yon tan bsngags pa brjod/ /sems can rnams ni yang dag dge la bskul/ /rgyal sras rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas 'gro la phan bde byed/ /dkar po'i chos rab bzhi po bsten par mdzod/ /rang don las kyang gzhan phan gtsor 'dzin pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa ste/ /gzhan don 'gyur na lus ngag mi dge bdun/ /189

gnang ba'i skabs yod don la dge ba yin/ /yid gsum nam yang gnang ba'i skabs med do/ /rang don zhi bde 'dod pa'i dge ba yang / /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i kung ba ste/ /gzhan phyir phan na mi dge gang lags pa/ /de yang bslab bya lags par rgyal bas gsungs/ /rgyal sras de yang rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /rang nyid grol nas 'gro ba sgrol 'dod pa/ /rgyal po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang dang 'gro ba mnyam du thar 'dod pa/ /gru pa lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'gro ba bsgral nas rang nyid zhi 'dod pa/ /rdzi bo lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' gsum/ /rim bzhin grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum dang / /bdun dang gsum gyis grol ba thob pa ni/ /dbang po'i rim pa lags par mdo las gsungs/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis kun la bslab pa ste/ /gtso bor pha rol phyin pa drug la bslab/ /'gro ba dbul bas nyam thag mthong nas ni/ /zas gos rta dang shing rta glang po sogs/ /mkho dgu'i yo byad dpag med gtong ba ste/ /bu dang bu mo la sogs gtong ba che/ /mgo dang mig sogs shin tu gtong ba ste/ /zang zing dang ni chos kyis pan pa bsgrub/ /des ni rang gi ser sna'i tshogs 'joms shing / /gzhan gyi 'byor pa nye bar skye bar 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni rgyud bldams shing / /sems kyis dge ba zhi ba rnam bsgrubs la/ /shes rab kyis ni don gnyis sun tshogs 'thob/ /sdom dang chos sdud sems can don byed de/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis tshul khrims gsum rtag bsrung / /khyim pas dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas smon 'jug la/ /rab tu byung bas dge slong dge tshul dang / /dge slob ma yi sdom pa gang yin steng / /byang chub sems gnyis bsrung ba tshul khrims yin/ /phyi nang gnod pa sna tshogs sdug bsngal la/ /ji mi snyam dang snying rjes chos la som/ /dmigs med bzod pa gsum yang bsgrub par bya/ /zhe sdang lta bu'i ldig pa 'ga' med la/ /bzod mtshungs dka' thub bsod nams gzhan med pas/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bzod la nan tan du/ /khro ba'i me chen 'jil la brtson par bya/ /gnod pa'i yul rnams mi bsrun grangs med pas/ /re re zhing yang gdul bar yong mi lang / /sems gcig btul bas thams cad dul 'gyur ba/ /sems 'dul brtul zhugs bsrung la nan tan mdzod/ /gnod la brten nas bzod pa'i legs pa 'grub/ /snying rje dang ni byams sogs yon tan skye/ /byang chub grogs gyur dgra la ston pa bzhin/ /gus dang kro bas bzod pa nye bar bsten/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid med na mi 'byung la/ /brag ca bzhin du phan tshun brten pa can/ /rang gis nyes gyur gnod pa'i tshogs rab 'di/ /'phral gyi rkyen dang sngon las rgyus bskyed phyir/ /'di 'byung rigs te las zad thabs 'di la/ /ci nas sems 'dul gcig pu bsran tshugs bya/ /mi 'dod thog tu bab la mi dga' btang / /bcos su yod na mi dgar ci dgos la/ /med na phan pa med pas ci byar yod/ /de bas rkyen rnams bzod la nan tan bya/ /brtags na mkha' bzhin stong pa'i rang bzhin la//dga' dang mi dga' shor god legs nyes med/ /de la gnyis su bzung yang don med kyis/ /thams cad mnyam nyid ngang la nan tan mdzod/ /gang la brtson pa'i rang bzhin dge la spro/ /de la dge chos mi zad spren bzhin 'du/ /dri zhim padma'i tshal du bung ba bzhin/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs gang le lo gsum/ /bya ba nga/ ༵na sgyid lug bdag nyid brnyas/ /legs pa mi 'grub nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sun tshogs nyams

la rgud pa skye bar 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa 'jig rten gyis bstod cing / /brtson 'grus ldan pa mi yi bsam pa 'grub/ /brtson 'aspus ldan pa yon tan tshogs 'phel zhing / /brtson 'grus ldan pa mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /de yang 'jig rten dge chos mchog rnams dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam ni gang yin pa/ /zag bcas zag pa med pa'i chos rnams la/ /mi dge spang zhing dge ba bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'bad rtsol brtson pas yang dag gnas par bya/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar du ni/ /ches cher gong du yang dag 'gror yod pas/ /de srid mi ngal 'bad pas brtson 'aspus brtsam/ /bsam gtan 'dod pas rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi spang / /yul gyi dga' ba ston ka'i sprin 'dra zhing / /glog ltar mi brtan g.yo ba'i rang bzhin te/ /longs spyod mi rtag sgyu ma'i khang bzangs 'dra/ /nam yang yid brtan mi rung de spangs te//myur ba nyid du zhi ba'i nags 'dab bsten/ /'dod pa rnams ni phung krol bskyed pa ste/ bsag dang baspung dang tshol bas sdug bsngal zhing / /khengs dang sred dang 'jungs pas ser sna 'phel/ /ngan 'gror 'khrid cing bde 'gro'i lam 'gog pas/ /'dod pa chung dang chog shes ldan par bya/ /lus me ji snyed sdug bsngal khyab pa ltar/ /nor mang ji snyed sdug bsngal de bas mang / /yo byad bskungs rnams bde ba mtha' yas te/ /'tshe ba nyung zhing dgra rkun 'jigs pa med/ /kun gyis bstod cing 'phags pa'i lam la gnas/ /bya ba nyung zhing sems las chung bas na/ /rtag tu 'dod pa chung la bslab par bya/ /byis dang 'grogs pa'i nyes pa tshad med de/ /sdig pa 'phel zhing mi dge ngang gis 'go /dge ba 'grib cing rtsod dang nyon mongs skye/ /byas pa mi gzo nam yang mgu bar dka'/ /don med bya ba mang zhing 'du 'dzis g.yeng / /me dang sbrul dang gcan gzan khrod 'dra ba'i/ /byis pa rnams las thag ring 'byol bar bya/ /ji srid sems la brtan pa ma thob bar/ /phyi rol yul gyis rab tu slu bas na/ /dben pa'i nags su spro bas gnas par bya//ji srid skyes bu bzhi yis bteg pa'i lus/ /ngud mo'i sgra dang bcas par ma gyur bar/ /bdag ni zhi ba'i dgon par rab phyogs te/ /las sems 'du 'dzi'i dgra las rgyal bar bya/ /nags ni chu gtsang me rtog 'bras mang zhing / /brag ri'i phug dang rdo lab khang bzangs mang / /dud pa'i ljon shing grib mas brgyan pa'i khrod/ /bya dang ri dwags mang po gar byed cing / /chu 'gram me tog bung ba glu lan mdzis/ /spos dang sman sogs dri zhim ngad ldang zhing / /dben zhing nyams dga' bsam gtan ngang gis 'phel/ /dus bzhir dga' bas padma'i mtsho 'dra zhing / /so ga dbyar dang ston dus dgun dang dpyid/ /rim gyis 'gyur bas mi rtag skyo shas 'phel/ /dur khrod rus pa 'thor ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /bdag gi lus kyang de 'dra'i ngang tshul can/ /so sor 'gyes chos can du mthong bar 'gyur/ /'dus byas snying po med pa'i 'khor ba la/ /dga' ba'i blo gros gang yin ring du byed/ /rtsod dang nyon mongs med cing rtag zhi bas/ /rang gi sems ni las rung bde ba 'thob/ /de 'dra'i nags ni rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags/ /srid la skyo bas dgon par rab phyogs te/ /gom pa bdun tsam bor ba'i bsod nams ni/ /gang gis bskal pa gaṅgā'i sangs rgyas la//bskal par mchod pa'i bsod nams phung po yis/ /snga ma'i bsod nams brgya stong char mi phod/ /de phyir zhi ba'i nags 'dab bsten par bya/ /der ni stan la skyil krung rab bcas nas/ /rtse gcig soms la mi 191

g.yo mnyam par gzhag /byis pa nyer spyod don rab 'gyed pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan dam pa bsgrub/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang de bzhin gzugs med bzhi/ /lam ma zhugs dang zhugs zin 'phags rnams kyis/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi ming rnams shes par bya/ /des ni 'dod yon dga' ba'i sems sbong zhing / /rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub/ /spyan dang rdzu 'phrul soms la rang dbang bsgyur/ /shes rab gsum ste thos bsam sgom pa nyid/ /lhag mthong grub pas ston mongs tshogs spong zhing / /chos dang chos can gnas lugs rab shes nas/ /srid pa'i grong las mya ngan 'das zhir 'gro//snang 'di gdod nas ma skyes gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /ngo bo med la sna tshogs snang ba ste/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i rten 'brel mthong nas ni/ /mi gnas mchog gi go 'phang myur du reg /shes rab ldan pa thabs kyis grol 'gyur te/ /ji ltar dug la sngags kyis btab pa bzhin/ /shes rab med na thabs kyis 'ching 'gyur te/ /sman nyid nad du song bas gdung ba bzhin/ /de phyir gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod pa na/ /sgyu ma'i skye bo ji bzhin shes par bya/ /'khor gsum mi rtog dge ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar dge legs sprin gyi bzhon pa yis//'gro sems gtsang ma'i lo thog legs bskrun te/ /srid pa'i nyes tshogs dbul bas rab phongs pa'i/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po segs nyid ngal gso las/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/ /de ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /gsang sngags phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don la 'jug /de yang thabs mang dka' ba med phyir dang / /don gcig na yang 'jug tshul ma smongs dang / /dbang po shin tu rnon po'i dbang mdzad de/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med bzhi bstan/ /dus dang mi rigs dbang po'i rim pa ste/ /rdzogs ldan sum ldan nyis ldan rtsod ldan dang / /bram ze rje'u rigs rgyal rigs gdol pa'am dmangs/ /rtul po 'bring rnon shin tu rnon po la/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra gtsor ston bya ba'i rgyud/ /lus ngag bya dang sems kyi sgom pa kun/ /cha mnyam ston pa spyod pa'i rgyud sde dang / /sgom pa gtsor ston lus ngag spyod pa kun/ /grogs tsam ston pa rnal 'byor rgyud dang ni/ /sgo gsum bya bral gzung 'dzin mi dmigs par/ /sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal brtul zhugs mchog /gtsang sbra chung rnams dor ni rnal 'byor che/ /de yang bya spyod rnal 'byor thub pa rgyud/ /gi ya u pa yo ga zhes bya'o/ /de dag gsang sngags gyi ste lha rnams kyang / /yab yum zung 'brel bsgom par mi nus shing / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs bsten mi byed/ /gtsang sbra kun du spyod pas gnas pa yin/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud la'angs gsum yin te/ /pha ma gnyis su med pa bla na med/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis med gtso bor ston pa ste/ /ma hā a nu a ti zhes bya'o/ /lha yang 'khril sbyor dam rdzas khyad par can/ /gtsang btsog gnyis med thams cad ro gcig tu/ /dkyil 'khor gcig gi rol par ston pa yin/ /bya bas rang nyid dman la lha nyid mchog /rje khol tshul du bsgrub pas dngos grub len/ /spyod pas rang dang lha nyid mnyam par blta/ /rang nyid dam tshig mdun du ye shes lha/ /grogs po'i tshul gyis dngos spub len pa yin/ /rnal 'byor dasdosdu gzhir gnyis su med pa la/ /sbyor rjes lha ni dgug gshegs gnyis su byed/ /chu la chu bzhag gnyis

med dngos grub len/ /ma hās rlung dang bskyed rim thabs gtso la/ /a nus khams dang rdzogs rim shes rab gtso/ /a tis thams cad gnyis med ye shes gtso/ /kun kyang chos kun ye nas mnyam pa nyid/ /yin par shes pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len/ /bdag dang 'gro kun ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs kun/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu gsal btab rim gnyis bsgom/ /de yang skye bzhi'i rim pas sgom tshul bzhi/ /sgong skyes bag chags sbyang phyir sngon 'gro'i tshe/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bskyed rim mdor bsdus nas/ /bsod nams zhing rab spyan drangs mchod pa'i mthar/ /rang bzhin med bsgom tshogs gnyis sngon song nas/ /gdod kyis bskyed rdzogs rgyas par bsgom pa ni/ /thog mar sgo nga de las bya skye bzhin/ /mdor bsdus rgyas pa'i bskyed rdzogs rim pas bsgom/ /mngal skyes bag chags sbyang phyir bstan pa ni/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong las sa bon dang / /phyag mtshan las ni sku dang 'od zer sogs/ /rim gyis rgyas par bsgom gyis sngar bzhin du/ /mdor bsdus sngon du mi 'gro'i bskyed rdzogs ni/ /ji ltar rlung sems thig le dkar dmar las/ /mer nur ltar dang mkhrang gyur la sogs nas/ /lus yongs rdzogs te btsa' ba'i bar bzhin no/ /drod gsher las skyes bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong las lha rnams kyi/ /mtshan tsam brjod las lhar gsal bskyed rdzogs bsgom/ /ji ltar drod gsher 'dus las grub pa'i lus/ /shin tu 'grub par sla bas btsa' ba bzhin/ /sa bon phyag mtshan spros pa dgos pa med/ /brdzus te skye ba'i bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir/ /skad cig tsam gyis wal gyis bskyed rdzogs bsgom/ /ji ltar dzus skyes skad cig snang ba bzhin/ /ming las rim gyis bskyed rdzogs bsgom mi dgos/ /de ltar sgom tshul rnam pa bzhi nyid kyang / /gtso bor skye ba gang bsdus des bsgoms la/ /bag chags sbyang phyir kun gyis de bzhin bsgom/ /khyad par las dang po yis sgong skyes bzhin/ /cung zad brtan pas mngal skyes bzhin bsgoms la/ /brtan pa che bas drod gsher skyes bzhin bsgom/ /shin tu goms pa yang dag brtan pa yis/ /rdzus skyes bzhin du skad cig dkrong bskyed bya/ /rdzogs rim de yang snang bcas snang med de/ /bskyed rim bsdus nas mkha' la spren dngas bzhin/ /mi dmigs ngang du 'jog pa snang ba med/ /bskyed rim de nyid rdzogs par shes bya ste/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin spros dang bral/ma yengs bsgom pa snang bcas rim pa bzhin/ /las dang po yis bskyed rim zhen pa dgag /snang la bden par zhen pa'i gnyen po byed/ /brtan pa rnams kyis rdzogs rim zhen pa dgag /stong la mtshan mar zhen pa'i gnyen po byed / /phyi nas gang snang bskyed rim thabs nyid la/ /'dzin med shes pa rdzogs rim shes rab nyid/ /dus rnams kun du 'du bral med par 'char/ /bskyed rim snang 'di'i bden zhen 'gog pa ste/ /rdzogs rim sgyu mar zhen pa'i rtog pa spong / /gang la snang stong bden zhan med pa na/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis med rang bzhin dag pa yin/ /'di ni mthar thug rdo rje'i theg pa ste/ dbang po rnon po tshe 'dir rdzogs sangs rgyas/ derjes gdul bya'i 'jig rten gang yod der/ sangs rgyas mdzad pa sna tshogs lhun gyis grub/ 'di ni grangs med rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi/ nye lam sbas pa shin tu zab mo ste/ /skal bzang tshe 'dir grol 'dod rnams kyis bsten/ /de yang gang mos rgyud sde'i rim pa la/ /brten nas rdzogs pa'i 193

byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /thog mar rig gtad rjes gnang dbang la sogs/ /rang rang gzhung nas gsungs pa'i lung mnos te/ /rang gi sems 'di yongs su smin par bya/ /khyad par mchog gsang rnal 'byor chen po'i lam/ /smin byed dbang bzhi grol byed bskyed rdzogs te/ /bum dbang lus dang gsang bas ngag dang ni/ /shes rab ye shes yid dang tshig dbang gis/ /bag chags mtha' dag spyong zhing dngos grub ster/ /dang po gsum gyis bsod nams tshogs rdzogs la/ /bzhi pas ye shes tshogs rdzogs de bzhin du/ /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib kun sbyong / /de phyir smin byed dbang bzhi thob pa yis/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs don la slab par bya/ /'dir ni dbang rdzogs dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /gnyis med a ti'i dgongs par 'jug 'dod pas/ /bde ba'i stan la skyil krung rab bcas nas/ /skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bskyed de/ /chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /rgyu las steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ /rtsi bas bcu khro bo bcu yis mtshan pa ste/ /phyi nang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na dpal/ /kun du bzang po'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan cing / /rtsig pa lnga dang 'dod yon snam bu dang / /pha gu dra phyed mda' yab pu shus mdzes/ /phyur bu'i thod pa rin chen rdo rje'i tog /dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang mi bya dang / /shang shang padma nyi zlas spras pa'i steng / /rigs lnga so so'i yum dang sems dpa' brgyad/ /sems ma brgyad dang sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ /thub pa drug rnams so so'i gnas bzhugs te/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan rnams rdzogs pa las/ /mu med 'od zer phyogs mtha' gtugs par 'phro/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar gzhi yi kun du bzang / /yang yum 'khril sbyor mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /mkha' ltar dri med mthon mthing skyil krung tshul/ /tshon gang 'od kyi gong bu 'bar bar bsgom/ /de las 'od 'phros snang srid snod bcud sbyangs/ /thams cad rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i ngang / /yi ge gsum dang rigs lnga'i sa bon bzlas/ /grag stong skye med brag ca ji bzhin no/ /de nyid ngang la ma bcos mnyam par gzhag /rang sems ye nas lha yi rang bzhin la/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor sgra tshig gsang sngags nyid/ /thams cad lhun rdzogs ye shes chen po'i ngang / /dam tshig ye shes gnyis med dgug gzhug med/ /gshegs gsol mi dgos bzang ngan blang dor med/ /ye nas dkyil 'khor yin pa'i bdag nyid la/ /yin par shes pa'i tshul gyis gsal 'debs las/ /ma grub pa la yang grub byed pa min/ /rjes la zhen pa yod na rim gyis bsdu/ /gang du'ang mi dmigs spros dang bral bar gzhag /med na sgyu ma chu zla'i ngang nyid nas/ /dge ba sems can don du bsngo bar bya/ /spyod lam kun du stong gsal sgyu ma'i tshul/ /snang dang grags pa thams cad lha dang sngags/ /dran dang sems pa thams cad ye shes su/ /skad cig skad cig ma yengs shes par bya/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gtsang ma bsrung / /shes dang mi spang spyad dang dang du blang / /bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga lnga ste/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga mdor bsdus sku gsung thugs/ /de yang rang sems rnam dag tshul la bslab/ /nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad nyi shu dgu/ /tshe/ 9/cu yar ngo mar ngo'i nyin dang mtshan/ /bsnyen sgrub tshogs mchod bskang bshags 'bad par bya/ /

rlung beems rtsa dang thig le'i rnal 'byor sogs/ /yang zab gnad la nan tan snying por bya/ /bde gsal mi rtog zung 'jug lam bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa tshe 'dir rdzogs sangs rgya/ /de ltar rab gsang bla med snying po 'dis/ /nye ru ka dpal grong du nyer 'tsho zhing / /'gro kun las dang nyon mongs srid pa 'dir/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel rnam 'byor pas/ /chos rnams ma skyes stong pa'i tshul la 'jug /de yang snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /ye nas bdag med spros dang bral ba la/ /ma rig 'dzin pas srid pa 'dir 'khyams te/ /'khor 'das bde kug sna tshogs snang mod kyang / /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang / /sgyu ma mi lam 'dra bar mkhyen par mdzod/ /'di ltar phyi rol snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /sems la snang yang sems su grub pa med/ /sems las gzhan du'ang grub pa 'ga' med de/ /bag chags dbang gis gzung 'dzin gnyis snang yang / /snang dus nyid nas gzung 'dzin gnyis med pa/ /bzhin dang the long nang gi gzugs bzhin no/ /der ni byad nyid snang yang ma grub la/ /byad las gzhan gyi rnam pa btod gyed med/ /med bzhin gnyis su snang ba mngon sum ltar/ /sna tshogs chos rnams de bzhin shes par bya/ /ma brtags nyams dga' brtags na ngos gzung med/ /shin tu brtags na smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /yod med mi dmigs mtha' bral ma bral med/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du skye sogs snang na yang / /snang dus nyid nas skye sogs rang bzhin med/ /smig rgyu'i chu dang rdzing bu'i zla gzugs bzhin/ /khyad par ma dag 'gro drug snang ba 'di/ /med bzhin snang ba bag chags 'khrul pa'i gzugs/ /rab rib can la skra shad snang ba bzhin/ /de bsal 'dod pas bad kan sbyong ba ltar/ /'khrul snang dag 'dod ma rig ling tog bsal/ /de yi gnyen por rig pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'khor ba'i bag chags stong par la bzla zhing / /stong pa'i rang bzhin snang bar thag bcad de/ /snang stong gnyis med bden pa gnyis don shes/ /mtha' gnyis gnas bsal dbu mar bslabs pa yis/ /srid zhir mi gnas nam mkha'i ngang du grol/ /'di ni nges don snying po'i dam pa ste/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /snang ba'i dngos kyis phan gnod gnyis su med/ /der 'dzin zhen pas srid par 'ching bas na/ /sna tshogs snang la brtag dpyad mi dgos kyi/ /'dzin pa'i sems kyi rtsa ba bcad par mdzod/ /sems ni snang la rang bzhin 'ga' med de/ /btsal bas mi rnyed bltas pas mthong ba med/ /kha dog dbyibs med ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /phyi dang nang med dus gsum skye 'gag med/ /phyogs dang ris med gzhi rtsa dngos po med/ /'di zhes mi mtshon bsam yul 'das pa'i sems/ /'gags pa mi dmigs ma skyes phyogs na med/ /da ltar mi gnas rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang / /sems kyis sems ma tshol bar dal du chug /dgag sgrub dran rig skad cig yid kyi yul/ /snang tsam nyid nas phyi dang nang na'ang med/ /btsal bya'i don gyis tshol mkhan byas pas bslad/ /rang gis rang btsal nam yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /ye nas skye med rang bzhin gnyug ma'i don/ /mi gnas 'gag pa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /dus gsum gzhi rtsa med pas stong pa'i ngang / /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gags snang ba la/ /dngos po mtshan ma med pas 195

rtag pa med/ /rang shar 'gag pa med pas chad pa med/ /gnyis dang gnyis med med pas brjod du med//'di zhes grub pa med pas ngos gzung med/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag par shes par bya/ /brtags pas med ltar ma brtags dus na'ang med/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gdod ma'i ngo bo la/ /bzang ngan blang dor re dogs mi dmigs pas/ /brtag dang dpyad pas 'di la ci byar yod/ dus gsum yid kyis tshol khro ma byed zhog /rtog ge kros pa'i zhun pas bskyod pa'i sems/ /rnam g.yeng rlung ltar g.yo bas mi rtogs kyi/ /bsal gzhag 'gro 'ong med pa'i byang chub sems/ /kun byed ye shes dri med ngo bo nyid/ /ji bzhin bzhag pas de bzhin mthong ba yin/ /'dir ni sna tshogs grub mtha' mang po dang / /bsam brjod rtog pa du mas ci zhig bya/ /nges pa'i don la grub dang ma grub med/ /mtha' dang dbus med theg pa'i rnam dbye med/ /mkha' bzhin rnam dag rgya chad phyogs lhung med/ /de la yong med blos brtags 'khrul bas na/ /brjod du med gang ji ltar bshad du yod/ /don med gnas la rab tu ngal bar zad/ /ji ltar ma/ba' dbus dngas pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /me tog 'bras mang 'bab chus brgyan pa zhig /mngon du bsams nas de yi rnam dbye dang / /mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs gang rtsod pa bzhin/ /gang yang dri thed sems nyid dag pa la/ /bcos bsgyur dri mas nam yang mthong ba med/ /de la bskyed dang rdzogs pas ci zhig bya/ /dang ba'i bsam gtan bsgoms pas bslad par zad/ /gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /spang gnyen bral thob med kyis dmigs gtad shol/ /phyi nang gzung 'dzin med kyis ched 'dzin thong / /'di zhes ngos gzung med kyis zhen pa chod/ /thob dang thob med kyis re dogs thongs/ /gzhi nas 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rig pa la/ /sna tshogs rkyen gyi rnam pa ci shar yang / /shar ba de nyid rang gi thog tu grol/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin chos skur phyam gcig go /gang du bltas tshe blta mkhan ngo bo stor/ /btsal bas ma rnyed yul dang phyogs na med/ /'tshol mkhan nyid kyang mi dmigs spros dang bral/ /byed po mi gnas bya ba'i yul gyis stong / /mkha' bzhin dri med gdod ma'i ngang du phyin/ /ldog pa'i gnas med da ni gang du 'gro/ /zad par thug ste 'ong ba 'ga' yang med/ /sus kyang mi mthong kho bo gang na 'dug /de nyid shes na gzhan zhig dgos mi 'gyur/ /grol ba rnams ni nga bzhin 'khrul pa chad/ /da ni mi 'dri sems kyi gzhi rtsa stor/ /gtad med 'dzin med nges med 'di yin med/ /phyal ba lhug pa yengs pa phyam gcig pa/ /'di ltar rtogs nas nga ni glu len te/ /dri med 'od zer shar bas bstan nas song / /kye ho grogs dag snang ba'i yul la ltos/ /thams cad ma skyes stong ra mnyam pa nyid/ /me long gzugs brnyan sna tshogs ci shar yang / /me long ngos yin dngas par gcig pa bzhin/ /de nyid 'byed pa'i yid la tshur ltos dang / /sems ni mkha' 'dra dgag sgrub kun dang bral/ /mkha' la sprin rnams byung nas zhig na yang / /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul gnyis med dag pa bzhin/ /rang bzhin dri med gdod ma'i sangs rgyas te/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid do/ /yul sems gnyis med yi nas dag pa la/ /spang blang gnyis med phyogs ris dgag sgrub med/ /gang snang bden med gang shar stong pa nyid/ /thams cad mnyam nyid gza' gtad kun dasdo sdul/ /yul la nges med snang ba sna tshogs ltar/ /blo la gtad med phyogs bral chen po nyid/ /rang

bzhin rdzogs pa chen por shes par bya/ /'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams la/ /'das pa'i chos rnams mi dmigs mnyam pa nyid/ /ma 'ongs chos rnams ma skyes mnyam pa nyid/ /da lta'i chos rnams mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /dus gsum dus med gzhi bral mnyam pa nyid/ /thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa'i ngang nyid do/ /snang srid 'khor 'das sems kyi gzugs brnyan te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin dus gsum 'apo 'gyur med/ /'gyur med rang bzhin gzod nas myang na 'das/ /gzhi nas byang chub kun du bzang po yin/ /snang dang stong pa dbyer med gdod ma'i ngang gcig dang du mar mi dmigs spros dang bral/ /phyogs dang ris med thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /snang mnyam stong mnyam bden mnyam brdzun par mnyam/ /yod mnyam med mnyam mtha' las 'das par mnyam/dbyings gcig gdod nas dag pa'i ngang nyid do/ /blo yis brtags pa thams cad ngo bos stong / /ming rnams glo bur rang mtshan sgro btags nyid/ /bden brdzun gnyis med yul sems 'brel pa med/ /gcig gis gcig la ma gos gzung 'dzin med/ /ji ltar me long gzugs bzhin snang ba ni/ /yul gyi rnam pa dbang po'i shes la shar/ /de nyid bzung bas chags sdang srid par 'khrul/ /nan tar gtugs ni sems ni ma 'phos shing / /yul gyi rnam pa'ang sems la shar ba med/ /ngo bo med phyir gnyis su ma grub po/ /yul rnams thams cad rang bzhin med par gcig /blo rnams thams cad ngos gzung med par gcig /snang sems gnyis med gdod nas dag par gcig /brtag datshid mi dgos gzhi nas grol bar gcig /'khor 'das gnyis med sems kyi ngang du gcig /chu bo sna tshogs rgya mtsho'i ngang du gcig /thams cad ro mnyam lhan cig skyes par gcig /'byung bzhi'i 'pho 'gyur nam mkha'i ngang du gcig /sems kyi dgag sgrub stong pa'i ngang du gcig /gang shar rang grol gnyis med dag par gcig /dba' rlabs rol pa chu bo'i ngang du gcig /de ltar rtogs na skyes bu mkhas pa yin/ /sna tshogs ngos gzung med pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i gzugs baṅgān te/ /bzang ngan blang dor med pa'i rol pa la/ /blo yis gnyis su ma 'dzin gang bder zhog /gtang med yul la nges med snang ba shar/ /'dzin med rig pa rnam yin chen po ni/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /de ltar chos kun mnyam pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /blo bral ngang du 'dzin med la bzlas nas/ /phyogs bral rig pa khol bur bcings pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ gzhi rtogs pa'i shes rab mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o/ /de ltar chos kun mnyam pa'i don mthong nas//gnas lugs ngang la ji bzhin gzhag pa gces/ /de yang dbang po'i rim pas bstan pa ste/ /dbang po yang rab gnas lugs rtogs pas grol/ /sgom dang bsgom bya gnyis med don mthong nas/ /snang srid gzhi grol sems nyid bya btsal med/ /phyogs bral rig pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'char/ /thun mtshams ris med 'di yin nges gzung med/ /thams cad rang grol kun du bzang po'i zhing / /rtags dang tshad med rang byung gzhi klong yangs/ /ji bzhin ngang la ye bzhin gnas pas na/ /gol dang gol sa rtsal sbyong bogs 'gyin med/ /thob dang ma thob med par thag chod pas/ /'bras bur smon med da lta rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /197

de 'dra'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rab 'byams yin/ /'bring dang tha mas goms la brtson dgos te/ /ji srid bdag 'dzin dgyings su ma nub bar/ /de srid sna tshogs thabs kyis bsgom par bya/ /khyad par rnam rtog ngan pas srid par 'khrid/ /de nyid grol phyir bsam gtan thabs la brten/ /phyi nas shes rab mtha' grol klong yangs 'char/ /zhig nas kyis ni nyon mongs mgo gnon la/ /lhag mthong gis ni nyon mongs rtsa ba 'gyin/ /des na rab kyis ngan rtag chos skur lhongs/ /bzang ngan med na gnyen po bsgom mi dgos/ /'bring gis ngang dngas zung 'brel bsgoms pa yis/ /bzang ngan rtog pa dbyings su nub gyur nas/ /zung 'brel rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu 'char/ /tha mas thog mar zhi gnas btsal ba yis/ /gang dmigs de la brtan pa thob par sla/ /de nas lhag mthong so sor rtog bsgoms pas/ /phyi nang snang sems gzhi grol chan por 'char/ /des na dbang po'i rim pa shes pa bcas/ /da ni dbang po 'bring gi sgom pa bstan/ /ji ltar chu ni dba' rlabs dzhag pa na/ /dngas pa'i gzugs brnyan mi gsal g.yo ba ltar/ /yid ni mi bsrun kun rtog 'phyar zhing g.yo/ /sna tshogs spros la kun du 'chel ba na/ /sems nyid 'od gsal dngas pa'i ye shes dang / /spyan dang mngon shes gzang skar mi 'char bas/ /gcig tu mi g.yo mnyam par gzhag pa gces/ /lus ni chos bdun ri rgyal lta bu la/ /dbang po mtha' bral rdzing bu'i gza' skar 'dra/ /sems nyid stong gsal dngas pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /bying rgod gnyis med spros dang bral bar gzhag /de tshe rang bzhin gcig ste gdod ma'i ngang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa mi dmigs chos kyi sku/ /dri med 'od gsal nyi ma'i snying po ni/ /bde gsal mi rtog mtha' dbus med pa 'char/ /snang dang stong pa thams cad phyam gcig la/ /yod dang med pa kun gyi mtha' las 'das/ /srid dang zhi ba gnyis su mi rtog pa/ /shes dang shes bya gcig ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam med pa'i chos nyid mthong / /'di ni 'phags pa'i bden mthong ye shes rgyu/ /phyi nas de bzhin nyid mthong blo mig gis/ /rgyal ba'i chos sku sun tshogs bsgrub pas na/ /skal bzang rnams kyis rtag tu mnyam par zhog /sems nyid ma skyes mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngang / /sems byung mi dmigs sprin tshogs dengs pa bzhin/ /yed med spros dang bral ba'i shes pa yis/ /ji bzhin ngang la ye bzhin mnyam par zhog /dngas shing stengs brgya mtsho lta bu la/ /gzung 'dzin stog bral dba' rlabs med par zhog /stong zhing gsal ba nam mkha' lta bu la/ /kun rtog spren med phyogs lhung bral bar zhog /brtan zhing mi g.yo ri rgyal lta bu la/ /dgag sgrub gnyis med re dogs bral bar zhog /dag cig gsal ba me long lta bu la/ /snang yul ma 'gags gzugs brnyan lta bur zhog /yi grol sor gzhag 'ja' tshon lta bu la/ /bying rgod gnyis med dag cing gsal bar zhog /gzhan du ma yengs mda' mkhan lta bu la/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes spro bsdu bral bar zhog /thag chod shes pa las zin lta bu la/ /re dogs gnyis med kun gyis grub par shog /'di ni rang bzhin dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel pa yin/ /skye med ngang der gnas pas zhi gnas la/ /gsal stong spros dang bral bas lhag mthong nyid/ /dbyer med ngo bo gcig pas zung du 'brel/ /de tshe zab zhi spros dang bral ba'i soms/ /smra sdu9ṭwāṃm brjod du med pa'i don mthong bas/ /snang ba'i ye shes shin tu mi rtog pa/ /'od gsal shes rab

pha rol phyin zhes bya/ /de nyid mthong bas sems ni rab zhi zhing / /phyi nang chos la dgag skub zhen pa chung /stong pa'i ngang nas snyeng rje phyogs med 'char/ /rang gzhan don du dge la spyod cing bskul/ /dben par dga' zhing rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi nyung / /zi lam na yang dge ba'i chos la spyod/ /des sgru thar ba'i lam sna zin pa yin/ /de nas ches cher gong du goms pa yis/ /beems gsal ye shes sngon bas rgya che zhing / /snang ba mi lam sgyur mar rab tu rtogs/ /chos rnams gnyis med dang du ro gcig pas/ /skyes dang ma skyes thed par mthong ba'i tshe/ /mched pa'i ye shes shin tu mi rtog pa/ /bsam gtan dga' bas brgyan pa thob pa yin/ /de tshe lus sems sngon bas rab dag cing / /thabs dang shes rab dri med rtogs pa 'char/ /mngon shes ldan zhing snying rjes phan pa 'grub/ /srid la skyo bas sems ni nges par 'byung / /mi lam na yang chos kun de 'drar rtogs/ /lus kyi phyi nang shig sro 'bu srin med/ /bying rgod bral zhing nyin mtshan ting 'dzin 'grub/ /skye bo des ni 'phags lam myur du mthong / /de nas ches cher goms pas sngon bas lhag /ting 'dzin rtogs pa'i nyi ma sngon med 'char/ /chos kun tshul gcig mnyam pa'i don mthong nas/ /spyan dang mngon shes sgrib pa med mnga' bas/ /zhing khams brgya stong bye ba dpag med mthong / /de tshe zag med 'phags pa'i ye shes te/ /thob pa zhes bya mngon du gyur pa yin/ /de las ches cher gong du 'phel ba yis//rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin yon tan grangs med cing / /rtog dang mi rtog mnyam pa'i chos nyid las/ /gzungs sprin ye shes dri med rgya che zhing / /mnyam par gzhag dang ma bzhag gnyis med par/ /rtag tu mnyam gzhag sprul pa bsam yas ston/ /tshad med zhing dang ye shes gzigs la 'jug /rtsa khams dag cig rlung sems yon tan mchog /shin tu rgya che dri ma med pa na/ /nye bar thob pa zhes bya'i ye shes te/ /'phags lam rdzogs nas myur du byang chub 'thob/ /'di ni 'od gsal snying po'i theg pa ste/ /skal bzang 'bras bu tshe 'dir grol ba yin/ /dbang po tha mas bsgom pa'i rim pa yang / /dang por zhi lhag so sor rtsal sbyang ste/ /brtan par gyur nas zung 'jug dbyer med bsgom/ /de yang thabs tshul dpag med tshul la bslab/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal ba'i rim pa ni/ /dben pa'i phyogs su stan la rab 'dug nas/ /dbugs dbyung badzub pa'i kha dog grangs rnams kyis/ /nyin 'gar rnam rtog 'dul zhing gnas par bya/ /de nas byams sogs bzhi dang sems gnyis dang / /bskyed rim ngang ni bris sku glegs bam sogs/ /dge ba'i yul ni gang yang rung zhig la/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig ma yengs mnyam par gzhag /de ltar bzhag pas sems ni las rung zhing / /gzhan du mi 'phro gar gtad yul la zin/ /ji tsam bzhag pa de tsam mnyam par gnas/ /lus ngag sems ni dga' bdes khyab pa na/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo'i zhi gnas grub pa yin/ /de nas lhag mthong don la bslab pa ni/ /phyi rol snang srid 'khor 'das chos 'di rnams/ /sna tshogs snang bas rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhing / /gzugs brnyan sprul pa sgra brnyan dri za'i grong / /mig yor smig rgyu 'dra zhing snying po med/ /snang bas stong ste rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang / /thams cad nam mkha' 'dra zhing bdag med pas/ /skye med spros dang bral bar mnyam par gzhag /de yis phyi rol chos la bdag med cing //gzung dang gzung yul rang bzhin med par rtogs/ /de nas nang gi sems la 'di ltar brtag /sna tshogs 199

rtog la ngo bo med pa'i sems/ /dgag sgrub bden brdzun bde sdug btang snyoms sogs/ /yul la 'phro zhing ngos gzung med pa khyod/ /dang po gang 'ongs da lta gang na gnas/ /tha ma gar 'grod dgyibs dang kha dog ci/ /snyam du brtags tshe 'di ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /thems ni dang por skye ba'i rgyus stong zhing / /bar du gnas dang tha mar 'gag pas stong / /kha dog dbyibs med ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /'das pa 'gags shing ma 'ongs ma skyes la/ /da lta mi gnas phyi nang gang na'ang med/ /nam mkha' 'dra zhing kros dang bral bar shes/ /de tshe sems la gang yang mi bsam par/ /chad pa ngal gso bzhin du lhod kyis glod/ /ci yang mi bsam yid la byed pa por/ /thams cad gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang la gzhag /de yis ngar 'dzin gang zag bdag med cing / /'dzin pa'i sems la rang bzhin med par rtogs/ /de nas zung 'jug gnyug ma'i ye shes ni/ /snang sems gnyis med chu dang chu zla bzhin/ /gnyis su gzung bas srid par 'khrul na yang / /gnyis med shes pas mya ngan 'das zhing 'gro/ /de bas gnyis med don la 'di ltar bslab/ /chos rnams ma skyes sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /dri med stong gsal spros dang bral bar gzhag /de yis nyon mongs rnyog pa rab zhi zhing / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes chen por gnas/ /rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin 'grub 'gyur zhing / /gzung 'dzin gnyis med mtha' bral dbu mar rtogs/ /de tshe sems ni nam mkha' lta bu la/ /yul ni mi dmigs rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /sgom dang bsgom bya med pa'i chos nyid la/ /bya rgyu byed mkhan med pas gdod ma'i ngang / /dri med rang bzhin dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /gzung yul mi dmigs chu zla mig yor la/ /'dzin mkhan mi dmigs g.yo med phyogs lhung bral/ /snang sems gnyis med pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos nyid khong du chud/ /'dzin med yangs pa'i ting 'dzin gru chen gyis//srid gsum rgya mtsho'i pha rol brgal bas na/ /gzhi bde'i steng du blo bde rgyun mi 'chad/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du phyin/ /gnas pas zhi gnas chos sku stong pa la/ /gsal bas lhag mthong gzugs sku snang ba nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab tshogs gnyis bskyed rdzogs grub/ /lhag mthong rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyes byas nas/ /zhi gnas kyis ni de yi ngang la gnas/ /gang tshe gzung 'dzin dngos dang dngos med du/ /blo yi rnam par rab tu mi gnas pa/ /de tshe dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med par/ /sems dang sems byung dmigs pa med par zhi /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /gnas skabs glo bur kun rtog dag pa na/ /snyoms 'jug dgu dang rdzu 'phrul mngon shes 'grub/ /ting 'dzin grangs med gzungs sprin lhun gyis spub/ /rang sa 'dod pa'i sems gang rtse gcig pa/ /de las rtog dang dasbyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /dga' bde'i yan lag bsam gtan dang po skye/ /de las rtog med dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /sems gsal dga' bde'i rang bzhin gnyis pa skye/ /de las rtog dpyod gnyis med ting nge 'dzin/ /dga' bdes brlan pa'i yan lag gsum pa skye/ /de las dga' ba sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bzhi pa phan yon yan lag bcas pa skye/ /de las mkha' ltar dag cing dngas pa'i sems/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched thob par 'gyur/ /de las chos kun sems nyid spros pa med/ /rnam shes mtha' yas 200

skye mneed thob par 'gyur/ /de las snang semaspo mi dmigs kros dang bral/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched 'aspub par 'gyur/ /de las yod med spros kun bral ba'i sems/ /yod min med min skye mched 'grub par 'gyur/ /de las sna tshogs nyon mongs spros pa'i sems/ /rang bzhin 'gog pa zhib thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar mthar gyis snyoms 'jug dgu po yang / /rim dang rim min thod rgal rtsal sbyangs pas/ /rang gzhan snga phyi'i tshe rabs las rnams dang / /sems kyi spyod yul gang yin shes pa dang / /'chi 'pho skye dang sgrib pas chod kyang mthong / /gcig dang du mar rdzu zhing rnam par 'phrul/ /nyon mongs med cing ji snyed ji bzhin shes/ /zhing rnams bde gshegs sras kyis gang ba mthong / /de tshe snang ba sgyu mar rab rtogs pas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin nyid dang ni/ /sems kyi gdung bral rnyog pa rab zhi'i phyir/ /zla ba dri ma med pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /chos kun mi dmigs mnyam pa'i ngang gcig pas/ /mkha' ltar gos pa med pa'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /brgya stong grangs med rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /lhag mthong gis ni rab tu rtogs pa'i don/ /zhi gnas dam pas rtse gcig gzung ba'i phyir/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin zung 'brel lhun gyis spub/lam lnga'i rim pa bgrod las grol ba ste/ /tshogs lam chung ngur lus tshor sems dang chos/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi bsgom zhing / /'bring du 'dun dang 'bad rtsol brtson 'grus bzhis/ /dge dang mi dge'i zhan bzhi yang dag spong / /chen por 'dun sems daphyod dang dran pa bzhis/ /rdzu 'phrul rten 'grub rkang pa bzhi po bsgom/ /spyor lam bzhi ste drod dang rtse mo ru/ /dad brtson dran dang ting 'dzin shes rab kyis/ /dbang po lnga dang bzod pa chos mchog tu/ /dad sogs stobs lnga rab tu sgom par byed/ /mthong ba'i lam ste rab tu dga' ba'i sar/ /dad brtson dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab dga'/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi/ /yan lag bdun po dag ni legs bsgom zhing / /sgom lam chung 'bring chen po re re zhing / /chung ngu'i chung ngu chung ngu'i 'bring dang ni/ /chu'i ngu'i che sogs sa dgu rim pa bzhin/ /dri ma med dang 'od byed 'od 'phro can/ /sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring song mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin rnams su/ /yang dag lta dang rtog pa dag dang las/ /'tsho rtsol dran pa ting 'dzin 'phags lam brgyad/ /de ltar byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /slob pa'i lam bzhir bsgoms pa'i mjug thogs su/ /mi slob sa la mi gnas mya ngan 'da'/ /'di ltar sa dang lam rnams ma bgrod pa'i/ /sangs rgyas de 'dra nam yang 'byung ba med/ /bskal mang tshe rabs du ma tshe gang grol/ /de dag kun kyang lam 'dir brten pas na/rgyu 'bras theg pa gang la zhugs rnams kyis/ /sa dang lam rnams mkhyen nas bgrod par mdzod/ /de ltar zab zhi 'od gsal snying po yis/ /'gro kun sems kyi rnyog pa rab zhi nas/ /srid 'dir yun ring spros la 'chel ba yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/lam bsam gtan dri ma med pa zhi lhag zung du 'brel pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o/ /de ltar zung 'jug bsam gtan 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /ting 'dzin mi g.yo yan lag gsum la bslab/ /gang gis bsgrub pa cho ga'i yan lag dang / /ji ltar bsgrub pa thabs kyi yan lag dang / /gnyis med bsgrub pa ngo bo'i yan lag go /gang gis bsgrub pa'i skye bo nges 'byung can/ /lus ni 'du 'dzi'i grong las rgyang bsrings shing / /sems ni 201

kros pa'i tshogs las ring du bsrings/ /de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'grub/ /dad ldan ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod la/ /bag yod tshul khrims dag cing dge la spro/ /mang thos 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes ldan/de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'grub/ /lus sems bldams shing dben par gnas la dga'/ /gnyid dang snyom las smra la dga' ba spangs/ /rgod 'gyod med cing gzhan ngang 'dris pa nyung / /de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'aspub/ /grong dang grong 'dab skye bo'i 'du 'dzi med/ /gnas dang dgon par mang po'i rten 'dris med/ /don dang bya ba sna tshogs brel ba med/ /de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'grub/ /tshe 'di'i bde dang phyi ma'i bde 'bras dang / /rang don zhi ba gnyer min 'gro ba'i phyir/ /srid las thar 'dod nges 'byung skyo shas can/ /de yis ting 'dzin mchog 'di myur du 'aspub/ /ji ltar brgyab pa thabs kyi yan lag kyang / /gnyid mugs rgod 'gyod the tshom sgrib pa lnga/ /spangs te zhi lhag zung 'brel tshul gyis bsgrub/ /gnyid mugs gnyis kyis zhi gnas rab tu sgrib/ /rgod 'gyod gnyis kyis lhag mthong rnam par g.yeng / /the tshom gnyis ka'i gnod byed mi mthun phyogs/ /de ltar lnga nyid gying rgod gnyis su 'du/ /bying na gseng zhing rgod na rtse gcig bsgom/ /zhi gnas med pa'i lhag mthong spros la rgod/ /lhag mthong med pa'i zhi gnas lung ma bstan/ /zung 'brel sgrib pa'i galkon po mchog gi lam/ /zhi gnas lus ngag yid sems dal bas 'aspub/ /de yang chos kun rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang / /dmigs pa rab zhi gtso bo'i yan lag yin/ /dmigs pa gcig la sems 'dzin 'khor gyi tshul/ /de yang snang bcas snang thed rnam pa gnyis/ /phyi nang gnyis te bzhi yis zin par 'gyur/ /snar bcas gzugs sogs sgo lnga'i yul rnams la/ /snang med mi rtog rtse gcig ngang la 'jog /phyi rol rdo shing sku gzugs la sogs dang / /nang nyid snying gar padma 'thur 'phyang sogs/ /dmigs yul gcig la rtse gcig sems 'jog pa/ /zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi yan lag yin/ /de yis rtsi gcig zhi gnas skyes pa'i tshe/ /spel zhing brtan phyir lhag mthong ye shes spro/ /bogs 'byin spyod lam kun dang bsre ba gces/ /stengs na lus sems gsengs la sngar bzhin bsgom/ /'dis ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur pa yin/ /lhag mthong 'dod pas sems gsal dngas pa'i ngang / /so sor rtog pa gtso bo'i yan lag la/ /mi rtog mnyam par 'jog pa 'khor gyi tshul/ /de yang chos can chos nyid rnam pa gnyis/ /chos can sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad blta bya zhing / /chos nyid mkha' ltar stong pa'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /ji bzhin ngang la bzhag pas ye shes 'char/ /stengs na sna tshogs chos la rtsal sbyang ste/ /sgyu ma stong pa gnyis med dag par blta/ /'phro na zhi gnas ngang la mnyam par gzhag /de tshe nam mkha' lta bu'i 'od gsal ni/ /stong gsal spros dang bral ba'i ngo bo mthong / /de yis sgrib gnyis sprin las grol ba 'grub/ /res 'ga' rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'od gsal 'char/ /shar grol ngang dngas rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /bogs 'byin spyod lam kun dang de nyid bsre/ /'dis ni lhag mthong myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zung 'jug shes pa 'phro gnas mnyam pa'i ngang / /gnyis kar mi rtog ye shes gtso bo la/ /yeng med sgros dang bral ba 'khor gyi tshul/ /ji ltar shar gnas de yi ngang bzhag pas/ /shar bas grol la gnas pas mnyam panyitwe0/2/zhi lhag zung 'bril bde gsal mi rtog 'char/ /snang stong thabs shes bskyed rdzogs kun gyis grub/

stengs na zhi lhag so sor rtsal sbyar zhing / /bying rgod tshe na ldog la bsgom par bya/ /bogs 'byin nam mkha' dngas shing sprin med tshe/ /nyi mar rgyab phyogs mkha' la rab bltas pas/ /stong gsal shes pa sgros dang bral ba 'char/ /phyi rol dpe yi nam mkha' dag pa las/ /nang gi chos nyid don gyi nam mkha' che/ /gsang ba 'od gsal snying po'i nam mkha' ste/ /nam mkha' sum sprugs dgongs pa shes par bya/ /gnyis med bsgrub pa ngo bo'i yan lag ni/ /thams cad ro mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang / /spang blang mi bya dmigs gtad zhen pa dor/ /'dzin zhen thams cad srid pa'i 'du byed la/ /dmigs gtad med na mkha' bzhin bcings grol med/ /ji ltar gzugs brtan sna tshogs me long ngang / /de ltar chos rnams sna tshogs stong pa'i ngang / /ji ltar sprin rnams sna tshogs nam mkha'i ngang / /de bzhin dgag sgrub sna tshogs sems nyid ngang / /ji ltar chu bo sna tshogs rgya mtsho'i ngang / /de bzhin nyams rtogs sna tshogs sgom pa'i ngang / /ji ltar sgyu ma sna tshogs sprul pa'i ngang / /de bzhin 'khor 'das sna tshogs chos nyid ngang / /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' gzhi bral ngang / /de bzhin ye grol chos rnams lta ba'i ngang / /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag gnyis med ngang / /de bzhin sems dang sems nyid dbyer med ngang / /ji ltar sna tshogs mi lam gnyid kyi ngang / /de bzhin blang dor gnyis med spyod pa'i ngang / /ji ltar mtsho dang dba' rlabs chu bo'i ngang / /de bzhin rtog dang mi rtog mnyam pa'i ngang / /ji ltar tshong pa don spub bde ba'i ngang / /de bzhin re dogs gnyis med 'bras bu'i ngang / /thams cad phyam gcig rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang / /khyab gdal dbyings kyi chos nyid shes par bya/ /de ltar sna tshogs gnyis med ro gcig gis/ /'gro kun bdag gzhan gzung 'dzin las grol te/ /'di zhes dmigs pas 'khrul pa'i srid pa 'dir/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ ting nge 'dzin brgyab pa'i yan lag thabs la mkhas pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin nas/ /sku dang ye shes srin las kun gyis grub/ /sems dang sems byung kun gzhir bcas pa kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su 'jug par bzhi'i tshe/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med ro gcig gyur/ /de tshe dag pa gnyis ldan kros kun zhi/ /shin tu skye med 'od gsal snying po'i ngang / /gnam gang zla ba dbyings su nub pa ltar/ /phra ba'i ye shes mkha' dbyings padmor 'khyil/ /gang du'ang mi rtog zhi ba brnyes pa'i tshe/ /chos nyid mi dmigs dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i cha de la/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku zhes brjod pa ste/ /gzhi dbyings zad pa'i chos nyid mthar thug pa'o/ /rang bzhin glo bur sgrib gnyis rnam dag cing //thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho brnyes/ /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin pas/ /stobs sogs pha rol phyin pa'i chas gzhal na/ /mngon par byang chub sku zhes btags pa ste/ /ma 'dres yon tan 'char gzhi mthar thug pa'o/ /shes bya'i yul la de blo mi 'jug cing / /shes byed blo la 'dzin pa mi dmigs kyang / /nang gsal mkha' dbyings nub pa'i zla ba ltar/ /thim la ma mugs phra ba'i ye shes mchog /thams cad mkhyen chas 'char gzhi ngo bo'i tshul/ /de las gzugs sku rnam mkhyen mched 'gyur zhing / /gzhan la snang mdzad yon tan gter yin phyir/ /shin tu ches phra'i ye shes rab zhi'i chas/ 2/ṭwāṃ ba

chos kyi sku zhes rab tu brjod/ /'di dag phyi rol yul la mi 'jug cing / /chad pa ma yin shin tu phra ba'i phyir/ /rtag dang chad sogs mu bzhi'i mtha' las 'das/ /smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyir pa'i ngang /stong pa'i ngang bzhin dmigs pa rab zhi bas/ /rgyal pa rnams las gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /chos dbyings pho brang shin tu skye med na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad rtag bzhugs kyang / /gcig gis gcig mi gzigs te chos nyid phyir/ /rang bzhin zab zhir bzhugs zhes gsungs pa yin/ /de nyid ngang du rgyal rnams dgongs klong gcig /bum mkha' snga phyi'i nam mkha' gcig pa bzhin/ /'di ni chos nyid stong pa shes rab dang / /ye shes tshogs dang rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'o/ /de nyid ngang las rang snang longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas dus ston pa chos 'khor phun tshogs las/ /gnas ni 'od gsal stug po bkod pa'i zhing / /lnga ldan 'od kyis lhun stug gsal zhing 'tsher/ /'ja' tshon gdangs gsal nam mkha' gang ba bzhin/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /gzhal med khang mjos sgo bzhi rta babs ldan/ /rtsig pa lnga dang pha rgu dra gyed dang / /mda' yab pu shug tsang khang rgyur bus maldas/ /'phan gdugs rnga yab dril bu'i phreng ba dang / /bla re rgyal mtshan la sogs nam mkha' gang / /'dod yon lha mo mchod pa'i sprin 'phro zhing / /'od zer 'khyil bas phyi nang kun du khyab/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhi so so'i kha dog la/ /mthun pa'i rgyan dang la dog rnam par bkra/ /che chung ma nges gang bltas de ltar snang / /grangs ni tshad med nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /ji ltar til gyi gang bu phye ba bzhin/ /kun kyi nang na seng ge glang chen rta/ /mi bya shang shang nyi zla padmas spras/ /dus ni ma nges gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /dus gsum dus med kun du bzang po'i dus/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs chos nyid gdal ba che/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i ngang nyid do/ /ston pa mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ /don grub lnga po lnga lngas bskor ba la/ /nam mkha' dbyings phyug rdo rje ma ma tī/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang gos dkar dam tshig sgrol/ /yab yum mnyam spyor so so'i rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /mjing ga dkar ser dmar ljang 'od zer 'phro/ /'og gzhi zhi ba steng gzhi khro bo'i tshul/ /buca badzra rasna padma kar/te ru ka dpal lnga lngas bskor ba yang / /krosgri shwa rī lnga dang mnyam par sbyor/ /de sogs rnam pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /chos ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang / /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i klong nyid do/ /'khor ni nyid las mi zhan rang snang 'khor/ /sems dpa' brgyad dang de bzhin sems ma brgyad/ /sgo ba bzhi dang sgo ma rnam pa bzhi/ /zhi ba rang bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis las/ /drug ni gzhan la snang phyir sprul ba ste/ /gnyis ni dbyings na gnas phyir chos kyi sku/ /rang snang zhi ba 'ongs sku sum cu bzhi/ /khyad par 'khor ni nyi shu bzhir gnas so/ /khro bo'i 'khor ni sku sing phra men brgyad/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ /khro bo rang bzhin lnga bcu rtsa brgyad las/ /khyad par 'khor ni bzhi bcu brgyad dang bcas/ /'bar ba'i cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /shin tu mi bzad gar dgus rol pa'o/ /gzhan yang lus grub dkyil 'khor ji snyed pa/ /de snyed rang snang longs sku'i zhing khams yin/ /gzhan snang gdul bya'i zhi khro ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃd pa/ /sprul skus bsdus phyir rang snang longs sku min/ /de ltar phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga'i zhing //

thams cad rang snang yin phyir bzang ngan med/ /kun kyang gsal 'tsher kun rtsag 'od zer 'phro/ /lham me lhan de lhang nge'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul te/ /gcig gis gcig gzigs de yi bsngags pa brjod/ /de ltar yid 'ong kun nas bkod pa'i zhing / /dag pa'i gdul bya yis kyang mthong mi nus/ /rang snang stong gzugs bzhin du bsam mi khyab/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi rang
