chub kyi theg pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang / bla na med pa'i theg pas ma rig pa'i rnam par rtog pa nyon mongs pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por chos stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ /de'ang shākya thub pa lta bu'i 'khor gyi khyams su gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus rang rang gi mos pa ci yod pa de 'dra ba gsung gcig las dus gcig tu sems can tha dad kyi bsam pas chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa snga phyi med par sgra brtan bzhin du thos par 'gyur ro/ /sprul sku'i gsung ltar snang yang sgra tshig rang mtshan pa med de/57ṭwāṃdul bya'i blo dang sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs las rang snang ba nyid/ rgyud bla las/ ji ltar sgra bahon

gyi ni sgra/ /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ /rnam rtog med cing bzo med pa/ /phyi dang nang na mi gnas ltar/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung / /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ /rnam par rtog med bzo thed cing / /phyi dang nang na gnas ma yin/ /nes so/ /gsung de nyid gdul bya'i rna bar yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs su thos pa ste/ dgongs 'dus las/ 'di lta ste/ tshangs pa lta bu dang / sil snyan lha bu dang / spu gar lta bu dang / ka la spaṅka lta bu dang / 'brug gi dbyangs lta bu dang / sgra brnyan lta bu'o/ /laṅka'i bdag po/ yan lag ni 'di lta ste/ 'du shes bskyed pa dang / rnam par rig pa dang / mnyan par 'os pa dang / mi mthun pa med pa dang / shin tu zab pa dang / rjes su 'byung ba dang / gang gis mi tshugs pa dang / rna bar snyan pa dang / rnam par ma 'khrugs pa dang / shin tu gsal ba ste/ rnam grangs kyi sgo re re gang byung ba de dang der yan lag kun rdzogs par 'byung ngo zhes so/ /rtsa ba drug la yan lag bcu bcu 'jug pas drug cur 'gyur ro/ /de ltar drug cu po rnams kyi rang bzhin bcu ni/ de las/laṅka'i bdag po/ de la rang bzhin gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gdangs su che ba dang / yongs su khyab pa dang /go bar myur ba dang / the tshom gcod pa dang / gcig la gzigs pa mnyam pa dang / nyi tsher ston pa dang /kun nas 'jug pa dang / 'dun pa bskyed pa dang / khyad du zhugs pa dang / thams cad 'dul ba'o zhes so/ /rang bzhin bcu po re re la rtsa ba'i drug po bsgres na'ang drug cur 'gyur la/ drug cu drug cur basmres pas dbyangs kyi yan lag stong du 'gyur bas dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho zhes bya'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul ba'i gzugs brnyan mthong ba yang bai ḍūrya'i sa gzhi la brgya byin gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar 'gro ba'i las dag pa'i sems snang la snang ba ste/ rgyud bla las/ ji ltar beeḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la//thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/ /'gro bar gzugs brnyan 'char nub rnyog med dang //rnyog pa'i rang sems rab 'jug dbang gis 'jug /ces so/ /thugs kyis 'dul ba ni/ gsang snying las/ dus bzhi kun du mkhyen pa dang / thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud kun du mkhyen pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi spyan gyis thams cad kun du gzigs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi snyan gyis kun du gsan pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi tshogs kun du don spyod pa dang / zag pa med pa'i kun du bzang po'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mngon par shes pa chen po drug dang zhes so/ /de'ang gzigs palha'i mig gi mngon shes/ gsan pa rna ba'i mngon shes/ zag med kyi mngon shes/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ dus bzhi mkhyen pa tshe rabs du ma dran pas sngon gyi gnas dran pa'i mngon shes/ rdzu 'phrul gang gis 'gro ba 'dul ba der ston pa rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang drug gi rim pa thams cad thugs kyi rjes su 'gro zhing mkhyen nas don mdzad pas thugs kyis 'dul ba yin no/ /'phrin las kyis 'dul ba ni/ de las/ kun du sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du zhal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /kun du gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa grangs med pa phyogs bcur snang bar gyur to zhes so/ /de'ang de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi rim pa re re'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ༵/sa

can gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad khyab par don mdzad pa'o/ /de'ang sku gsung bugs gsum gyis dngos su don mdzad pa dang / 'phrin las kyis dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad nas mdzad pas tha dad du bshad pa yin no/ /sprul pa dang yang sprul bshad pa ni/ de ltar 'gro ba'i khams drug tu don mdzad pa'i thub pa drug smos pa/ de yang gtso bo'i grangs te sprul pa dang / /yang sprul rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /lha yi gnas su 'ang gnas ris so so ru/ /tshangs dang dbang phyug 'og min bar snyed du/ /rang rang 'dul byed ston pa'i tshul rnams snang / /thub pa drug ces smos pa ni sems can gyi rigs drug tu 'dus pa 'dul ba la dgongs la/ dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa'i ming drug ni mtshon pa tsam ste/dbyings nas sprul pa dang / sprul pa des kyang yang sems can gyi ngor sprul pa bkye ba tshad med pas don mdzad de/ lha'i gnas su'ang rgyal chen bzhi nas 'og min gyi bar lha gnas so so 'i gtso bos 'dul bar byed la/ gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa ni/ de bzhin du/ mi la'ang gang 'dul de la der snang ste/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang / rgyal po la sogs sprul nas mi rnams 'dul/ /lha min gnas su'ang so so'i 'dul byed dang / /dud 'gro'i ris su'ang bya la byar snang zhing / /ri dgas rnams la seng ge mchog la sogs/ /so so'i 'dul byed ston pa bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin yi dgas dmyal ba'i 'jig rten ru/ /rang rang mthun pa'i gzugs kyis don mdzad do/ /'di ltar mi'i 'jig rten du'ang thub pa gcig bur ma zad de/ rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / bud med la sogs pa tshad med pas 'dul zhing / thub pa gcig pus kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / rgyal po la sogs par sprul nas don mdzad pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du dud 'gro la yang byas 'dul ba la bya/ ri dgas kyis 'dul ba la seng ge la sogs pa'o/ /dmyal ba dang yi dgas na'ang de dang mtshungs te sems can gyis gar khyab tu sangs rgyas kyi sprul pas don mdzad pa ste/ phal po che las/ kye rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa ni tshad med de 'gro ba gang dang gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i gzugs dang kha dog dang ming gis don mdzad do/ /'di lta ste/ dbang sgyur gyi gnas su ni lha'i bdag po dbang sgyur du sprul nas dag pa bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par len du 'jug go zhes pa nas/ dge stong dang / bram ze dang / yi dgas dang / dmyal ba pa'i gzugs kyis 'dul ba rnams la'ang de'i gzugs su sprul zhing don mdzad do zhes so/ /ye thes kyis don mdzad tshul la'ang gnyis kyi/ so sor don mdzad tshul ni/ tshul/ de ltar 'gro 'dul rnams la ye shes gnyis/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam pa ste/ /chos nyid dang ni chos can ma 'dres par/ /so sor mkhyen nas gdul bya'i don gnyis mdzad/ /'gro ba 'dul ba dang mchog gi sprul pa'i ye shes ni/chos nyid la ltos te ji lta ba dang / chos can la ltos te ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ste/ mkhyen tshul ni/ 'di ltar/ji lta'i ye shes stong pa'i dngos mkhyen nas/ /'gro la nye bar zhi ba'i chos ston zhing / /ji snyed ye shes sems dang dbang po sogs/ /ma 'dres mkhyen nas chos tshul bsam yas ston/ /de'ang chos nyid stong pa'i ngo bo nyid du mkhyen nas sems can rnams la rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i chos ston te/ yum bar ma ༵ṭwāṃ/ kye sems can dag tshur shog /chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa ste khyed ci zhig gis

nyon mongs pa zhes chos ston cing stong pa nyid la so sor rtog la zhes so/ /ji snyed pas gdul bya'i khams dang dbang po dang bag la nyal thams cad gzigs nas de dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa ste/ de nyid las/ ngas sems can gyi khams la rnam par gzigs nas sems can kun nas nyon mongs pa can de dag gi nyon mongs pa rab tu gdul pa'i phyir chos bstan to zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /ma dag pa'i 'gro la snang tshul ni/ de ltar thub pa drug gis sprul pa/ 'di ni ma dag 'gro la snang ba ste/ /zhing ni 'gro drug 'jig rten drug rnams su/ /stan pa 'gro 'dul rang snang mazun pa yis/ /chos ni ma nges theg pa sna tshogs nyid/ /dus ni gdul bya'i skal ba mtshungs par snang / /de yang sprul sku'i gnas ni sems can gyi snang ba'i gnas gang yin par/ ston pa de'i snang ba dang mthun pas/ chos kyang sems can gyi blo rtog dang dbang po tha dad pa'i dbang gis theg pa sna tshogs su ston pa gnas dang 'khor rnams tshogs pa'i dus der gsungs so/ /kun byed las/ sprul pa'i sku yis 'dul ba'i zhing khams ni/ dzamyu'i gling ni bye ba phrag brgya sogs/ /rang byung ye shes thugs rjes rgyud drug 'dul/ /zhes pa dang / 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /'dul ba nyi khri chig stong gsungs pa yin/ /zhe ldang 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /mdo sde nyi khri chig stong gsungs pa yin/ /gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni//mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /dus gsum cha mnyam 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /sde snod gsum mnyam nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /spyi ru brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang / /dug gsum gnyen pos 'dul phyir gsungs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /ma dag pa'i snang ba la shar tshul ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshul/ de ltar 'gro drug 'jig rten drug po yang / /las dang bag chags dge sdig rgyu 'bras kyis/ /bde sdug mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ /ston pa drug kyang 'gro sems rang snang ste/ /mi lam nang gi sangs rgyas sems can bzhin/ /ngo bo dag kyang rnam pa ma dag pas/ /sna tshogs snang la thugs rje'i rol par shar/ /'gro ba'i las dang bag chags dge bas mtho ris dang / mi dge bas ngan song du 'khor zhing bde sdug sna tshogs su myong ba mi lam nang gi snang ba lta bu 'di ni ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang / rang rang gi dge ba'i las kyi snang ba la sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba thub pa bcom ldan 'das la sogs pas don mdzad pa de yang rmi lam lta bu ste/ sems can gyi rang snang las don la ma grub pa nyid rmi lam du sprul ba bkye bab bzhin snang ba yin te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ ngas ni rmi la ma lta bu'i 'gro ba la/ /rmi lam lta bur sprul nas chos bstan yang / /ngo bo med de rang bzhin gnyis su med/ /bdag med stong pa gsog tu rig par bya/ /zhes dang / yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ myangan las 'das pa yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu zhes so/ /'khrul snang gi snod bcud brdzun pa ltar de la snang ba'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa'ang brdzun la/ yod pa ma yin pa ste med bzhin snang ba'i phyir mi lam gyi sangs rgyas dang sems can bzhin no/ /des na 'khor 'das rmi lam lta bur snang dus 'dir ngo bo ye nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin yang / rnam pa 'gro drug gi sems can dang /de 'dul ba'i ston pa'ang de dag gi gzugs ngan pa la sogs par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /snang yang dbyings 579

gcig gdod nas dag pas gnyis su med pa ste/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas med cing chos dang dge 'dun med/ /de ltar sus shes de ni mkhas pa yin/ /sems can rang bzhin byang chub nyid du gsungs/ /byang chub rang bzhin sems can thams cad de/ /sems can rnams dang byang chub gnyis ma yin/ /de ltar sus shes skyes bu mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i sems can la sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes gzigs pa yang gdul bya dang 'dul byed du 'brel nas don mdzad de/log rtog bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas dbyings su zhi ba brnyes kyang ye shes brtse ba chen pos sems can thams cad sa ler gzigs nas/ don med pa la bdag tu gzung bas 'khrul pa rnams snying rje'i yul du dgongs te thabs kyis 'dren zhing lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa yang 'bad rtsol med par ngang gis 'byung ba'i nus pa ye ldan du shar bas don mdzad pa nyid/ gsang snying las/ log par rtog brtags rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi gzhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos 'brel bas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang / /zhes so/ /de dag kyang tshad med pa'i zugs rjer ldan pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku chen po rnam pa drug po/ 'di ni tshad med thugs rje'i sprul pa yin/ /srid pa ji srid 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /dbyings kyi ngang nas ye shes kyi ngo bo tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs las rang snang ba'i sprul pas sems can gyi don mdzad de yang / gdul bya'i khams dang / de 'dul ba'i thabs dang / de'i gnyen po dang / dus la bab pa na bsnyal ba mi mnga' bar 'dul bas don mdzad pa yang 'bad rtsol med par chu zla snang ba ltar 'byung ste/ rgyud bla las/ gdul bya'i khams dang gdul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyis 'dul ba'i bya ba dang / /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ /khyab bdag rtag tu kun gyis spub par 'jug /ces so/ /de'ang ngan song ba dag mtho ris la bkod nas thar pa'i sar 'dren pa dang /mtho ris pa dag gi'ang gnod 'tshe skyob cing phan bde mdzad nas thar pa la dgod pa dang / lam la ma zhugs pa rnams 'jug pa dang / zhugs pa rnams gong nas gong du yon tan la sbyor ba dang / sa bcu'i rjes la sangs rgyas la dgod pa ste/ mdor na sems can la ji lta bus skad cig tsam bde bar 'gyur ba de yang mdzad nas rim gyis byang chub gsum la so so'i skal ba ji lta ba bzhin 'god pas/ 'khor ba nas 'dred zhing sdug bsngal la skyob pa'i 'phrin las 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du dngos dang brgyud nas mdzad de/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /ces so/ /rnam pa ni dpe dgus mtshon pa ste/ brgya byin mthong dus snon ba skye ba ltar sangs rgyas mthong nas sems dang bas smon zhing tshogs gnyis spyod pa dang / lha'i rnga sgras bag med pa las slong zhing 'jigs pa sel ba ltar chos kyi rnga sgras bag med pa dang 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang /spren ltar chos char 'bebs pas rgyud kyi dge ba spel ba dang / tshangs pa gnas las ma bskyod par lha'i gnas su snang ba ltar chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du gzugs skus don mdzad pa dang / nyi ma ltar gdul bya'i padmo 'dzum zhing mun pa sel ba dang / nor bu ltar rnam par mi rtog pas gzhan don mdzad pa dang /sgra ṭwāṃ8/na ltar dbyangs gcig drug cur go bas don mdzad dus nyid nas sgra tshig tu med pa dang / nam

mkha' ltar rang bzhin spros pa med pa'i chos kyi skus 'char gzhi'i go bye bas don mdzad pa dang / sa ltar 'gro ba'i dge ba'i lo thog thams cad 'phel ba'i don mdzad pa ste/ rgyud bla las/ gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang spren bzhin dang / /tshangs nyi rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin/ /sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don byed de rnal 'byor rigs/ /rin chen lha dbang snang bzhin ston pa ste/ /legs par 'doms mdzad lha yi rnga dang 'dra/ /khyab bdag rmemakhyen dang brtse chen sprin tshogs ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i bar du khyab/ /tshangs bzhin zag med gnas las mi bskyod par/ /sprul pa rnam pa du ma rab tu ston/ /nyi bzhin ye shes snang ba rab spro gang / /rnam dag rin chen yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de brag ca bzhin du yi ge med/ /sku ni nam mkha' lta bur khyab dang gzugs med rtag pa nyid/ /sa bzhin 'gro ba'i dkar po'i chos kyi sman rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rnam pa kun du gzhir gyur pa ni sangs rgyas sa yin no/ /zhes so/ /sna tshogs sprul sku la gsum las/ bzo sprul bas 'gro don sun sum tshogs par mdzad tshul ni/ sprul ba'i sku gsum pa ni bems por snang bas don mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis sprul pa dang / 'gro 'dul la sogs pas de ltar sprul ba yin no zhes bshad pa yang / 'gro 'dul sprul ba'i dus dang ye shes kyis don mdzad pa nam mkha' lta bu'i phrin las phun sum tshogs pa/ de nyid ngang las sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /sems med bems po'i tshul gyis snang ba ste/ /ris su bris dang 'bur dang rang byon dang / /yi ge la sogs mchod pa'i rten dang ni/ /padma dpag bsam shing dang skyed mos tshal/ /khang bzangs mchog dang kun dga'i ra ba dang / /sprul pa'i grong dang spu gzings zam pa dang / /mar me rnar bu zas gos bzhon pa sogs/ /'gro ba'i don mang byed pa'i bems por snang / /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul ba'i skus don mdzad pa'i bye brag la/ ris su bris pa dang / 'bur du dod pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten rang byon du snang ba dang / yi ge dang /lha dang mchod rten la sogs pa gang zhig mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i gdung shugs g.yo bas thar pa'i sa bon 'jog pa dang / des mtshon nas de 'dra'i rten gyi rnam pa thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i rgyud la dge ba spel bas sangs rgyas kyi sprul par bsdu ste/ snyan gyi gong rgyan du / nga ni snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /bzo dang yi ge'i gzugs su 'dug /nga yin snyam du dad par byos/ /zhes pa dang / mdo sde'i rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /myangan 'das pa ltag ston pas/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen no/ /zhes so/ /bzo ni bzo'i rnam par snang ba bshad ma thag pa rnams so/ /skye ba ni sems can la dngos su phan pa de'i lus su sprul pa ste/ mu ge'i tshe nya po che dang / nad kyi tshe srog chags nges pa dang / srin mo'i gling du rta'i rgyal po ba la ha la sogs par sprul nas don mdzad pa'o/ /mchog gi sprul pa ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'o/ /de bzhin du padma dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang / skyed mos tshal dang / khang bzangs dang / rab tu byung ba'i kun dga' ra ba dang / tshong pa myangam gyi thang la 'khyams dus grong khyer du sprul pa dang / chu chen po la spu dang gzings dang zam par sprul pa dang / gsang chen thams mkhas las nags su mtshan mo lam 'khyams pa'i tshong pa la sgron mer sprul nas lam bstan pa 581

lta bu dang / mu ge'i tshe nor bur sprul nas kha zas la sogs pa'i char phab pa dang / shing rta'ang glang po che la sogs pa bzhon par sprul nas sems can la gang la gang phan bsgrub pa ni dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde rnams las gsungs shing / khyad par du/ ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi kha dog tu mthong bas gdul bar bya ba yin na gser gyi kha dog tu snang ngo zhes pa nas/ skyed mos tshal dang / nor bu dang / sman dang /rig sngags dang / nye bar mkho dgu'i yo byad du snang bas gdul bar bya ba yin na de dang de'i gzugs dang kha dog tu snang ngo zhes rgya cher gsungs te/ gnas na skabs dang mthar thug gi mngon marjo nges legs kun grub tu 'byung tshul ni/ de ltar snang ba des/ gnas skabs dga' skyid bde ba'i gnas mdzad nas/ /mthar thug zhi ba'i lam la 'god pas na/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro don lhun gyis grub/ /sprul pa'i rol pa des kyang gnas skabs su sems can so so'i yid dga' ba dang / lus dang ngag bde bas skyid par mdzad pa'i mthar sangs rgyas kyi sa la sbyor bas na sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku yang don dang mdzad pa shin tu chen po lhun gyis grub pa ste/ rgyud bla las/ snang bde ni shin tu yang / /rtog pa med cing g.yo ba med/ /de lta mod kyi sa steng na/ /don chen gyis ni nye bar gnas/ /zhes so/ /spyi don gsum pa de dag dgyings las byung zhing dgyings su jim pas mjug bsu ba ni/ da ni sku de dag gi bya ba dang mdzad dbyings las byung zhing dbyings su thim pa'i tshul gyis mjug bsdu ba ni/ sangs rgyas la brten pa'i/ gdul bya med na 'dul byed dbyings su nub/ /rang snang longs sku chos sku'i ngang du thim/ /chu snad med na chu zla mkha' la thim /tshes kyi dbang gis zla ba dbyings su nub/ /gnam gang zla ba 'phel 'grib med pa bzhin/ /gdul bya yod na sngon bzhin rim gyis snang / /'di ni 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /ji ltar chu snod med dus zla ba'i ngang du chu zla'i gzugs brnyan rang thim pa ltar gdul bya'i rgyu snod med na de'i ngor snang ba'i sangs rgyas sprul sku'i zla gzugs rang snang longs sku'i ngang tsam las med pas der thim pa'o zhes btags kyang gcig nas 'ongs te gcig tu thim pa ltar ma yin no/ /zla ba'ang gnam gang gi tshe na nang gsal du thim ba ltar rang snang gi longs sku'ang nang gsal chos sku'i dbyings su thim pas ye shes dbyings su 'khyil ba zhes bya'o/ /de'i tshe so so rang rig pa'i ye shes nyid phra ba'i ye shes su gyur pas shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i gnas skabs so/ /dbu ma las de'i che 'jug pa chos kyi dbyings su zhi bas gang du'ang dmigs su med pa 'gog pa dam pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag pa'o zhes 'dod la/ rgyud bla ma la sogs pa nas mnyam par gzhag pa'i ye shes zhes 'dod do/ /yang gdul bya yod na g.yo ba dang 'bad pa'i rtsol ba med par skad cig gis phyi gsal du rang snang ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sprul pa'i sku rnams snga phyi med par don mdzad pa snga ma bzhin mi rtog pa'i ngang nas 'byung ngo / /'di la dbu ma nas sngon gyi smon lam las gzhan snang du don mdzad ces 'dod la/ rgyud bla ma la sogs pa nas rjes thob tu don mdzad kyang mnyam gzhag gi ngo bo las ma g.yos pa zhes 'dod de/ rgyud bla las/ mi rtog pa dang de yi ni/ /rjes thob de ni ye shes 'a/ṭwāṃ2/ /ces pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /dzes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /

sems can yang dag sprol ba la/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /de lta mod kyi sa rdul dang / /rgya mtsho ba lang mig rjes kyi/ /khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i khyad de nyid/ /ces so//spyi don bzhi pa skabs kyi dge ba bsdo ba ni/ da ni dge ba sems can gyi phyir bsngo ba ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i tshul/ de ltar zhi ba mchog gi rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro kun sems nyid 'od gsal dbyings gzhol te/ /srid zhi'i mthar 'dzin nyes cha'i dri ma yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /ces smon te/ snying po'i de kho na nyid kyi dge bas 'gro ba thams cad srid zhi'i mthar 'dzin pas dub pa'i sems nyid thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ba tshad med pas dbang 'byor ba'i sa la dal sos shig ces pa'o/ /rab dkar ku mu ta rnams rgyas byed pa/ /ston ka'i mtshan mo dkaraba'i zla gzugs bzhin/ /dge ba rab mchog nyon mongs gdung sel bas/ /'gro kun sems kyi rnyog pa zhi bar shog /nyon mongs mtsho sngon sdug bsngal dbu phreng can/ /nyes cha'i bzhad rnams lding ba gar yin pa/ /sems dge'i 'od stong shar bas bar bskams te/ rgyal ba'i 'byor bas yongs gang mthong bar shog /sems kyi rab rib glo bur sgrib pa'i sprin/ /kun sbyor 'ching ba'i rnam 'gros rab brtan pa/ /ye shes rlung gis phyogs bcur gtor byas te/ /'od gsal byang chub nyi ma mthong bar shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ 'bras bu lhun grub chen po'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'i 'grel pa'o// //yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don la lnga ste/ legs parabashad pa'i dge ba rgya cher bsngo ba ni/ de ltar tshig don mtha' dag gi rim pa legs par gtan la phab zin nas/ da ni bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs pa'i skabs las/ gzhan don du bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ thog mar mtshan bshad pa nas brtsams te/ 'bras bu mthar thug pa'i don bshad pa'i bar gyi tshig don bkod legs pa/ de ltar legs bshad bsod nams sprin chen las/ /zhe bde'i rang bzhin char gyi tshogs mang pos/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i dge legs rab rgyas te/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor tshos lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa ste/ rab tu yangs shing dri ma med pa'i yid mkhar/ legs par bshad pa'i sprin phung chen po/ thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi 'brug stong sgrogs shing / lung dang / rigs pa dang / man ngag gi glog phreng bzang po 'gyu ba las 'thon pa'i/ zhi bde'i dge ba char gyi tshogs bsil bar 'bab pas/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang /gzugs med pa'i sems can gyi sems kyi sa gzhi chos khams dge ba snying po'i sa bon can gyi rgyud brlan pas/ ches cher gong du 'phel ba'i nus pa mthar phyin pa sangs rgyas kyi byang chub sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yon tan dang 'phrin las chen pos mnga' dbang rdzogs par shog cig ces pa'o/ /brtsam dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ brtsams pa'i tshul brjod pa ni/ dus/ ding sang phal gyi blo mig ma dag pas/ /sngags dang pha rol phyin gzhung so so'i lam/ /'gal bar 'dzin pas gcig tu sdud mi shes/ /de phyir de dag phyogs re'i mig can yin/ /sngon gyi mkhas spub chen po rnams ni gshegs la/ de dag gi gzhung lugs chen po rnams kyang ring zhig nas rang rang gi don rtog gis daspugs pas gsal bar med la/ sngags kyi rgyud sde chen po rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung so so'i lam gyi dgongs pa /sdu tu

brling bas/ mang du ma thos shing rtog ge'i ngan rtog tsam gyis dkrugs nas blun po mkhas pa'i mngon rlom can rnams kyis 'gal bar 'dzin pas/ dgongs pa zab mo rnams gcig tu bsdu bar mi shes pa'i phyir/ cung zad re'i tshig tsam lhur len pas phyogs re'i mig can du gyur pa yin no/ /mdo jigs gnyis kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don ma rnar bar bstan tshul ni/ tshul de dag mthong nas/ gzhung / 'dir ni rgyu 'bras theg pa'i zab don mchog /gcig tu bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i thabs/ /gangs ri thod dkar yo rgyan rdzong gnas su/ /dri med 'od zer shar bas legs par bkod/ /bstan bcos 'dir ni rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i nges don gzhi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang / 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don rnams/ /mdo dang / rgyud dang / lung dang / rigs pa dang / man ngag gi gnas bstan pa las ji skad 'byung ba dang / bla ma dam pa las 'ongs ba'i zab mo'i de kho na nyid kyi don rnams gcig tu bsdus te/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul yo rgyan rdzong gi grub gnas dam par bkod pa yin no/ /ri de yang 'on cang rdo bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang gi byang shar na yod de/ sngon gangs ri'i bre bas brgyan zhing zla ba'i gos dkar gyis g.yogs pa 'dra ba las/ dus kyi dbang gis ding sang ni rtse mo brag ri'i bas mdzes pa'o/ /ngogs rnams sman ljongs dang chu gtsang 'bab pa/ me tog dang sman dri zhim po rgyas pa'i lho phyogs na rgya shug gi nags tshal ljang gu rma bya'i mgrin pa 'dra bas brgyan pa'i mthongs na/ grub pas brten pa'i nags khrod rang byung padmas byin gyis brlabs pas rma rgyan rdzong zhes btags pa gang yin pa'o/ /bstan bcos 'di yang snying po'i don gcig tu nges pa bstan pa'i mdzod kyi nor bu yin pas spyi bos blang bar rigs te/ rgyud bla las/ de ltar yid ches lung dang rigs pa la/ /brten nas bdag nyid 'ba' zhig dag phyir dang / /gang dag mos dge phun tshogs dang ldan blo/ /de dag rjes su gzung phyir 'di bshad do/ /ji ltar sgron glog nor bu nyi zla la/ /brten nas mig dang ldan pas blta ba bzhin/ /de bzhin don chen chos spobs 'od mdzad pa/ /thab la brten nas 'di ni rab tu bshad//gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khams sum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsung / /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /gang zhig rgyal ba ston pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang / /zhes legs par gsungs so/ /dge ba rgya cher spel phyir shis brjod kyi rgyan 'god pa ni/ de ltar lung dang rigs pa 'i rjes su 'phrangs te phyin ci ma log par mthong ba'i blo gros kyis/ legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho rmad du byung ba'i tshul gang chen mtsho bkod pa'i/ dge ba de yis srid pa'i sems can rnams/ /ma lus nyer zhi'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /phyogs dus kun du bkra shis byed par shog /ces pa ni shis pa brjod pa'i rgyan te/ zab cing rgya che ba'i bstan bcos bkod pa las byung ba'i dge ba mchog tu gyur pa des/khams gsum rigs drug srid pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'gro ba ji snyed pa thams cad 'bad pa dang rtsol ba ༵/ par zhi ba'i go 'phang kun du bzang po thob nas sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pas/ phyogs

dang / dus dang / gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis pa'i 'od zer brgya stong bye ba khrag khrig dpag gis mi lang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kun nas 'phro bar gyur cig ces grags par byas pa yin no/ /de ltar yon tan mchog rab shin tu rmad byung mtho ris sa steng rnam brgyan pa/ /legs bshad 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nyi zho dmar bas yid mkha'i lam la rab gnas shing / /mtha' yas 'gro bar nyer zhi'i go 'phang bla med snang ba dpe med 'char ba gang / /sa gsum skye dgu'i ye shes sgron mar bgyis te ding sang bdag gis sbyar ba lags/ /chos tshul 'di ni zab cing rgya che chu srin 'dzin khri'i gnas 'dra zhing / /legs bshad 'od stong kun nas 'phro bas rta bdun rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /'dod dgu'i re ba mtha' yas rdzogs ldan yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog 'dra ning / /sna tshogs 'dod ster rol pa can te bde gshegs dbang po'i go 'phang bzhin/ /ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa'i sprin tshen snying po dam pa ni/ /phan mdzad phan bde'i bde legs gyur pa rtag tu byed pa gcig tu gyur/ /ye shes mtsho bsil sdon med gang de lha brgya'i gang chen mtsho min zhing / /mtha' yas 'od zer dra ba spel legs gang yin de yang de bzhin no/ /'di ni mdo rgyud blta ba'i me long ste/ /lung rigs man ngag du ma'i mdzod khang mchog /thar gling snang byed nyi ma'i snying po ste/ /ma rig mug pa sel ba'i sgron me yin/ /phyi rabs skal bzang byang chub 'dod pa dag yi ge 'di la rtag tu nan tan mdzod/ /mdo rgyud man ngag snying po 'dir tshang zhing / /zab don brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sprin phung mchis/ /bdag blo'i 'dab bzang snying po'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /thabs dang shes rab tshig don gshog yangs rab brkyang ste/ /ches cher gong du thar pa'i grong khyer rab 'gro zhing / /byang chub zhi ba rdul bral chu ngogs bgrod pa snyam/ /dpal ldan padma'i mkhyen brtse'i mtsho chen las 'khrungs pa/ /gang gi rjes zhugs dri med 'od zer stong ldan ni/ /'gro kun snang byed yid mkha'i mun pa rab bcom nas/ /gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings sgrib pa med der gnas pa yin/ /gang gi mtshan mo zhi dbyings snang ba de mthong tshe/ /rnga sgra'i dbyangs bzhin sgrib med gsung gi rjes 'gro bas/ /ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan rgyal ba der 'gyur zhes/ /dbugs chen 'byin pa de yang dpal ldan padma skyes/ /gang gi mtshan tsam dran pa nyid kyis 'khor ba'i 'jigs las sgrol mdzad pa/ /de yi byin rlabs zhugs pa nyid kyis dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa med/ /gnyis med chos gsung thos pa nyid kyis mi skye'i bzod la sbyor mdzad pa/ /de yi dge bas rtag tu skyong zhing 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur cig /legs sasungs dpal ldan yon tan mchog mnga' tshangs pa'i rnam grol rab gsal ba/ /dpag med rgyal ba snga phyi'i gshegs shul rgyu 'bras theg pa zab mo'i don/ /lung rigs man ngag bzhon pas rab bskyod nges don shing rta chen po'i srol/ /gang yin 'di ni zab mo'i don te blo chen ldan rnams mgu byed yin/ /skye ba sdon rabs dus nas chos dkar gyi/ /dge tshogs rmad byung las bskyed las 'phro can/ /slob ma bzang po gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyis/ /bskul ba'i ngor ni bdag gis 'di bkod do/ /gangs ri'i ra bas legs par bskor ba'i dbus/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal dam pas bsten pa'i ri/ /rang byung padma rgyal po'i gnas mchog tu/ /phyi rabs don phyir phan pa'i chos 'di bkod/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro kun 'od 585

gsal snying po'i grur zhugs te/ /sgrib pa'i rgya mtsho shin tu brgal dka' skad cig yud kyis rab sgrol nas/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang shin tu rmad byung rin chen snying po'i gling so na te/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag rab bsal rdzogs sangs yon tan la reg shog /gang yang 'gro bas 'bad ma dgos par bdag gi dge bas yongs grol zhing / /cung zad tsam yang bsgrubs pa med par rgyal ba'i 'byor ba sun tshogs ldan//de ltar de bzhin brtson pa med kyang myur du srid pa'i mtsho brgal nas/ /yong ye phyam gcig 'khor bstongs nas zhi ba'i grong khyer gang bar shog /gnas skabs kun du dge ba 'di yis ni/ /'jig rten khams kun 'byor zhing lha yul bzhin/ /yid la bsams pa tsam gyis dag 'grub cing / /thar pa'i lam bzang snang ba 'dzin par shog /su yang sdug bsngal 'tshe ba mi mthong zhing / /rang gi bde ba dam pas nyer 'tsho ba/ /lha yul sa steng sa 'og kun khyab ste/ /mthar yang 'od dpag med pa'i gnas thob shog /'gro ba'i don gang chos dang mabun 'grub cing / /tshul min yid la byed pa rnam bral te/ /byams sogs rgyal sras dam pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /myur du byams mgon zhabs drung skye bar shog /bdag gi rtsom pa thams cad don yod cing / /sems can tshogs rab srid las sgrol ba'i phyir/ /skad cig mi la brtson pa mtha' yas kyis/ /srid gsum zhi ba'i dgon par 'khrid par shog /bdag gi bde bas sems can kun bde zhing / /sems can sdug bsngal bdag gis khur khyer te/ /'gro ba de kun yongs su stongs kyi bar/ /bdag gis 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog /nam yang bde med 'khor ba basbrul gdug gling / /me chen 'obs dang 'dra ba'i khrod 'di las/ /lus can bsil ba'i tsan dan nags khrod du/ /sangs rgyas pad tshal skyong bas nyer gnas shog /mi rtag mi gtsang sdug bsngal bdag tu 'dzin/ /phyin ci log bzhis rtsen pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /bdag gi mthu yis rgyal ba'i sar gzhol te/ /ma lus yon tan tshogs rab rdzogs par shog /nags nang me tog bung ba 'phur lding zhing / /rma bya grag bas ze ba bskyod pa der/ /zhi ba'i bsam gtan bde bas yongs gang zhing / /srog dang bcas pa'i lus 'di g.yo bar shog/ /chu gtsang 'bras bu'i ldang mad grib bsil can/ /'khri shing sman ljongs brag ri'i drung der ni/ /gcig pur yid la byed pa kun spangs te/ /thar pa'i byang chub bdud rtsi brnyes par shog /nags rlung g.yo bas me tog grib shing bskyod pa yis/ /lo ma lhags pa lha rdzas char pa 'bab pa bzhin/ /bsam gtan pa de sgra med zhi ba'i dga' ba yis/ /ting 'dzin mi brnyings 'od gsal 'dus ma byas 'grub shog /padma la 'khor bung ba dang ni gdangs snyan bya tshogs sgrogs pa las/ /gzhan pa'i ca co nye bar zhi gyur dben zhing nyams dga'i nags khrod der/ /'dris dang 'du 'dzi'i skye bo mi mthong gcig pur zhi la sems gzhol bas/ /lham me lhan ne lhang nger gnas shing tshe 'di don yod byed par shog /de ltar legs sungs zhi ba'i chos dang dag pa'i smon lam rgya che bas/ /mtsho chen ngas gsal srid rtser khyab cing bde dga'i yon tan tshogs rab 'bras/ /lha yul sa steng mtho ris brgyan pas ngan song pa dag rab stongs te/ /mngon mtho nges par legs pa'i lam song rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'aspub par shog /chos tshul 'di yang mkha' bzhin rgya ṭwāṃ ༵na la khyab cing yid bzhin re ba rnam skod la/ /sa bzhin 'gro ba'i rten dang nyer 'tshe'i gru chen

srid mtsho las sgrol ded dpon bla med bzhin/ /gdung sel chos char bdud rtsi'i chu bzhin yid mkhar gzungs sprin snyan pas lha yi rnga sgra bzhin/ /ma rig mun sel thar gling snang bas nyi zla'i mchog bzhin grags pas bkra shis byed par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngas gso zhes bya ba'i 'grel ba shing rta chen po zhes bya ba/ /dpal yo rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma sambha was rjes su gzung zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' rab 'byams lam du zom pa'i nor gyis phyug pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ brag dmar zang yag nam mkha'i rdzong pod kyi ri bo rtse lnga gter ka du mas brgyan cing mkha' 'gro ra nga bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta chen po'i bsdus don gyi sanas rgya cher dbye ba badma dkar po'i phring ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /dpal kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos thams cad gzhung lam gcig tu ston pa rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya cher bshad pa la gsum ste/ 'grel pas bshad pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu brjod pa/ 'jug yul lus kyi don rgya cher bshad pa/ yongs su rdzos pa mjug gi don bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan gyi don phyag gis mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'o/ /phyag la gnyis te/ /mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas zhwa ra bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/phyi'i bla ma dkon mchog gsum la/ khyad par gyi bla ma o rgyan padma la/ brjod bya'i dbyings rang byung gi ye shes la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /don gnyis pa 'jug yul lus kyi don rgya cher bshad pa la gsum ste/bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i tshul brjod pa/ gzhung gi don dngos rgya cher bshad/ mthar phyin pa mjug gi don bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ phyag gi don dang / brtsam par dam bca' ba'o/ /phyag la gsum ste/ snga 'grel gyi mtshams sbyar/ rtsa bas mdor bstan/ 'grel pas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dam bca' ba la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don dngos rgya cher bshad pa la le'u bcu gsum las/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa'i le'u la gsum ste/ le'u la 'jug pa rgyu'i don/ le'u dngos kyi don/ le'u rdzogs pas mjug gi don bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ /mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ dal 'byor gyi dbye ba/ de thob dus chos la 'bad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dbye ba'i gnas gzhan/ chos la nges pas dal 'byor don yod pa ra gdams pa/ spro dga' bskyed nas dal 'byor snying po len par gdams pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bdun te/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis da res ma 'bad na/ 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa la bsams nas kyang dal 'byor gyi rten la chos bsgrub dgos pa/ mtshams sbyar/mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyi rang dbang yod dus thar pa'i lam sna zin pa dgos pas kyang dal 'byor gyi rten la chos bsgrub dgos pa/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyi dus skabs 'dzom pa‘re gru bo rnyed dka' bas kyang dal 'byor gyi rten la chos bsgrub dgos pa/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/58shās

bshad kyis kun du rtog pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir yang dal 'byor gyi rten la chos bsgrub dgos pas/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis ma 'bad na yun du gdud bas kyang dal 'byor gyi rten la chos bsgrub dgos pa/ mtshams sbyar/ /mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo 'grub sla bas kyang dal 'byor gyi rten la chos bsgrub dgos pa/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/rgyas bshad kyis rnyed dka' ba dpes bstan pas kyang dal 'byor gyi rten la chos bsgrub dgos par bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa dbye ba'i gnas gzhan bstan pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / dbye don spyir 'god pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas mi lus phal pa dang / mtshams sbyar/mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas mi lus khyad par can dang / mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas mi lus rin po che bstan pa'o/ /don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba/ bstan/ bshad pas chos bsgrub par gdams pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /bzhi pa chos la nges pas dal 'byor don yod par gdams pa la gnyis te/ ma 'bad na blo gros blun pas kyang dal 'byor bsam ste chos la nges pa/ lus sems rten 'brel gyi tshogs don bsams te'ang dal 'byor chos la nges par gdams pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sngags 'grel gyis mtshams sbyar/ rtsa bas mdor bstan/ 'grel bas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gsum mo/ lnga pa spro dga' bskyed nas dal 'byor la snying po len pa'i tshul gdams pa la lnga ste/mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas 'khor 'das bde sdug gi snang ba dal 'byor thob pa la spro dga' bskyed pa/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis 'di phyi'i legs dgu dal 'byor snying por byas pa las byung bas spro dga' bskyed pa/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis sangs rgyas gang las 'byung ba'i rtekki yang dal 'byor yin pas de thob pa la spro dga' bskyed pa/ mtshams sbyar/mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas lam dang mngon par rtogs pa'i chos khyad par can gsar du skye ba'i rten dal 'byor thob pa la spro dga' bskyed pa/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis dga' ba khyad par can gyi blos dal 'byor rnyed pa la spro dga' bsgom pa'i tshul la gdams pa'o/ /don gsum pa le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don bstan pa la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rtsa ba'i don 'grel/'grel pa'i gnas bsngo ba/ le'u'i mtshan bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa bsam pa'i le'u la gsum ste/ le'u la 'jug pa rgya'i don/ le'u dngos kyi don/ le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don/ dang po la gsum ste/mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bdun te/ gang mi rtag pa phung po'i rang bzhin la bsams te chos la bskul ba/ dus ring ba'i rgyu mtshan dpyad de chos la bskul ba/ dus nye ba sna tshogs kyi rkyen la bsams te chos la bskul ba/ snga phyi'i da lta'i rang bzhin la bsams te chos la bskul ba/ 'jig nges rkyen gyi gtan tshigs nges pas chos la bskul ba/ rang gzhan rtag 'dzin skyo shas 'aṭwāṃsdu bas chos la bskul ba/ mi rtag bsgom tshul phan yon dang bcas pas chos la bskul bar gdams

pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dus ring ba'i rgyu mtshan dpyad pa la bzhi ste/ tshe bskul par bub pa'i lha chen po rnams kyang mi rtag pa/ khams gsum spyi btsan gyi skye dgu rnams kyang mi rtag pa/ snod bcud brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten rnams kyang mi rtag pa/ sngon rabs byon pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyang mi rtag pa la bsams te snying nas dam pa'i chos la bskul ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la'ang mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa gsum mo/ /gsum pa la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa la yang / mtshams sbyar/ mdon bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa la gsum mo/ /gsum pa dus nye ba'i rkyen bsam pa la bzhi ste/ gcig tu nges pa med pas mi rtag pa/ grong khyer rnying pa bzhin ngu mi rtag pa/ rlung nang mar me bzhin du mi rtag pa/ 'chi ka'i snang ba bzhin ngu mi rtag pa'o/ /dang po la'ang /mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa la gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bzhad pa'o/ /gsum pa la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa snga phyi da lta'i rang bzhin bas ma pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas sngon rabs 'das pa'i tshul la dpag ste thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang ba'in la bsam pa /mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas da ltar 'pho 'gyur mi rtag pa'i tshul la dpas ste thams cad 'jig par bsam pa'o/ /lnga pa 'jig nges rkyen gyi gtan tshigs nges pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas nyin mtshan ska da cig thang cig 'gyur bas kyang mi rtag par bsam pa/mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis 'chi rkyen ma nges sna chogs yod pas kyang tshe mi rtag par bsam pa'o/ /drug pa rang gzhan rtag 'dzin la skyo shas 'phel bas chos la bskul ba gnyis la gsum ste/mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas don zab/ thar pa'i chos dang 'phrad kyang 'chi ba ma dran pas rtag 'dzin tshe 'di'i 'khrul pas bslus pa la skyo ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas mi lus rin po che thob kyang 'chi ba ma dran pas yang yang 'khor ba'i btson rar 'chi ba la skyo ba/ mtshams sbyar/mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad bar bstan pa'o/ /yul dbus dam chos dar sar skyes kyang rtag 'dzin tshe 'di'i chos la g.yeng ba'i mkhas blun bar ma'i skye bo la skyo bas rang nyid legs pa'i chos la bskul ba'o /bdun pa mi rtag pa bsgom tshul phan yu na dang bcas pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas mi rtag pa bsgom tshul dang / mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /don gsum pa le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rtsa ba'i don 'grel/ 'grel pa'i don gnas bsngo/ le'u'i mtshan bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal du bsam pa'i le'u la gsum ste/ le'u la 'jug pa rgyu'i don/ le'u dngos kyi don/ le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ snga 'grel gyi mtshams sbyar/ rtsa bas mdor bstan/ 'grel pas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rang gzhan mngon par skyobs 'khor ba sdug bsngal du bsam pa/ sdug bsngal sems kyi 'khrul snang rten gzhi dang bcas pa la bsam pa 589

dang / 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs la bsams la/ thams cad rang la bug pas rang la rang gis sbyangs pa la bsam pa'o/ /dang po la bdun te/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas sdug bsngal snga mas non yang da dung thar thabs mi shes pas 'khor ba la skyob/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis 'bras bu bde sdug la blang dor du 'dod kyang / de'i rgyu spang blang gi gnas la rmongs pas 'khor ba pa la skyo ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'khrul snang mtho dman du brgyud pas 'khor ba la skyo ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas dgra gnyen nges med du byas pas 'khor ba pa la skyo ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas lus dang las snang mang bas 'khor ba pa la skyo ba/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bde sdug sna tshogs myong bas 'khor ba la skyo ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas shin tu 'gyur zhing 'pho bas 'khor ba pa la skyo ba'o/ /gnyis pa sdug bsngal sems kyi 'khrul snang rtan gzhi dang bcas pa bsam pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rten sgo gsum gyi dbye ba nges pa/ bshad pas brten pa tshogs brgyad kyi dgye ba nges pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rten gzhi kun gzhi la bag chags spyong tshul gyi dbye ba nges pa'o/ /gsum pa 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs la bsam pa la gsum ste/ rang snang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lung bzhin gdams pa/'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal las kyi rnam smin bzhin bshad pa/ 'khor ba'i dga' ba'i skye bo rtag tu sdug bsngal bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la drug ste/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha min/ lha'i sdug bsngal ba'o/ /dang po la'ang tsha daskyal/ nyi tshe/ nye 'khor/ grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal gsum las/ dang po la gnyis te/ tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal so sor bstan pa dang / thun mong du bshad pa'o/ /dang po tsha dmyal brgyad kyi dang po yang sos la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sdug bsngal dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas tshe tshad do/ /thig nag la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /bsdus 'joms la yang /mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ ngu 'bod la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /du'abod chen po la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /tsha ba la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/bar tu tsha ba la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /mnar med la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong du bshad pa la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /nye tshe nye 'khor la gnyis te/ nye tshe ba dang / nye 'khor ba'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas sdug bsngal bstan pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas log rtog dgag pa'o/ /nye 'khor la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/mtshams sbyar ba dang / mdor bstan pa dngos so/ /gnyis pa la drug ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/rgyas bshad kyis me ma mur gyi 'obs/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas ro myags kyi 'dam/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas spu gri'i thang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas ral gri'i nags/ mtshams sbyasdu9/0bstan/ bshad pas shal ma ri'i/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med do/

gum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ mtshams/ gdams tshul bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa grang dmyal la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sdug bsngal dngos/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas tshe tshad/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de las 'da' bar gdams pa'o/ gnyis pa yi dwags la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sdug bsngal dngos/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de'i cha shas bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / gdams tshul dngos kyis de las 'bad par bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sdug bsngal dngos dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de las 'da' bar gdams pa'o/ /bzhi pa mi'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gsum ste/ sdug bsngal nyid gsum brgyad kyi ngo bo spyir bstan rnam pa brgyad kyi dbye ba bye brag tu bshad/ de las 'da' bar gdams pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /gnyis pa la brgyad de/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas skye ba'i sdug bsngal/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas rgas pa'i sdug bsngal/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas na ba'i sdug bsngal/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas mi bsdug pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis bdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal/bstan pa dang / bshad pas 'dod pas phongs pa'i sdug bsngal mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis nyer len sung po'i sdug bsngal bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa de las 'da' bar gdams pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbya ra/bstan pa/ bshad pa'o/ lnga pa lha min la'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan pa/ bshad pas sdug bsngal dngos dang / mtshams sbyar ba dang / gdams tshul dngos kyis tshul de las 'da' bar bstan pa'o/ /lha'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'dod lha'i sdug bsngal bstan pa dang /mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas khams gong ma gnyis kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa 'khor bar dga' ba'i skye bo rtag tu sdug bsngal bar bstan pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o//bzhi pa thams cad rang la thug pas rang las kyis sbyang bar bstan pa la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas thar pa rang la rag las pas rang gis brtson par bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rang gi las smin pa la gzhan gyi dgag dka' bar bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rgyal ba'i thugs rjes 'dren pa'ang rang gi las su bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rang gi las su ma rtogs pa'i skye bo la skye bar bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas las ngan 'gor ba'i bag chags sbyang dgos par bstan pa'o/ /don gsum pa le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don la lnga ste/mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rtsa ba'i don 'grel/ 'grel pa'i don bsngo/ le'u'i mtshan bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa las rgyu 'bras bsam pa'i le'u la gsum ste/ le'u la 'jug pa rgyu'i don/ le'u dngos kyi don/ le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don to/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bsod nams cha mthun/ thar pa cha mabun/ gnyis kyi gnas skabs gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ las kyi ngo bo mdor bstan/ de'i rten gzhi bye brag tu bshad/ rten chos las kyi sdusdu1 tu

dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bltan/ rgyas bshad do/ /gsum pa la bcu gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas kun gzhi dang tshogs brgyad kyi ngo bo spyir bstan/ mtshams sbyar/mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis sa de la las sog pa dang brten pa'i tshul dang bye brag tu bshad/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan pa/ bshad pas tshogs brgyad kun gzhi dang bcas pa'i rang dus ngos gzung ba/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ bshad pas de goms pa las khams gsum gyi 'khrul snang du 'grub tshul/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas khams gsum so so'i sar shes pas gang gtso cher ldan pa ngos gzung /mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas 'dod par nyin mtshan nges pa'i shes pa ngos gzung /mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis gzugs khams kyi shes pa'i rang sa ngos gzung / mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis gzugs med rang sa'i shes pa ngos gzung / mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis khams gong ma'i sems las grol dgos par spyir gdams/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'dod pa'i sar las khyad pa ra can gyi bsags sbyang bya dgos par bye brag tu bshad pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'dod par nyin dus tshogs brgyad kyi shes pa'i cha dbye/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas 'dod par nyin mtshan 'khor yug gi cha'i shes pa la ngo bo gcig pa'i gnas skabs bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa rten chos las kyi rab tu dbye ba la gsum ste/ rtsa ba'i las mdor bstan/ des bskyed pa'i las dngos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mi dge ba bcu dang / dge ba bcu'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis te/ rang bzhin dang / 'bras bu'o/ /rang bzhin la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa dang gsum mo/ /rgyas bshad la gsum ste/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa sa lus kyi las gsum/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas ngag gi bzhi/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas yid kyi gsum mo/ /'bras bu la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas byed pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bdag po'i 'bras bu/ mtsham sa sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas skyes bu byed 'bras so/ /don bsdu ba la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dge ba bcu'i las la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshadakyi ngo bo spyir bstan pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de'i 'bras bu bye brag tu bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pa'o/ /don gnyis pa thar pa cha mthun gyi las la gsum ste/ las kyi ngo bo khyir bstan/ de'i rten gzhi bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /rten chos las kyi dbye ba nges pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas ngo bo spyir bstan pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bsgrub tshul gye brag tu bsdusdu2 pa'o/ /gnyis pa rten gzhi la 'ang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa dang gsum mo/ gsum pa

rten chos las kyi dbye ba la gsum ste/ thar pa cha mthun gyi rtsa ba'i las/ des bskyed pa yan lag gi las/las kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'o/ dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan pa'i zung 'brel khyad par can gyi las bstan dang / las su btags pa'i nges tshig bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la gnyis te/ 'bras bu bzhi'i rang bzhin spyir bstan pa dang / sbyin sogs khyad par can gyi 'bras bu bye brag tu bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la mtshams sbyar ba dang / ngo bo shes pa gnyis so/ /rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas dbang gi 'bras bu/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas byed pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /gnyis pa sbyin sogs khyad par can gyi 'bras bu la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sbyin sogs drug gi 'bras bu dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa sa byams pa sogs bzhi'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o/ /don gsum pa de gnyis kyi gnas skabs gzhan bstan pa la gsum ste/ las rgyu 'bras kyir nga bzhin bstan pa/ de la tshul gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa/ yang dag pa'i rgyu 'bras bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas las 'bras kyi ngo bo rten 'brel du bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas las 'bras kyi snang tshul sgyu mar bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas las 'bras kyi rang bzhin snang la rang bzhin med par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshul gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas tshul gzhan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan gyis khas bsrung dgod pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bzhad gad kyi gnas su bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas tshar bcad kyi rigs pa dgod pa'o/ /gsum pa yang dag pa'i rgyu 'bras bsgrub pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rten 'brel sgyu ma'i las rnam par gzhag pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas dge sdig blar dor du bya ba'i mchog thar pa'i las bsgrub pa la gdams pa'o/ /don gsum pa le'u rdzogs pa mjuka gi don la lnga ste/mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa/ 'grel pa'i gnas bsngo/ le'u'i mtshan bshad pa'o/ /lnga pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i le'u la gsum ste/ spe'u shā/ 'jug pa rgyu'i don/ le'u dngos kyi don/ le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsu ma ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bsta na/ bshad pa'o/ /sanyis pa la bdun te/ gsal ba sten la bla ma'i rang bzhin/ gang gis bsten pa slob ma'i khyad pa ra/ ji ltar bsten tshul thabs kyi yan lag /'gal zla sdig pa'i rtsa lag spang ba/ ma thun rkyen dase ba'i rtsa lag sten pa/lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsten pa/ rtag tu dge ba'i gshes gnyen bsten par gdams pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ legs dgu dge ba'i bshes las 'byung bas bsten par gdams pa/ ngan pa legs nyen kyis bza ngan du byed pas dam par gdams pa'o/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa/ de'i yon tan rlabs chen bsam pa/ dam pa bsten pa'i man ngag sbyin pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams 593

sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sbyi'i mtshan nyid/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o//bzhi pa pon tan bsam pa la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas mtha' yas ngo mtshar lhun gyis spub pa'i yon tan/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas tshad med yon tan gzhal du med pa'i yon tan/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sa chen 'gro ba'i rten ngudu gyur ba'i yon tan/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas rgyal kun dang skal ba mnyam pa'i lon tan/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas byin rlabs phan bde'i sprin tshogs mnga' ba'i yon tan no/ /dam pa bsten pa'i man ngag la gnyis te/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas mdor bstan pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gang gis bsten pa slob ma'i khyad par la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas slob ma ngan pa'i rang bzhin spang ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas ngan pa'i kun spyod spang ba'o/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas slob ma bzang po'i rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa'i lhar/ dran pa thabs kyi yan lag la gsum ste/ spang bya spong ba'i thabs/ blang bya bsten pa'i thabs/ des spub pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bla ma'i nyes skyon brtag pa spang ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba spang ba/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas bla ma la lus kyis ma gus pa spang ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bla ma la ngag gis ma gus pa spang ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad bas bla ma la yid kyis ma gus pa sbang ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bla ma la rang snang log pa spang ba'o/ /gnyis pa blang bya bsten thabs la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas lus ngag mdangs gsal gyis mnyes pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas rang sems rnam dag gis gnyes pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bsnyen bkur zhabs rtog gis mnyes pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rang phyogs 'gyur med kyis mnyes par bya'o/ /gsum pa des grub pa'i 'bras bu la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'gal zla sdig pa'i rtsa lag spang ba la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sdig pa'i bshes gnyen spang ba/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sdig pa'i grogs po spa nga ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de'i phan yo na bstan pa'o/ /lnga pa mthun rkyen dge ba'i rtsa lag bsten pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas dge grogs bsten par 'os pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de'i phan yon la balngags pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas yon tan gzhan yang bstan pa'o/ /drug pa lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la bstan pa la gsum ste/ rgyun du bsgoms las tshogs dang bcas pa/ rab cha dang zlog ba dmigs gnad dang bcas pa/ thabs des grub pa phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ dang po la gsum ste/bsgom tshul/ las tshogs/ cha rkyen no/ dang po la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas bskyed pa ༵/ lam khyer dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas grag stong gsung gi lam khyer ro/ /las

tshogs la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis zhi ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rgyas pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas dbang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas drag po'o//cha rkyen la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas sngags kyi gnad/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas phan yon gyi rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa bar chad bzlog pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'gron bsam pa/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas mchod rdzas sprul pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas mchod pa 'bul zhing dngos grub blang ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rgyas gdab bya ba/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas phan yon bsten pa'o/ /gsum pa thabs des grub pa'i phan yon la gsum ste/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /bdun pa rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan par gdams pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas phan bde'i 'byung gnas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rtag tu bsten par gdams pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas skyo dub spangs te dka' ba brgya phrag mang por bzod par byas la bsten par gdams pa'o/ /don gsum pa le'u rdzogs pa la mjug gi don la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa/ 'grel pa'i gnas bsngo/ le'u'i mtshan byang bshad pa'o/ /drug pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i le'u la gsum ste/ le'u la 'jug pa rgyu'i don/ le'u dngos kyi don/ le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag /gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ de ltar skyabs su song ba'i bslab bya/ skyabs 'gro rgyud la bsten pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas skyes bu gsum gyi dbye ba bstan pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas blo rigs gsum gyis dus tshigs ngos gzung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/yul gyi dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas sangs rgyas dang chos dang dkon mchog spyir bstan pa dang / lung dang rtogs pa'i chos bye brag tu bshad pa dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog gi gnas bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lung dang rtogs pa'i chos so/ /lung la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas phyi lung gi chos dang /mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas nang lung gi chos so/ /rtogs pa'i chos la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / mdor bstan gyi dbye ba dang bzhi/ spyir bstan pa dang / mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis lam rtogs pa'i chos bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'bras bu rtogs pa'i chos khyad par smos pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de dag gi don bsdu ba'o/ /gsum pa la dge 'dun la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul la gnyis ste/ rgyu'i tshul la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul dang / 'bras bu'i skyabs su 'gro tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rgyu'i skyabs yul bsam pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad 595

pas de la skyabs su 'gro ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de'i phan yon bsngags pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas 'bras bu'i skyabs su yul ngos gzung ba/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas de la skyabs 'gro byed tshul/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad tshul de'i phan yon bsngags pa'o/ /bzhi pa de ltar skyabs su song ba'i bslab bya bstan pa la gsum ste/ rgyu'i bslab bya/'bras bu'i bslab bya/ thun mong du gdams pa'o/ /dang po gdams pa la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas phyir bstan/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas dmigs kyis bsal/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas cha shas dbye/ ma kyi mas sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la 'bras bu'i bslab bya gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa thun mong du gdams pa'ang /mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /lnga pa skyabs 'gro'i phan yon la bdun te/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas drag spyo phan bdes skyob pa'i phan yon/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas thar ba'i lo thog 'phel ba'i phan yon/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas yon tan rlabs chen 'aspub pa'i phan yon/mtshams/ sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas mthar thug byang chub thob pa'i phan yon/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas bsod nams tshad med 'grub pa'i phan yon/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas legs dgu'i yon tan/ 'phel ba'i phan yon/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas phan yon bsams nas skyabs su sang bas slar yang don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phan yon bsngags pa'o/ /don gsum pa le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ 'grel pa'i gnas bsngo/le'u'i mtshan bshad pa'o/ /bdun pa tshad med bzhi'i le'u la gsum ste/ le'u la 'jug pa rgyu'i don/ le'u dngos kyi don le'u rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ tshad med bzhi dang tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'i khyad par/ tshad med bzhi'i bsgom tshul/ sgom pa dag pa'i 'bras bu/ thar lam nges pa 'i gzhung lam dang bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas rgyu dang byed las kyi khyad par/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/bshad pas ngo bo dmigs yul gyi khyad par/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas gnas bzhi nges pa'i khyad par/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas thar lam snying po khyad par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsgom tshul la gsum ste/ go don nges pas spyir bstan/ bo rims nges pas bye brag tu bshad/ rtsal sbyang nges pas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas tshad med bzhi'i dmigs yul bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad tha/sabazhi po rang gi blo'i rnam pa bstan pa/ mtshams sbyar/bstan/ bshad pas thog mar 'jug pa'i go rims bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ btang snyoms byams pa/ snying rje/ dga' ba bsgom pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la bcu ste/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan gyis nye ring chags ldang gi sems la rngan bgrang / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas chags snang mi rigs par gros gdab/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas nye ring chags ldang mi 'thad pa'i rigs pa dgod/mardo~X6sa sbyar ba dang / bstan pas chags ldang med pa'i btang snyams la sbyang / mtshams sbyar/ mdor

bstan/ rgyas par bshad pas smongs pa med pa'i btang snyoms la dgod/ mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas snying rje chen po'i btang snyoms la sbyar/ bstan pa dang / bshad pas nyon mongs pa'i btang snyoms bsgom par gdams/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul dngos rgya cher bshad/mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas goms pa'i rtags dang tshad gzung / mtshams sbyar/ bstan/ bshad pas dmigs pa
